༄ //bod skyong srung ma khag gi lo gyus/

gling gzhi/legs byas me char 'a1thor ba'i gzi khyim can/ /gang 'dul mos por 'phrod pa'i snying rje'i dbang / /dpag yas 'odi snani 'dzin par 'khyil ba'i dbyid/ /sbyan yangs snang byed nyi ma 'di na rgyal/ /:de pa bla med 'dul khrims mthongs su bsnams/ /snying rje bla med ris med 'gre thol byams/ /mdzad 'phrin bla med 'dzam gling 0tshengs khyab pa/ /'di gsum skyabs mgod bla pa'i khyad tshe sa gsum/ /sha 'khoni bam ro phyags pa'i le lan du/ /'khon med snying rje'i zer ma 'bum 'phro ba'i/ /rkang gnyis mi yi 'cho gnas /ma po'i gling / /grags snyan ge sar mu stag mil ma dgodi/ /rang byung ye shes 'od zer rtse dgas 'khyud/ /chogs gnyis dag pa shel dkar dwangs ma'i khams/ /mdza' ba mi 'gyur gser sbyangs btso pa'i phul/ /smra ba'i zla ba rig pa'i khengs pa mtho/ /

thugs bskyed sprin phung dkrigs pa'i klong las nyer babs phan bde'i char rdul zegs ma kun tu 'phye / /bgrang yas srid pa'i zug rngu drung 'byin sman gyi 'khri shing dge legs 'bras bu g.yur za zhing / /'chad rtsod rtsom pa'i 'phrin las lhun grub dri bsung ngad pa lding ba'i gragasapa kun tu :/na/ /gang gi phyag rjes nor 'dzin sgeg mo'i 'gran par rtsen pa'i ma theg ngal ba kun nas/ ba/glen/ /yi dam zhi khro pad ma cod phreng can/ /bka' sdo da dam tshig gnyan po'i rjes 'brel ba'i/ /bod skye nga srung pa'i lha chogs 'khor bcas kyi/ /rnam thar shel dkar me mthong 'di na gsal/ /zhes mchod par brjod pa'i dbyangs kyis nye bar drangs te skabs done gling gzhi ni/ rang re'i mes po bka' drin can rnams nas brgyud pa'i 'dzam gling na ngo gnong mi dgos pa'i chos rig ji snyed cig mthod pa phal cher dus rabs 'phel 'grib dbang gis nyams chags su song ba dang / lha sa su srung ma'i stothor 'di'ang bla rabs bo nga ma rnams nas shin tu gnyan po ra mdzad de/ rang gi bu slobo rgyun 'jin la gnang srol yod pa/ las dmangs kyis srung ma so so'i 'itshe rgyus la rgyus mnga' de tsam med snabs/ chos skyethong khag gi nyer mkho'i mtho rgyus gnad bsdus shig bsgri ga thub na bsams nas dpyad gzhi'i yig cha 'alha la sgrab byed ska bas/ rje drung bzhad nga/'i rdo rje'i gsung 'bum khrod na (7brnya na srung༄ rgya ’

mtsho'i rnam thar na/zhes pa zhig 'dug pa mthe nga bas/ snga ra las rtse ma 'dun che ru song ste/ deb chung 'di rtsom sgri ga byed 'go btsugs pa yin/yig cha der zhib tu blta skabs/ che( rgyus snga ma rnams las zhib rgyas che zhing / 'ordzo mang ring thugs zhib gnang ba'i 'ordzo rgyus kyi rtsal bon pa zhig 'dug pas gang ci'i legs cha che rung / tshig sgyo ra rnams gter yig dang /brda rnying du song gshis/ deng skabs kyi rgya che'i klog pa po rnams la 'tshams min sna tshogs 'dug pas/ rig sbyor gyi thod don mkhregs po'i rigs rnams sla bcos byas te kta nga bsdus re bdus/ yang dogs gzhi can dang / yig cha gzhan dag la blta dbo sa pa/'i rigs khungs serdzo serdzor btsal nas bskyar zhib yang zhib byas/yig cha'i nang gas la ba'i lung 'dren mdzad pa/'i khungs rnams setrer bzhag ma byas pa/ra gsu nga 'bum so so'i khrod kyi yig cha ngo ma rnams dang bsdur nas blta ska bas/ wo rgyus 'di'i rtsom gdan gtso bo lta bu ni/ (7rin chen gter mdzod na/nang gsal ba'i rgyud dang / gter yig de dag yin 'dus pa dang / khyad par yig cha der chos skyo nga so so'i zad kyi lo rgyus snga shos rnams dpyad gzhir bzung nas bris 'dug kyang / kha shas thad grub mtha'i dbang gis kha mi gsal ba 'ang 'dug pas yig cha gzhan dag dang bsdur nas kha sterdzong byas/dpyad gzhi rnams kyang gtor chog dang / bska nga gserdzo/ gsole kha sethogs lag tu gang thob dpyad gzhi ma byas par so so'i thad kyi rgyud snga shos dang / gter yig snga 31sa gang yin pa der khungs gtugs byas pa yin/(rba bzhed )dang / o rgyan gling pa'i gter ma (rgyal po'i bka' thang na// mnga' bdag nyang ban gyis gter nas bzhes par grags pa'i /tshegu ru'i rnam thar zangs gling man// o rgyan gling pa'i gter ma (7lha 'dre bka'

spang na/rnams sbrags nas blta skabs/ srung ma mtshan mi 'dra ba bzhi cu lhag theni pa de dag gi nang nas sku'ings grags kha shas bris pa yin kyang / kha sham la snyan brgyud kyi 'o rmorgyus ma rnyed snabs de mur bzhag yang khashas zad gsemal khakhungs ma rnams nas kha skong byas pa'ang 'di/yang srid pa chags pa'i lha dgu ngang / rje yi mgur lha bcu gsum sogs kyi 'etshe rgyus dalhasnas gnad che yang / rje yi mgur lha bcu gsum ni/ srid pa chags pa'i lha dgu'i steng srung ma bzhi (gsham gsal rnam grangs la gzigs )bsnan pa tsam las 'ethogs su med kyang / 'di dag gi 'edzi rgyus khungs ldan zhig ma mthong stabs/ g.yung drung boni gyi ba na 'byung khag las byung ba'i bshad srol rnams sor bzhag byas te bris pa yin kyang / re re bzhin lo rgyus med par 'o de gung rgyal gyi sras yin par bshad pa gang snar 17zang yig na/dang (7rba bzhed na/sogs kyi nang / yar lha sham po dang / gnyan chen zang lha semags las gzhan mi gsal snabs/ skabs 'dir 61ngas grags kyi dbang du byas te/ 'etho rgyus mthogs su bris pa yin/mgon po'i rigs la bshad srol mang ba dang / lhathos su grub mtha' so so'i lugs kyi phyag mtshan dang / kha dog le rgyus sogs bzhed srol mi 'dra yang / skabs 'dir thams cad mkhyen pa bsedi nams rgya mchos mdzad pa'i lo rgyus khungs ldan du song gshis/ snying bsdus shig zur 'don byas 'di cing / spyir bod du bzhugs pa'i mgon po'i chos skor dkar chag tu bsdebs pa zhig mthong ba'i nang / chos skor mi 'dra ba khag brgya dang nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i mtshan byang gsal ba deng sang cha tshang mthod med ma shes kyang / zhib cha (7rin chen gter mdzod )nang yod pa'i mgon po'i chos lkor de rnams yin/ phyis su mkhas grub thams cad mkhyen pas 17matre na po'i be'u bam na/mdzad pa nas 5

bzung matre na po'i chos 〈snar rnams las khungs btsan 3thos su byed pa yin/yang mabeshan po thobya re ga gdermeng can dang phyag bzhi ba gnyis gcig tu byed pa dang / 'ga' shas kyis zhal ba'i ba dang phyag bzhi gnyis gcig tu byed pa sogs cha 'jog ma nges pa lta bu mang du mthong yang / skabs 'dir mthongs grags kyi dbang du byas te bris pa yin/yang mdze rgyus kha shas las tshe ring mched lnga 'di dang / bstan ma bcu gnyis 'othogs su med par bcigad pa dang / sku(ngas grags su 'ethogs su mdzad 'dug pa/ gang ltar tshe ring mched lnga'i stothor la (7mi la ras pa'i rnam mgur na/las gzhan gsal ba'i yig cha ma rma )thong stabs/ rnam mgur de las byung ba ji bzhin bris pa yin kyang / kha shas kyis re re bzhin skye khungs mi 'dra ba lta bu'ang bshad srol mthod las che yang / skabs 'dir mi la'i rnam mgur semar bzhag byas sku(da/pe har dang / gnas chung rdo spre dregs ldan gnyis ngo co logs su 'di par snyam ste/ bskyar zhib yang zhib byed skabs/ pe har rgyal ngo/'i gsung gi spral bar grags pa las ngo bo 'othogs su ma rnyed stabs/ pe har rgyal po'i tsho rgyus kyi'aphros don las gnas chung rdo spre dregs ldan gyi lo rgyus shes dbe|sa pa yin/yang bska nga gso dang / bstod tshogs lta bu las mdze rgyus khungs ma med pa dper na/ bsnan ma bcu gnyis lta bu yin kyang / cod kyi yul lha rnying khongs su/ song gshis/ 7gong sa lnga pas mdzad pa'i (7brtan mgos dpyod kyi rgyal mo'i glu dbyangs na/dang / slob dngon pad mas mdzad par grags pa'i (7brgyags brngan na/gnyis gung bsgrigs nas bris pa yin kyang / brtan pa'i rgyud dang / 'otho rgyus/ serme so'i phyag mtshan dang / chibs pa sogs bzhed

srol mi mthun pa shin tu mang yang / zhib cha rgyud so sor gzigs dgos shing /g.yu sgroni ma 'di yig cha kha shas las brtan ma bcu gnyis kyi gtso mo lta bu dang /re 'gar brtan ma bcu gnyisalas logs suphyes 'dug pa gang ltar gtso mo lta gyani/ g.yu sgron ma 'di nyid yin stabs/ skabs 'dir lo rgyus logs su bris pa dang / yang brtan ma sermo se 'i mtshan snamar ba min nam snyam pa'ang 'dug pa yig cha sngon ma rnams rang sor bzhag mthod/srung pa'i lo rgyus 'di lo rgyus bzhan dag dang mi 'dra bar gzab nan daskra sa gal mthong ste/ cog mar zin bris btab pa nas maberte mjug bar thengs bzhir bskyar zhib 'phri stoni byas cog mkhas pa bgres rabs myong be mas can khag la sbyan zhib zhus te/ dgongs 'char gnang ba gzhir bzung gis slar yang thengs gcig 'phri stoni byas pa dang / khyad par 7bosnang sa skyabs mgod chen po'i chogaskyong bsten phyogs skor gyi bka' slob snga rjes bstsal ba'i dgongs gzhis zur brgyan/ skabs 'brel dbe sa gal can khag gcig gi 'khrungs 'das kyi lo tshugs gang rnyed kha rlo nga byas/ mjug tu chos skyong khag gi gsol kha dang / rgyud/ bstodi tshogs sogs nas byung ba'i rnam grangs rnams bsags nas ༷thogs gcig tu bsdebs te (7bsnan srung rgya mtsho'i rnam grangs gser gyi thang ma na/zhes btags te mjug tu bkodi/ yang 7bo nga sa skyabs mabod chen pos ljags rtsom mdzad pa'i (7bod skyong lha srung gi 'phrin bcol dam ldan myur skul na/'di nyid byin rlabs myur bas lhan thabs su bkodi pa yin/yin na'ang rtsom sgrig pa rang nyid na tshod gzhes khar/ mthong rgya dang shes 63 gang ci'i thog nas zhan snabs/ rtsom sgrig gi mthun rkyen dang dus chod sogs kyis rkyen pas/ deb chung 'di'i nang don dang tshig sbyor/ rgyas bsdus/ go rim sogs kyi thad nor 'khrul 'di srid pas/ mkhyen ldan 5/’

mkhas dbang dang rgya che'i skruthog pa pe thornams/ nas mtho bsrang thad gar gnang ba/ 'dun bcas/ rtsom sgrig pa sa/ sod rab byung bcu bdun pa'i me byi ྅1ཿཿcalo'i zla 1 tshes 17 nyin rda ram sa la nas /

mgon po phyag drug pa/mabe|na pe thophyag drug pa/skyes bu gsum gyi lam gyi srung pa'i gtso/ /myur ma dzad matre na dang rnam sras las gshin semags / /zhes gsungs pa'i chos bu chen po 'i srung ma/spyan ras gzigs drag tu khre sa pa'i mgode po phyag drug pa 'di nyid mkhas grub khyung co rnal 'byor las brgyud pa'i lo rgyus ni/ sngon mgon yo 'di sangs rgyas sne nga ba mtha' yas kyi sbya na ji ra byang chub mtshe ga tu sems bskyed/ dam/ las 'da' na mabed bo tshal ba 〈 snang du 'gas par gyur cig ces dam bcas nas/ ri co po tā la nas sems can gyi don byed cing bzhugs nga la / dus snyigs mar song gshis se ma sa can gyi gshis rgyud rje sdu ga je ngan du song sde/ thugs chad nas sems can 'di rnams las ngan pas mi sku(nga bar 'dug dbedzings nas/ byang chub kyi brla ba pa dor bas/ de ma thag maskra bo tshal ba jo nga du gas pa/ sa ngas rgyas snang ba mtha' yas byoni te/ khyed kyis ji ra khas blangs pa'i dam tshig de tshar cig skyo ra gsu ngas pa de ltar skyor bas / phyag drug tu gyur te slar yang nyin ma tshan dus drug tu sems can gyi dod byed cing bzhugs/de nas nam zhig dpal 'bras spu ngas dang nye ba'i grong khyer zhig na/ bram ze sha ba ri'i rigs tri pa la zhes pa rol sa mkhas pa/ sngone chad sangs rgyas la rol mo'i mchod pas mnyes par byas pa zhig 'dzid pa de/ dur khrod bsil ba'i tshal na 'jag ma 'i spyil bu'i nang ma thom zhing bzhugs pa'i ska bas/nyin zhig bar snang nas sgra zhig grags pa gzigs dus/ mabo na po 'di'i zhal

ma/bo napophyagadugapa/ da gzigs te/ nga'i sgri ba thabs 'di khyed la gtod nga mee/na pas yid la zungs shig gsungs te/ mi gnang ba'i gdams pa rnam sa mee ger btab ji/'i rnya na brgyud rnams rim par brgyud pa'i chos skor sna chogs shig mdzed pa/ dus phyis su mkhas grub dge legs dpal bzang gis dag zer mdzad nas mabe|na nge tho'adi'i (7be buman/ brtsam/sa nga/ 'di mgon po 'i tshetshes sko ra nang nas khungs btsan shos shig yin kyang / ṣṭṛ ra na mgon po'i chos rlo ra dkar chag tu bsde bas nga/ zhig mthong ba de'i nang chos 〉 thor brgya lha ga gi mtshan byang bris 'dug nga/ gang ltar/skyes bu chen po 'i srung ma/ 'di chos brgyud gzhan dag dang / khyad par ri bo dge sdo/gas pa'i srung ma gtsigs cher 'dzin pa/ zhig mee/na/

dbang snan lha ra dpal ldan lha resna/sangs rgyas 'ode srung gi sku dus nas byung ba'i srung ma 'di nyid kyi byung tshul la bshad sretrel mi 'dra ba mang yo 'dug kyang / 'dir rgyal mtshe ga bsermed nams rgyal mtsho'i 17'ode chen 'bar pa'i gte ra tshe ga bdud las rnam rgyal na/'di nyid go sla zhing khungs ldan du song gshis 'dir cha tshang drangs na/'di'i lo rgyus dang byung tshul cung zad brjod na/ sngon bskal pa dang po'i tshe sa 'og rim pa bdun gyi 'og na gshin rje sde dpon 'o nga pa'i rgyal po dang /bdud kyi rgyal sa me 'bar ma zhes bya ba gnyis sngoni du byung ba'i sras ོ che ba gcig lha'i dbang pos 'khyer/ de'i 'og ma klu'i rgyal pos 'khyer/ de nas sras ming sring gnyis byung ba na/ bu sa na re/ nga la mched 'di pa gar song zer bas/ yab kyi zhal nas/ khyed kyi mched 43 ma gnyis lha klus 'khyer zer/ de gnyis mi 'gugs sam byas pas/ ma na re/ lha klu de gnyis 'jigs shing dbang che bas thub par dka' zer/ de'i tshe bu po na re/ ngas 'jig rten gyi khams su skye ba brgya blangs pa lasad lta'i skyeb 'di lasamasache ba med/ nga la 'gran nus pa 'jig rten su na'ang med pas/ nga la phyag tshan bskur zer ba na/ yab kyis zhags pa dang dbyug pa byin/ rdi/ma gyis khram shing dang nad rkyang byin pa de 'khyer nas/ ming po gshin rje rgyal yo dang steng du semang nas/ lha dbang tshar bcad/ de'i lag nas rang gi a lce khrid nas klu yul du phyin/ klu rgyal tshar bcad/ de'i lag nas a lce khrid nas ming sring 3

—dari la ri na lha sdo gsungs pas/ mdor na ma sa thams cad kyi rtsa ba e ka ji tī la brten pas 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i tshul mdzad tshul gdulabya'i rigs sna chogs su spral ba yin no// dzo nyid rgya gar nas byed tshul ni/ rgyal ba rdo rje 'chang gis bram ze chen po sa ra ha la gnang zhing / de'i sgrab skor las chogs mdzad do/ de nas rim par brgyud de bod du pha dam pa sanges rgyas kyis sbyan drangs te/ de'i chos sgor dar ba byung / khyad par kha che bya/ nag po'i ro sol gyis zhal gzigs nas mngon :de kyi las drag po'i spyor ba mang po mdzad/ bla ma des mā ma bran mtha' bral ཿthos skyetsheng la dngethos su bka' bache(sa nas gnang / de nas rim par brgyud pa las/ bdag cag rnams kyi rigs rgyud la srung zhing skyetsheb pa'i bka' srung skyab thag nye la mthu rtsal che zhing / thugs rje dang byin rlabs myur ba'i lha sbyo 'ardo nyid ni/ gshin je chos rgyal gyi yum tsa min tri sgos sgrab tu bya ba yin ni / / ༄zhes lha sa 'di nyid sog mar rgya gar du byung tshul dang / phyis su pha dam pa sangs rgyas kyis lha mo'i chos skore rnams bod du gdan drangs pa khrophu 'o thotsā ba (1173—1225)serdzogs brgyud rim bzhin rgyal maḥsnag sku phreng rim byed gyi srung mar gyur pa'i brgyud rim cha tshang gsungs pa bzhin/ lha sa 'di nyid je dge 'dun grub pas srung ma gtso wang bsten pa'i tshul dper na rgyal maḥthog dge 'dun grub ( 1391—1474 )kyi (7rnam thar ngo mtshar rmad byung nor bu'i phreng ba na/las/shing sa glang le'i dgun chos la bo rwadong la byed/ chos sog gcig 1 (7bstan srung rgya mtsho'i rnam thar na/la dgas dpar ma'i 3tsheg ngos 334 par gsal/

dang ci rī ri na lha ོ / bzhi yab yum gyi sar slebs pas/ yab yum dga' sne/ da ni 'jig rten na nged rang bza' mi las dbang dang mthu che ba med pa yin/ a ce gnyis kyis lha dang klu yul du dbang bsgyur/ sring mo dan mthu che bas khams gsum ka la dbang bsgur/ ming po gshin rje ni skyes 'gro'i dbugs kyi bdag po gyis la legs nye kyi chad pa gcade/ sring sa khyed kyi ming ni gshin rje lcam sa dang /bdud kyi yum dang / dus tshan nag pe zhes bya ba yin sna zhes mtshan gsemal/zhag re re la 〈snag chags brgya lnga bcu'i sre ga dbugs dang / sha khrag la 'ethongs spyad cing 'jig rten gyi ma sa dang / lha srin sde brgyad kyi dmag dponi du mnga' gsemal nas 'di pa la/ dpal khrag 'thung rgyal pe sa dam la btags te sretreg snying phul nas zhag bdun bdun la bstan pa'i dgra bo re re zas skal du byin nas/sangs rgyas kyi bsnan pa srung bar bka' balhathos/ khyad par ming po gshin rje dang /lcam sring gnyisarigasadrug godakar nag gi las kyi chad pa gcodi par byin gyis brlabs/ ming ngo gshin rje dbyug pa chen po dang / ma mo chen po tsa mi dang /ye ka dzā sta dang / dmag dponi rgyal sa zhes bya bar yang mtshan btags/ rnya snaphyogs lcags mkhar bcu drug gi bdag pore bzhag bo yang de lta'i bka' srung de ni sngoni byang chub tu sems bskyed/ bar du tshogs gnyis la bslab pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sa brgyad la gnas pas de nyid bstan pa srung ba'i phyir/ shin tu 'jigs pa'i srung ma'i rnam par bsnan pa yin/ (7ma mo khros pa'i rgyud na/dang / (gshin rje rtog pa )dang / (me lce 'bar ma'i rgyud )dang /17gshan pa nag mo'i rgyudan// lo rgyus rnams las gsal bar byung ste/ re ma sta mched bzhi dang / bal mo mched bzhi/ dus tshan ma mched bzhi bya ba rnams 'di yi zhi rgyas dbang drag gi 'phrin las sgrub pa'i sku'i stoni tshul du 5

dpal lja na lha ོ / bzhugs/ sna ma 11la mtshams shig tu bla brang ser pe ra grags pa der 1sna rangs shig mabo phur nas 'di tsa na/ bar snang la bud med ngus pa'i skad lhang ba zhig byung / maspro phur ba sangs te ci byung ba yin dris pas/ de bshad na khyed kyang myongan byed du 'ong bas mi smra zer/ ci yin nam snagadu sems ma bde ba zhig byung / yang de dus blo rangs shig sngar gyi bud med de'i skad lhang ba zhig byung / mgo 'o bsrings te nyan pas/ de na khyed kyi dgon pa 'di/ /gdul bya dag kyang der 'du zhing / kho mo'ing khyed kyi rjes su 'brang / /khyod kyi rjes 'brang skyebo par byed/ /cegazer/zhes gsal ba bzhin bud med de ngus pa'i nyin kha shas kyi rjes nas dga' snan du rje shegarab seng ge dgongs pa rdzogs song zer ba'i skad cha 'bul mkhan byung ba de lta busarkyen byagate paṇa chen dge 'dun grub 'di nyid lha more mos gus che ba lta bus/ rje rang gi thun sang ma yin pa'i srung ma gtso por mdzad pa 17rnam thar ngo mtshar rmad byung nor bu'i phreng ba na/las/ khyad par lha ko dmag zor ma 'dis nye gnas khyad par can zhig tu phul srung skyethob tshul bzhin mdzad pa yin dzo/ /zhes dang / yang rgyal mtshe ga dge 'dun grub kyi (7rang rnam na/nang / yang snyil du ri la bzhugs pa'i tshe nub gcig sredi la grang rdul dang 'jigs sgrag gi ngang nas yab kyi sku phag tu nyal ba'i tshe yab kyi zhal nas/ci 'dug gsungs/ ban de ras cham dang sag theb rgyad pa zhig gis nga'i rkang pa naga'athen gyi'adug pa la dpal ldan lha mo dre'u la chibs te byed nas dre'u las 2 17'phags pa 'jigarten dbang phyugaga'akhrungs rabasan/ war ṇa lcags dpar ma'i shog nge sa 247 par gsal/

dang ci rī 3 na lha po babs te khe'i lag pa la pe cani brgyab pas khe tholag pa na nas phur phur byed cing dre sa sermeng / zhes gsungs pa gang ltar yang snying rgyal ba dge 'dun grub kyi sku dus su srung ma 'di dang dam tshig 'dris can du gyur te/ rgyal mcho ga sku phreng rim byed gyi sku'i srung ma gtso sor mdzad pa dper na/ rgyal mtshethog dge 'dun rgya ma37 1476—1542 )yi (7rnam thar dpag bsam ljoni shing na/las/yi dam bcu gsum dang / ye shes mabeshan po snaphyag drug pa/ dpal ldan da pag zere rgyal motho setregs yi dam ཿthos skyetsheng du pa'i bsnyen sgrab mtha' yas pa zhig dang /lhag par gtsang nas dbus phyogs la 'tsheng dgos st+ra shar nas/ deng sang gi bar dpal ldan lha mo'i rtsa sngags nyin re bzhin stong phrag re la/ nyung mthar byas na chag med du byas pa zhib tu brtsis na lha mo'i rtsa sngags 'di dung phyur la nye ba tsam song ba 'dra zhes gsungs shing / bkra shis lhun po'i gdan sar 'gro gdong tsam nas zhogs pa lha mo la bska nga gserme dang gtor ma /thun gsum du 'bul ba/ dgong re bzhin thun gtor gshegs pa dang bcas / zhes gsu ngas pa bzhin rgyal mtshetsheg dge 'dun rgya mtshos lha ma tho'adi gtsigs cher mdzad nas nyin rer lha mo'i rtsa sngags gcig stong re bsnar chags su zhal 'don mdzad bzhin pa 'di'i babs la brtag na lha mo 'di sku'i srung ma gtso co yin par go zhing /3 (7'phags pa 'jig rten dbang phyug gi 'khrungs rabs ga/deb phreng dang po war ṇa lcags dpar pa'i 3tsheg ngos 347 par gsal/ (7'phags pa 'jig rten dbang phyug si 'khrungs rabs na/deb phreng dang po war ṇa lcags dpar ma'i 3snag ngos par gsal/7

dpa la ri na lha ra /yang therdzos su rgyal ba dge 'dun rgya mtsho'i sku dus su 'bri gung ba dang cung zad thugs snang mi mthun pa lta bus/ skabs shig sde gzar byung skabs/ lha sa 'di'i ཿ tho'aphrul gyis dgra dmag gi gur gyi chod thag rang shugs kyis chad nas nam mkhar rlung gis 'khyer ba sogs kyi 'tshub stos ngan pa byung ba/ rje 'dis lha mo'i cho 'phrul yin pa tre nas rgyal lha khang du lha mo'i sku byin can zhig 'di pa gzigs zhib tu byed skabs/ chibs sga dang mtho gang tsam gyis ma thug par mde pa/ sku mdog kyang gnag cing snum pa shin tu sku las bskyed pa lta bu'i gzigs snang byung ba'i lo rgyus 'di pa ltar/ lha mo 'di lus dang grib ma bzhin du 'grogs te/ rje nyid la bar du gcod pa thams cad tshar gcod pa lta bu zhig 'di par mngon zhing / rgyal lha khang du'ang spre rang gi phyag bris ngo ma lha po gsung byed ma zhig 'di pa shin tu byin can du brtsi ba yin/ thang ga 'di'i skor 7gong sa skyabs mgon sku phreng bcu bzhi pa'i (7chos skyong bsten phyogs skor gyi bka' slob phyogs bsdebs na/nang / sku thang 'di 7long sa lnga pa chen po zhing la gshegs skabs/ ljags dbugs bsdus tshar rjes pho brang gi rtsig 'phro se gas 'gan chen po babs pa yin stabs/ sde srid 'u thug gsol 'debs byed skabs/ rgyal ba lnga pa slar thengs gcig sku sos nas sde srid la/ khyed rang de tsam sems ngal mi dgos/spyir btang don dag rnams khyed rang gis thag chod/ thag ma chod pa'i rigs rnams ('di'i lorgyus yom (('phags pa 'jig rten dbang phyug gi 'khrungs rabs na/deb phreng gnyis pa'i 31ga ngos 777par gsal bas der gzigs )rgyal ba dge 'dun rgya mtsho'i thugs dam gyi rten dpal ldan lha mo'i sku thang 'di'i mdun la zan brtag sgril nas thag gcod gyis zhes gsungs yod pa red/ ( (7bka' slob phyogs bsdebs ༄)shog ngos

dpa nga snan lha re / —de nas rgyal mtshe ga bsemad nams rgya ma37 1543—1588 )yi sku dus su'ang lha sa 'di sngar bzhin bsten cing grogs mdzad pa'i lo rgyus 'di pa dper na/ /rternam thar dngos grub rgya mtsho'i shing rta na/las/ de'i tshe nag phyogs gi bdud rigasa'aga' zhig (rje nyid la mi dga' ba'i mi kha shas yin nam snyam )gis bar du gcodi pa brtsams pa na/ spyodapal ldan lha mo dmag zor gyi rgyal mo byed te tshar bcad pa dngos su gzigs pa/ zhes dang / yang 17rnam thar dngos grub rgya mtsho'i shing rta na/las/ rje gong ma'i phyag len ltar/ dpal ldan wo sa 'dod khamasakyidabang phyug dmag zor rgyal mo'i mchod gtor bzang zhing gya nom pa legs par bshams te/ gnam gang gi daskra nga mo gtor ma byin rlabs dang tshes gcig gi rgyu skar lha mtshams shar ba dang mnyam du thugs dam tshugs te/nyi shar la'ang thog tu phebs nas gtor skyong rten 'bul sogs rgyas par gnang /03 par gsal )zhes gsungs pa'i sku thang 'di (7rgyal mchog dge 'dun rgya mtsho'i rnam thar na/g.yang ba chos rjes mdzad pa'i stod cha'i nang / rgyal ba dge 'dun grub kyi phyag bzo'i lha sa dmag zor ma zhig yod skor ((('phags pa 'jig rten dbang phrul gi 'khrungs rabs na/deb phreng dang po'i shog ngos 747 par gsal )gsal ba de min nam snam zhing / yang rgya mchog dge 'dun rgya mtsho'i mdzad rnam nang rje rang gi phyag bris kyi lha mo'i thong ga byin can zhig sku(da ste ra gsal ba de gnyis las gang yin zhib gsal ma nges/6 lho'aphags pa 'jig rten dbang phyug gi 'khrungs rabs/war ṇa lcags dpar ma'i 3snag ngos 10 par gsal/

dang la snan lha po de'i tshe mdun gyi bar snang la dpal ldan lha sa dngos su byon pa sogs ngo mtshar ba'i gzigs snang dpag tu med pa byung ngo ra / /zhes gsungs pa bzhin rje 'di dang mthun sang ma yin pa'i 'brel ba zhig 'di par mtshon zhing / de bzhin rgyal ma3snag 03 tan rgya mtshe cho(1589—1616)dang / rgyal dbang lnga pa chen po1617——1682) bcas kyi sku'i srung ma gtso bor lha sa 'di bsnyen cing gtsigs cher mdzad pa dper na/ (77gong sa lnga pa'i rang rnam gyi kha skong na/sde srid sangs rgyas rgya mchos mdzad pa de'i nang / nged rnams kyis da cha gsang sgo dgos sam ji 3 ra drag sku'i skye ba myur du nges shes 'drongs pa dang /de'ang nged tsho'i nye rigs min par phebs dgos zhes smre sngags phyag dang bcas zhus pa na/ sku dngos su sems pa'i sbyan gzigs nas/ rje tredzeng ma na rim gyis lha more lung bstan zhu ba gnang ba bzhin nged rang gi chos skyethong gi gtso bo'ang yin pas blos ma tshede rigs lha mthor brtag sgril dang retho phya bgyis zhes bka' bstsal nas / zhes gsal ba'i tshig 'bru 'di 7tredzeng sa lnga pa chen po dbe|ngas pa dze gas khar/ sde srid sangs rgyas rgya ma3 sna(1653—1679)yis gsang lhasna dbo sa min dang / yang pal myur byed dbo sa pa'i gsemal ba btab pa'i bka' lan zhal chems mtha' ma 〉na cing / 'di'i 1snag nas lha mtho 'di 7 (7'phags pa 'jig rten dbang phyug gi 'khrungs rabs na/deb phreng gnyis pa sbar ṇa lcags dpar pa'i 31ga ngethos 33 par gsal 8 17'phags pa 'jig rten dbang phyug gi 'khrungs rabs na/deb phreng gnyis pa war ṇa lcags dpar pa'i tu(ga nge sa 776 par gsal/1 0

dpas ji na lha ra rgyal ba sku phreng rim byed gyi thugs rtse gtad pa'i srung ma nang khorjis yin pa dang /gzhung skra/ga'agangs che ba'i phyag las thams cad lha rmethor zan sgril gyis lung zhu mdzad bzhin pa gsal po ra shes thub pa yin/de yang paṇa chen dgo'adun grub kyis lha mo 'di'i lung sog mar ji ltar gsan pa'i tshul 17rnam thar nor bu'i phreng ba na/las/ de nas bo dong la byon/dpal ldan dmag zor lha sa sku skye mang yo nas kyi chos skyetsheng yin pa la sngar rjes gnang zhu ba sogs mdzad pas/ de zhu ba la de dus bo dung na rgyal sras rin po che'i dngos slob rin po che chos bzang dpal ba zhes bzhugs pa der byon/ lha mo'i rjes gnang dbedzis zhus pas/ khong gi zhal nas/ mdang rmi lam bzang /lho phyogs 'di nas rlung nag 'tshub pa'i dkyil nas dge slong zhig bo dong gi sgo rtsar spebs byung ba la 'di nas bud med rgyan can zhig semang ste/ bstan 'dzin chen po la bsu ba byed zer nas song ba rmis/ da res rang 'brug po hor gyis 'khyer ba 'dra/ ha ha gsud zhing / lha sa 'di'i bka' lung man ngag dang bcas pa rdzogs par gnang ga /zhesapaṇa chen dgo'adun grub kyis lha mo'i chos stothor bo rwadong phyogs nas gsan pa de nagabazung rgyal ba skuphreng rim byed gyi thun sang ma yin pa'i sku'i srung ma dam tshig 'dris can du gyur te/ rgyal mchog dge 'dun rgya mtsho 'di nyid 'bras spungs su rgyun bzhugs mdzad par brten/ 'bras spungs su'ang lha mo 'di srung pa'i gtso bor mdzad cing / dus phyis su 'bras spungs la 'brel ba 'di 17'phags pa 'jig rten dbang phyug ga 'khrungs rabs na/deb phreng gnyis pa war ṇa lcags dpar ma'i 3snag ngos 23 par gsal/11

ngari ci rī 3 rna rā ོ pa 'i dge 'u gas nga/'i datha na pa gang sa ra lha sa 'di srung ma 'i gtso sor bsnye na pa dang / de yang ma do smad reb sgo nga nas yo na nga 'i lha rje brag swā ba zhu ba dbus phebs rsha bas / 'betho ma tre na 'phags nga ra a ma do'i phogs su srung ma chad lngan zhig dab sa nā ra zhus ngor lha cho 'di gnang ba de nas bzung ma do smad du srung ma 'di dar srol chen ngo byung / ngag rgyun tu'ang srung ma 'di nang nga byam sa shing phyi 'i 'phrin 3 si dang ma thu rtsa rī che bar grags ju 'i srung ma tham sa cad kyi ya nga spre lda bu 'di nyid dge 'u gas ② dar khyab ha dung re ba ma zad/ rnying phags su 'ang dang srol chen po yo da nga dpe ra na/ sre 'u nga bcud pa'i rdo spres ma rngad nga 'i /tebarnya na srung rgya ma tsho'i rnam thar ྅ tshen me da re gas bshad na/la sa / nang du rnyi nga nye wa bkra shis / phyi ru rno myur tshan che/ khyad nga ra du yang chos rgyal gter bdag gling pa ya ba sras rnam sa kyisrung ma 'i gtso thun sang ma yin pa 'gran zla dang bral batshor//'es gas wa ba ba'in ma nga' bdag nyang nyi ma te da zer gyis bsam ya/ma ma chodad rten nag ngo nas spu na drangs pa'i lha retho 'di'i sgra ba thabs dang / serdzog btad kyim na ngag rnam sa rim ba'in tshe sa rgyal gter sbadag gling pa 'gyur me da the spre dang / de nas rim ba'in 'phags sde rwadze tsā ba dge 'dun bkra tshes/ spre drung brnya na pa rgya mcho/ dge 'dun chos kyi dbang phyug sa gas spre drung rim byon brgyud rab 'byam sa pa don 'grub brgyud bar ma chad pa ra rnying phyogs kyi thun ri nga rma yi na nga 'i srung ma gasdud nge ra ma dzad pa rma zad/ grub rma tha' ris med kyis bsnye na 0 〈bstan sru nga rgya rma tsho'i rnam 488 sa dpe mdzod khang gi dpar pa'i tu ga dze sa 344 par thabathang zung ༈

dang rī 3 na lha ོ pa te/ dper na/ paṇa chen blo bzang chos kyi nyi ma (1653 ——1679)yis mdzad pa'i 17mdo khams dbang phyug dmag zor rgyal mo'i chos stothor gyi dkar chag mkha' 'gri dgyes pa'i sgra dbyangs na/kyi gling gzhi'i skabs/ de la 'dir ngag dbang lha sa snyigs dus bstan dgra 'dul ba'i phyir gtum drag rol pa'i skur bzhengs pa dpal ldan lha mo dpag zor rgyal sa 'di nyid gsang sngags gsar rnying mtha' dag pas bsten cing / bsgrab pa'i srung ma gtso bor bzung zhing /khyad par du'ang bkra shis lhun gyis grub pa〉 chos grwa chen po 'di nyid pad dkar 'chang dbang thams cad mkhyen pa dge 'dun grub pa dpal bzang pethos 1tsheg mar phyag 'debs pa'i dus su'ang lha mchog 'di nyid la gos kyiganyer gter mdzad pa dang / de rjes bde ldan zhing gi mgon po ma hā paṇa ṭi da blo bzang chos kyi rgyal mtshan nas bzung sku 'phreng dang / mkhan 11ba rim par byed pa thams cad kyis srung ma'i gtso bor mdzad pas/ zhes dang / de'i mjug thogs su/ chos skyethong 'di nyid gsang sngags gsar rnying / bon lugs/ dge lugs semags grub mtha' ris med kyis bsten gshis 3snas rmethor la'ang bsres bslad kyi 'phros pa'ang mang bas yid brtan dka' ba bcas/ zhes gsungs pa ltar retho/ /rnying phyogs sulha po 'di'i chos skor ji snyed cig bzhugs/ pa'i nang nas grags che ba khag ni/ 17mkha' 'a〈sna snying thig chen po'i gdams pa na/dang /klong chen rab 'byams pa'i (7lha mo'i sgrab thabs na/dang srog gtad las byang mang tho mdzad cing / yang sgos su slobyo dpon pad mas gsungs pa'i (pasrog sgrab rtsa ban// (7yang snying gnubs kyi man ngagan/ /nyang gter rdo spre drob brtan gyi (7rdo spre gshog rgod pa'i srog gtadan// (7brnya na ma rgya mtsho'i rgyud na/sogs lha mo'i chos skor shin tu mang tho bzhugs/13

da wa dang 4 3nalha re dang 'i/ ldan dam ga zor ma 'di'i 'byung khungs lo rgyus ni/ sngo na chad dur lho chen po brgyad na nor srung gi ma mo brgyad yod pa 'i nang nas ma po 'di (lha po )dur khrod bsil ba tshal gyi nor srung yin zhing / shin tu 'tshub pa sa klu thams cad bran du bskerdzol ba/ datshethor bdag thams/ cad kyi nang nas 'gran zla bral ba khrig byung /de nas me ri 'bar ba'i dur khod nas gsang bdag phyag na rdo rjes dbang ba'i ra zhing dam la btags te mtshan rdo spre rnal 'byor ma zhes gso wa// de'i rjes sudur khod chen ngo gas nga 'u nga zhes pa de nas slo ba dasto pad mas rla ra yang dam la btags shing ma mo 'di'i rgyud cha tshang gsu ngas/ phyis su bod du byon ska bas 'di'i chos rlo ra bas ma yas su gter du sba sa par grags/ya nga lo rgyus gzhan zhig ni/ spo na rgya gar lto phyogs kyi gshin rje grong khyer zhes pa na/ gshin rje legs pa'i rgyal po dang / bdud po kha la me 'bar ma gnyis la sras gcig dang / sras mo gsum mdzed pa'i tha chung lha po 'di nyid yin cing / a ce gnyis las gcig klus 'phrog /gcig 31sa lhas 'phrog nas song / yu na ring pa song bar lha mo 'od 'bar mas ( lha sa /rang gi a ce gnyis lha klu'i lag nas 'phrog par 'dod de yab kyi phyag nas zod dbyug dang zhags pa/ yum gyi lag nas nad kyil dang khram shing blangs te lha klu gnyis la 'thab te a ce gnyis 'phrog nas yul lung der dbang bsgur zhing bzhugs pa dpal he ru gas spun mched rnams dam la btags te ༷thog snying bzhes pa de nas bzung bstan pa'i srung ma gtso sar gyur/yang lo rgyus gzhan zhig ni/ sngoni gling 'di'i byang shar mtshams na dpag bsam gyi ljon shing zhig mthod pa lha rnams kyis bdag tu bzung nas mthod pa 14

dang rī lja na lha mo /la/ skabs shig lha ma yin rnams nas ma(ngas su sbyad pas lha dang lha ma yin dbar dmag 'khrug byung ste/ lha ma yin rnams khros te glang bo che mabo sum cu so gsum mde pa'i dbus su lha ma yin gyi rgyal po thags bzang zhoni/ mgo snalhag ma sum cu serme gnyis la ga'edi sbyin sum cu se gnyis zheni/ mtha' 'khor du lha ma yin gyi dpag dung phyur gyis ba〉 thor nas mtshon cha drag char bzhin du phab/de nas lha rnams kyis 'thab rgyu'i gros mdzad ska bas sula'ang khong khrom byung snabs khro bo lam ka nag po zhes pas thabs shig dran te/ kho'i kha chu jing bu zhig tu sprul nas lha rnams kyis kha chu de 'thung bas/ shin tu khros par gyur te rgo mtshon sna chogs thogs/ glang chen mgo sum cu can gyi dbus su lha'i dbang po brgya byin zhon/ mabe lhag ma rnams la nye dbang serdzo gnyis ḍūrsha/ mtha' 'khor du 3 dmag dung phyur bcas byung sde/ lha dang lha min 'thab pas lha ma yin rmas pa'i khrag 'azor ba las lha ma yi na bo mchon thogs pa chig khri tsam je mang du gyur cing / lha mis pa'i khrag 'byor na je mang du ma song bar lha rnams spro/ci//de nas phyag na rdo rjes lha ma yin las rgyal ba'i ched thugs ka nas 'ode zer gcig spros te khyab 'jug gi dpral ba'i dkyil du thim pa las lcags kyi mdzer ba zhig byung ba de bzhol ba'i nang nas bud med sngo ni mo mtshan dang dpe byad shin tu legs pa zhig byung ba'i mtshan la lha 〈sna u ma de wa zhes btags/de nas lha chen dbang phyug de nyid dge slong gi cha byad mdzad nas dur khrod cig tu 'di skabasalha rnams nas lha mo u ma de wa dbang phyug gi chung mar phul /sras ming sring gnyis skye sa pa'i ming po'i ming la gshin je ma hā ka la dang /sring mo'i ming la lha mo dpar mo tsan tre zhes grags/ de nas phyag na rdo rjes ming 15

dang rī 3 na lha ra sring 'di gnyis g.yul las rgyal ba'i dbang bskur nas lha dang lha min 'thab pas sngar bzhin lha ma yin gyidapag rmas pa'i khrag 'byor na je mang du 'gretho bzhin pa lha sa tsan tres lha ma yin he ran ke shu'i mabo bcad de khrag 'thung bas/dmag gi 'phel kha chad nas ga5/la las rgyal/ sngar gyi dpag bsam gyi ljoni shing de lha rnams la dbang zhing rnam par rgyal ba'i khang bzang bzhengs pa de nas bzung lha sa 'di'i mtshan la dung mkhar rdzong mar grags/de nas lha mo dung ma khar jo nga mas sngar gyi sdig pa la 'byedi nas ri khrod mdangs dga' zhes par ljoni shing gi 'otho ma rgyad nas mtho bdun la 'phags pa mi pham pa'i gzungs bzlas te bzhugasapa4lha yopaṇa stob ri mkhom rbursha pa zhegazer /de nas tshe 'phos te yul lang ka pu ri ṇa zhes pa na/ srin po dngha sha lha ba dang / srin sa ṇa ba rtse bya ba gnyis 'di pa phas bu skye ba'i smoni lam btab cing / mas bu sa skye ba'i smod lam btab pas/ mos sgon lam ltar byung ste/ bu sa mdzes sdug yid du 'ong ba zhig skyes pa pha khros nas thal dong du gaspru/gas/ mas gsang nas galta ra te/ mtshan thal mde ga par grags pa phyis su phyag na rdo rjes sangagargyasakyibarnya na pa'i srung mar bskogan mthubatsan par gzigagate lha sa nag mo re ma dri zhes bya bar gyur cig ces smon lam btab pa de nas bzung nag sa re ma sta zhes par grags/de nas skabs shig srin po ngu sha lha bas nga lcebs rgyu yin zer bas/chung ma ṇa ba rtses khyed la gang 'de da pa nga la 31da/ da lan ma lcebs zhus pas/srin pos/ nga lha sa dung skyethong par sems chags pas de thob na mi lcebs zer/chung mas/ de las sla/ nga'i bu sa thal mdog ma lha sa dung skyo nga pa'i gamatsheg mor btang ste/ thabs kyis bslus chog zer nas thal mdog ma lha sa dung ྅thong 16

dang na ri na lha ོ pa'i gamathog sar brdzangs/lha sa dung skyethong mas/ thal mdog ma khyed sangs rgyas dang las smed 'brel bas/ nga las khyad du 'phags pa yin/ da nas bzung ngas khyed kyi gasku'og byed/ thugs brtse bas skyethong bar zhu zhus pas lha sa 'di yang thugs shin tu mnyes nas de ltar byed par khas blangs/de nas srin po'i grong khyer lang ka pu ri ṇar spre'u rgyal po kta len dang /mgrin bzang gnyis rgyal sa brtsad nas 'khrug rtsodi byas pa lha mo thodung skyetsheng ma ltad mtho la 'gretho skabs thal mdog mas/ de ring khyed kyi 'khris su bsgru mkhan mthong bas su la'ang ma lta zhig ces mngags/lha mo dung spyong ma song ba'i shul du thal mdog mas/ yab srin po dzña sha sgyu bar sbran pas/ srin ngetho gzhes nu gzugs byad legs pa zhig tu spral nas dung skyong mar lcags sgrog brgyab te khrid skabs/ dung skyong mas lca|sa rdzog bkrol te rang gi rkang pa'i rgyan cha byas/ de nas lha mo thal mdog ma mthong ste/khyed kyis nga'i tshig la nyan nam zhus pas/ dung skyetsheng ma khros te khyed kyis nga bsgru dbo sa doni gang yin nam zer bas/ khyede srin po'i chung par 'gro 'am zer bas/ dung skyong ma bya thabs zad pa dang / sngar ji gsung bsgrab rgyu'i khas blangs zin pas rang dbang med par srin po'i chung mar 'gro dargos༄ byung /de nas dung skyong pa'i a ma u ma de wa thugs khros te/ nged rang gcig yo khrim du bzhag nas srin po'i chung mar sesnang ba srin po bzhin du mi sha za zhing mi khrag 'thung ba shin tu mi sdug pa zhig tu skye ba dang / thal mdog mas kyang ngas bu mo bslus nas srin por sprad pa'i rnam smin gyis de bzhin du 'gyur bar 3tsheg ces dmode bcu gnyis btsugs/17

dang ci rī 3 na lha ra / yun ring ma song bar bu mor pa'i smon lam bzhin byung ste/ gzugs byad shin tu mi mdzes pa srin gzugs su gyur te/ phru gu lnga brgya tsam skyes dus pha srin nge thokta sha rghaṃ ba shi/ rgyal sa'ang 3snar nas srin po'i phag rdzi byed bzhin pa nyin zhig phag rdzi dim pu zer bas dbang med du 'khrig pa sbyad pas sbram mar gyur te/lha mo thal mdog pa'i skye ba gamathog mo shig 'di pa dang bsdebs narmi srin po'i zhon pa bong bu la zhon/ lag tu srin po'i ral gri bzung / rin po che'i rkyal ba sked par btags nas bros pa srin po'i dmag gis/ ded kyang 'ong bu margyages pas rjes ma zin/ mthor dur khrod gcig du slebs/ der skyes pa g.yul du shi ba'i ro gsar pa zhig sku'od pa sha de bsregs nas za bsams kyang me med snabs rgya mtsho'i 'gram na rdo semal gyi me ri 'bar ba mthong ste rdo semal la bsregs nas zas/de nas lha sa dpon g.yog gnyis rgya mtsho'i 'gram du song sde/gshin spre rlung gi 'khe ra mdze zhag bdun la ba:tshems nas tshe 'phos pa na sangs rgyas kyi zhal mthong zhing 'dod khams kyi dbang phyug ma zhig tu skye ba dang / nga'i gamadzeg sa 'di yang tshe rabs thams cad du nga'i 'khor 'bangs su skye bar shog ces rnyed lam btab/de nas dung skyong ma sngar gyi smon lam gyi mthus rgya mtsho'i 'gram gyi dur khrod rol pa'i tshal gyi gshin je mthu rtsal can gyi bu sar skyes/ khol sa re ma trī thal mdog ma'ang dri za'i grong khyer gser lding skyed mos tshal gyi rgyal po lde 'gong g.yag dang / yum dran pa dbang med gnyis kyi sras sar skye ba bzhes te/nar 63 skabs pha ma gnyis nas shin tu gces par skyorngo chabu mo'i skra nyag ma rer rin yo che'i rgyan cha sna chogs g.yogs te pho brang gi dbus su cad pa 'phrul gyi gzhal yas khang brtsigs/ de'i dkyil du thede pa 'phrul gyi lding khang zhes pa 18

dpa 'i ri na lha ra brtsigs pa'i nang mi re tho'abum gyis brtsigs pa'i khri la bzhag nas sus kyang ma mthe nga ba byas te che( bsngams/ mtha' 'khethor du rim pa gsum byas te nyug rum pa dang sa bdag rgyal sa sermegs srung byar bstothos/lha sa dung skyong mas dri za'i bu sar skyes pa'i re ma nī 'gug par 'dod nas gsang bdag gi sngags bye ba bco brgyad bzlos pa'i byin rlabs kyis dri za'i rgyal po 'khor dang bcas pa dran pa nyams/ bu sa re ma dīs sngoni gyi skye ba dran nas ngethos sku'ong skabs/ khrim bdag ra ba sbyin gsal zhes pa'i gasku(ga mtho ba ji bya ha mu zhes pa zhig mdzed pa dang 'phrad pa mo snabasad nas sha zas te pags pa sked par dkris nas phyin skabs/ lam bar du kha stedzem nas srin po bum sna zhes pa zhiba'i khrag gi rdzing bu zhig 'di pa 'thung bas kha rlangs gar phog shi nas rims nad bcas su med pa zhig byung /de nas btsan skya rdo je zla ba zhes pa'i sho mkhan zhig mthod pa dang 'phrad nas khyim thab byas te 'khrig pa spyad pa'i khyab thigs pa gcig 'khuthor ba'i shul nas corngo zhi skyes par grags/ nyin zhig khyo bo 3tho mkhan gyi 3tshe rde'u dkar nag 'khyer nas greng khyer sbrang ldan zhes par song ste/ rgyal po seng ge rtsal zhes pa der bsod rtsoms slong ba sbrang rtsi phor pa gang sprad de lag tu 'ardzog khar hub gang 'thung nas sprad skabs bar snang nas sgra zhig grags te bdud mo chen po/ rgyal po'i lhag 'phro 'thung ngam zhes byung skabs/ lha yi brda yin pa tshor nas re ma tī shin tu khros nas rgyal po'i yul du rims nad btang bas rgyal po'i dkong bdag zangs kyi dra ba can zhes pas rims nad bcad/nag sa re ma tī de nyid rgya mtsho'i 'gram gyi dur khrod chen po rol pa'i tshal na yod pa'i sngon gyi grogs sa dung skyong pa'i rtsar song sde/ se rma sa can yod 19

dang rī 3 na ྅ mo tshad bsad nas stongs par byed pa'i skabs su/ dung skyong ma'i zhon pa song bu de dre'u sngon mo rlung gi gshog pa can zhig tu sprul ba rgyu ma'i mthur dang zangs kyisna gtad nas khethol mtho nag mtho re ma dī la zhed par byin/ lha klu gnyan gsum thams cad bran du bko la nas sems can sku'od tshad kha zas byas te 'jig rten stongs la nye skabs/ lha sa dung skyo nga ma'i sngon gyi smon lam dang / dge ba spyad pa'i dbang gis byang chub shing gi drung du bcom ldan shākya thub pa bzhugs pa'i spyan sngar semang ste re ma tī dang / dung skye tsheng ma gnyis nas srelag snying phul te byang chub mtshermeg tu sems bskyed/de nas gnyis ka a su ra'i brag phug tu sethong ste bram ze maḥtsheg sred dang zhal mjal ba dung skyong mas bram ze la/ khyed kyis 'di na ci byed kyi yod sdus pas/ bram zes/ sngon 'dod khams 'di na dge slong bstan pa'i sde dang /dge 〈snang ma tā ri sde zhes pa gnyis 〈snam khrims nyams te rgyal ngo/sa chad pa bcad nas bsad/ de gnyis tshe 'phe sa nas bdud du skyes te sems can la gnodi cing 'tshe bas/ nged de gnyis 'dul ba'i ched yum e ka ḍi ral gcig ma sgrub kyin yod zer/ dung skyong mas/ 'o na nged gnyis kyis de 'dra sgrab thub drom zhus pas/ khyed gnyis la dngos grub gang dbo sa zer/ rngodi gnyis la khams 'di'i dbang mor gyur nas sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa'i srung ma'i mthu sgrab par 'dodi zhus pa ltar gnang ste bsgrabs pas yum e ka dza ṭi'i zhal mthong dro de nas bzung dung skyetsheng pa'i mtshan lasto dpal ldan lha mosna nag mo ma hā ka li zhes par grags/ khol mo re ma tī'i ming la yakṣa re ma tī zhes btags/ gnyis ka 'dodi khams kyi bdab 〈snar dbang bskur te bstan pa srung bar khas blangs/20

dang rī ji na lha sa de'i tshe sa'i lha mo bstan ma ji 'khor rnams 'bangs su byung ba dus de nas bzung sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa'i srung ma gtso sor gyur cing / khyad par du khethol 〈 snanag sa re ma tī 'di nyid da lha'i dpal ldan dmag byor rgyal mo 'di nyid yin/lha mo 'di'i lo rgyus gnad du dril na/ sangs rgyas 'khor ba 'jig gi sku dus su lha 〈sna 'ethod zer can ma zhes grags shing byang chub tu sems bskyed/sangs rgyas gser thub kyi brnya na pa'i skabs su lha motho dpal ldan ma zer zhing bstan pa'i srung ma mdzad/ sangs rgyas 'odi srung gi dus su lha mtho man dzu zhes grags/ de nas bcom ldan 'das dge :rdzong dbang phyug dpa' bo'i skye ba bzhes skabs lha mtho 'di'i mchodi pa phul nas bsnyen bkur mdzad/ baḥthom ldan 'das shākya thub pa'i sku dus sudabang bskur zhing bstan pa'i srung mar gnyer du gtad pa de nas bzung sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa'i srung ma gtso bor gyur cing / phyis su pha dam pa sangs rgyas kyis lha mo 'di'i chos sterdzor sod du gdan drangs nas 'chad spel mdzad pa rim bzhin sa dge bka' rnying grub mtha' ris med kyis bsten cing /lha ma tho'adi'i rgyud la bod kyi mkhas pa rim byed gyi 'grel ba rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum mdzad pa shin tu mang la zhe/ de lta bu'i srung ma 'di gzhung sa dga' ldan 11 (zang yitha/pas bstan ma zhes bris 'dug pa ma zad/ yig rnying rnams su 'bri tshul gcig gyur med pas brtag dbostos/12 paṇa chen blo bzang chos kyi nyi mas mdzad pa'i (7mdo khams dbang phyug dmag zor rgyal mo'i chos skor gyi dkar chag mkha' 'gro dgyes pa'i sgra dbyangs na/(gsung 'bum pod nga pa'i nang gsal ba'i dkar chag de'i 3tsheg ngos thong nas 46/ bar gsal)nang lha sa 21

dbal ji na lha mo / pho thobrang gi sru nga ma nag pethor / bzhugs pa 'di yin snarme/ /'di'i chos skedzer mi 'dra ba khag brgya lhag gi mtshan byang bris 'dug pa sa zhib cha der gzigs par zhu/13 sung ma dmar nag gnyis zhes/ pa 7be|nga sa sku phreng bcu bzhi pa mtshe ga gi bka' 〈snab nang /dpal ldan lha mo ni thams cad mkhyen pa dge 'dun grub pa'i skabs nas bzung thun mthong ma yin pa'i 'brel ba zhig mdzed pa red/ srung ma nag po brtsi yul de dpal ldan lha sa yin pa red/ srung ma dpar po ni/ spyir btang lcam sreng (bab rtse)la brtsi rgyu mthod pa red /yin na yang dga' ldan pho brang gi srung ma dpar nag gnyis rtsis skutsheng dus srung ma dpar po de gnas chung rdo rje dregs ldan red/ (7gong sa mchog gi (7chos skyong bsnyen phyogs kyi bka' 〈snab phyogs bsdebs na/chos rig lhan khang gi dpar ma'i 3snag ngos 144par ba/sa0/)

mabe|na ngetho zhal bzhi ba/marbeton rngo1 zhal bzhi ba/ṣasbas pa'i mabo na perdzo'am mabe na pe zhal bzhi pa 'di ni/ (7gsang 'dus rtsa rgyud na/dang / (7bde mchog gi bshad rgyud na/sogs las dngos su byung ba zhig yin la/ 'di'i mtho rgyus mdzengs grags ni/ bcom ldan 'das dpal 'khor lo spo ma pa'i thugs ka nas spro sa pa'i spru la ba dang / lha chen dbang phyug chen po'i bur skye ba bzhes te/ rim gyis/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa'i srung ma gtso bor bzhugs pa 'di yin cing / spyir na mgon po/ 'dir rnam 'gyur mi 'dra ba bram gzugs serdzogs bcu gsum skudad pa dang / yu/ma/ gang/nga ma thonag 〈sna/gtum mo ljang khu/ srin mo dmar sa/ ming ga li ma ser mo/ srog gi 'ordzo 1 mgon po 'di'i lo rgyus ni/ (7mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i rgyudan/ dang / (7nag po gcer bu ba'irgyud)/ (pabastan srung rgya mtsho'i rnam thar)/ (7spu gri klad gzer nag po dngos grub 'byung ba'i rgyud le'u bcu bdun pan/ (7bya sog brtsegs pa dam tshig bstan pa spyi'i rgyud le'u nyi shu rtsa gcig pa)/ (ye shes gsang ba'i rgyud kyi rgyal po le 'u nyer gcig pa )/ khodapal nag ngo chen po snyi nga rje khros pa'i rgyud le'u bcu drug pa)/(bzhi ṭwāṃ nga spas pa sro ga bzer spas pa'i rgyud re 'u bcu bdun nga )/ dpal nas po'i rgyud dur khrod nag po 'i le 'u bcu gsu ma man// mnga' bdag nyang ral gyis gter nas bzhes pa'i (7dpal ye shes kyi mgon po phyag bzhi pa'i sku lasung thubs las khros pa 'i rgyudan/ sethogs su gsal bas zhib cha rgyud de das tu bzilas par 'tshal/23

mabe|na ngetho zhal bzhi ba/1158 )gnang / de nas bzung dpal ldan sa skya rnams kyi srung ma gatshe perdzor bzhugs pa gur maskra na la mabo na po che ba dang / zhal bzhi ba la chung ba zhes zer zhing / rnying phyogs su chos rgyal gter bdag gling pa yab sras brgyud pa'i rnya na brgyud mtha' yas pa/ zhig mde kyang re re bzhin ma bris zhing / ri bo dga' ldan pa'i phye gas su thams cad mkhyen pa paṇa chen dge 'dun grub kyi skabs nas bzung rgyal rma chog sku phreng rim byed gyi sku'i srung ma gtso sor 'dzin pa rnam thar so sor gsal ba dang / 3 ga don rgyal mchog lnga pa'i (7rang rnam du ku la'i gos bzang na/nang / la la'i brdzod rigs kyis 'khrul ba'i zhal po'i thugs la/ matre na po zhal 'di bkra mi shis pa lda bur mngoni nas bkag cha che bar 'dug kyang / chos skye nga 'di la lhag par sas nga/ zhig byung bas rtse lugs kyi mngon rtogs spu na 'dren bskang bstod rnams tshang ba'i shog bu nyi shu yod pa der ma 'dus pa'i bstod tshig rigs semags lhan thabs 3thog bu bcu dhethor bcas pa stothog la 'dzin daskra sa byung bas/ myur sa ma thug rung zhag nyi shu tsam la gtsang par dril/ de'i skad cha gzim khang gong bdu gnya' ba sku skyes tshor bas/ 'phyong rgyas zhal dpon sbyin dpal la/ khong gis mgo na so zhal gyi bskang gse ma/5 gzim khang skra nga zhes pa ni/ sprul sku grags pa rgyal mtshan gyi bla brang yin par 7bosnang sa skyabs mdon chen po'i (7chos skyong bsten phyogs slor gyi bka' slob phyogs bsdebs na/nang / gzim khang bosnang zhes pa sprul sku grags pa rgyal mtshan bzhusas sa'i bla brang gnyis rkya dar rgyas chen po mthod pa dang / de 'dra'i rkyen byas nas gsham 'og las ka byed mkhan tsho'i nang du'ang phran bu mi mthun gyi gnas tshul tan tan sku'od tshosnad 'dul (glerdzos rig lhan khang gi dpar ma'i 3snag ngos 4 pa ra gsal/)ces gsungs/25

mabe|na po zhal bzhi ba/bzung bas lan lab pa zhal ngethos/ji gsan nas/ lha 'dre 'di 'tshub pa yin zer bas mi 'gab bsam pa shar rung / thugs 'dzin grub rjes dus gtor mdzod gsung ba ltar/ yar ngo mar po'i brgyad gtor kyang btang /khazhes byung ba'i brjodi babs 'di'i thog nas ska bas der mabo na po zhal bzhi ba 'di kha shas kyis bkra mi shis pa lta bu'i snyan phra byed bzhin yod pa gang ltar/7bo nga sa lnga pa chen po de nyid srung ma 'di la mos gus lhag par che bas sku'i srung ma gtso bor mdzad cing / kha shas kyis mgon po 'di ma gcig lab sgre da gyis gter gyi srung mar bsgom par bshad pa'ang 'di/ yang mgon po 'di'i snyan brgyud rnams dge lugs phye gas su mkhas grub thams cad mkhyen pa brgyud nas byung ba'i bshad sretrel 'di pa dper na/ dpal mang dkoni maḥthog rgyal mtshan gyis mdzad pa'i /tshebla brang bkra shis 'khyil gyi gdan rabs lha'i rnga chenan/ 05sa//zhal bzhi ba ni/ klu sgrab yab sras kyis na len drar chos skyong du bsten pas/ klu sgrab yab sras kyi swādzi ba 'dzin mkhan la rang shugs kyis srung skyob byed cing / tsu skya paṇa ṭi da (1182——1251)sogs na len dra'i rgyud 'dzin yin pas/ sa skyar bsten kyang / dus phyis su sa skya rbad pa zhig gi skabs/mkhas grub thams cad mkhyen pa (1385——1438)la rnye thobs 'phro ga dbang nge sa sku 6 zhal ngo 3 7skra nga sa lnga pa'i phyag mdzod sde ba bsermed nams rab brtan min nam snam/17 (7'phags pa 'jig rten dbang phyug gi 'khrungs rabasan/ deb phreng gnyis pa'i shog ngos 277 par gsal/26

mabo na po zhal bzhi ba/dngos su bstan nas/ khyod rgyud 'dzin dang bcas pa la srung skyebo byed pas nga la gtor ma thongs gsungs pas/ de phyin chad rje rin po che gdan sa thams cad kyis bsten datre sa par gsang mda' ba ཿtshes ldan rab 'byor dang / se ra snro gutsun pas mdzad pa'i (7mkhas grub rje'i rnam tharan/ las byung ba ltar yin zhes gsungs pa bzhin mgon po 'di nyid sangs rgyas kyibastan pa spyodang khyad par klu sgru ba yab sras kyi lta ba'i rgyun 'dzin la rang shugs gyis srung zhing skyo ba pa'i srung ma 17gsang 'dus rtsa rgyud na/sogs nas dngos su byung ba zhig 6sen tshes//18 /rtegadan rabs lha'i rnga cherno) kun su'u mi rigs dpe skrun khang gi lcags dpar ma'i shog ngos 233 par gsal/27

marbeston po phyag bzhi ba/mabe|na mtshe phyag bzhi ba/nemagon po phyag bzhi ba 'di'i lo rgyus ni:/ rgyal mchog bsod 19 mabo|na po phyag bzhi ba/ ma hā ka la khrag 'thung gi rgyal po/ dpal mabo na bya sol mtshan can/ sde dpon chen so lanod sbyi na bya sog bdong can bcas mabon po 'di nyid kyi ming yin par gsungs pas brtag daskradas/7 17las kyi mgon po bya sog gdong can gsod byed srog bzer nag po'i rgyud cithe'u bdu bdun pag)/ dpal mgon bya sog ming can gyi rgyud khrag mcho khol ma snying 'byin gsod byed spu gri sna bu'i rgyud)/ (bu ston chos 'byung )/ rje cong kha pa chen pos mdzad pa'i (7sbas don kun gsalan// (7dpal rdo rje nag po chen po gsang ba dngos grub 'byung ba'i rgyudag)/ (7me lce phreng ba'i rgyudan// 17legs ldan stag zhon gyi rgyud gsang ba 'khor lo nag tha)/ (7rdo spre gur gyi rgyud le'u bcu pa)/ rje drung bzhad pa'i rdo rjes mdzad pa'i 17bstan srung rgya mtsho'i rnam thoran// rgyal ba bsod nams rgya mchos mdzad pa'i 17mgon po phyag bzhi pa'i yo rgyusan// 'brug pa pa da ma dbar pos mdzad pa'i mgon mang gi rnam bshad rdo rje snying tshog/ bdag chen a skyes kyis mdzad pa'i (7sa skya'i gdung rabs rin chen ba'i mdzod)/ 'be bo lo tsā ba tshe dbang kun khyab kyis mdzad pa'i 17sgrub rgyud dmi dam tshang gi chos 'byung rab 'byams nor bu'i zla she la na/bcas sugasal ba rags bsdus shig bris pa yin pas zhib pa rgyud serme serdzor gzigs par zhu/28

mgon po phyag bzhi ba/nams rgya mtsho'i gsung ltar bris na/ sngoni dge slong sbyangs pa'i yod tan bcu gnyis dang ldan pa zhig gis dpal bde ma31ga sgrab bzhin pa mtshan zhig mnal lam du mi nag sto zhig skutsheng ste/ khyed rang 'ardor ma snod par byang phyogs ces ta'i yul du song dang / de na bde mchog gi spral ba ye shes kyi mgon po bde byed 'khor lo bya ba zhig mdzed pa des khyed la dngormi grub sder bar 'gyur zhes pa zhig rmis pa ltar/ dge :thong yul der phebs pa'i lam khar/ rgyal po dge ba'i dpal bya ba 'jig rten pa'i lha yi dam du byed pa zhig skusnad pa de dang 'phrad nas/ rgyal pos lha khang du khrid pas/ 'jig rten pa'i lha khang du song gshis/ dge slong gis phyag ma 'tshal snabs/ rgyal po khros te dge slong gi mig brus te gsod pa'i skabs/ dge slong thugs chad nas/ ngas tshe gas bsags pa dang / gsang sngags rā/ba pa/ dpal mabe|na la dmigs nas mtsheng ba'i bden pa'i byin rlabs kyis/ mi srid pa gsum na dbang che ba'i gnod sbyin bya sog can zhig tu skyes nas rgyal po 'khor bcas kyi mig 'bru bar gyur cig ces smed lam btab/de nas tshe 'phos te byang phyogs rgyal ba'i ༷thong khyer zhes pa der yab rnam sras dang / yum bya sog mig can gnyis la bu zhig skyes pa gtum drag che zhing 'jigs su rung ba zhig byung ste/ sngar gyi rgyal po'i mig brus/ snying phyungs nas zas/ 'khor rnams tshar bcad de/ sems can mthod tshad zas nas bzhugs bzhin pa'i skabs/ dpal bde mtshethog gis 'dul bas/gcetshed sbyin bya rethog mchu can na re/ batshetshem ldan 'das la bka' nyan ji 'dra zhig mthod dam zhes bka' 'dri zhus tshe/ nga la bka' nyan bya resnag mchu can zhig sku(da gsungs te/ mabo na po 'di la dbang bskur/ byin gyis brlabs nas bka' 29

mdon po phyag bzhi ba/srung du bskos/de nas slob dpon klu sgrub de nyid dpal na len dra'i mkhan po las cogs pa gnang bzhin pa'i skabs/ nyin zhig dge 'dun gzhan dag dang mnyam du me tshetsheg gi ldum ra zhig tu spretshe bsangs la phebs dus/ chu 'gram zhig na mu man gyi the sku rang byed zhig mde pa zhib tu gzigs pas/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis/gri gug dang zod khrag 'dzin pa/ bya khwa ta'i ma/skra can/ sku smad chu nang du mthod pa/ 〉tsheb dngo na 'khor bcas kyis gtor ma zhig phul nas/ khyod srung ma zhig yin par gda'/ phyi pa'i srung ma zhig yin na de gar snod/ nang pa'i srung ma zhig yin na/ na len dra'i gtsug lag khang du byed par zhu/ zhes zhus pas/ zhogs par gtsug lag khang gi 〈 sna rtsar bsre bas 'dug pa chos skye tsheng yin par rbeto nas/ dge 'dun rnams la gtethor ma 'char can ltar 'bul datredzes ba'i zhal bkod mdzad/skabs shig du ru sha'i dmag mardzong sde/ na khron dra'i dgon pa gtor/rdo sku de'i rdo stegs bshig gtor stod bcag pa'i shul du mi gtsang ba'i rdzas blugs nas song / de nub dkor gnyer gtor ma 'bul du mardzong dus/ gtor gzhong bcag yod pa pa'ong sne/ khyod 'dra ba'i chos skyong gis rang gi phor ba srung mi thub na/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa ji ltar bsrung zhes zhus pas/ rdo sku de ma dgyes par sngar snod sar song sne/ zhal yang du ru kha'i yul du bstan nas bzhu/kra/sa//de nas dge 'dun pa rnams kyis masku na sto dpang du btsugs te/ drag po'i gtor ma bskyal/ chos skra sa phud de sa la brdabs nas gsemal ba shugs drag tu btab pas/ du ru ma'i dmag rnams sa gamathos pa'i nang du brdibs te shi/30

mabe|na ngermo phyag bzhi ba/de nas slob dpon klu sgrab rdo sku'i drung du phebs nas na len drar byon pa'i gsol ba btab pas/ nga der snyu mthong / bsil ba tshal gyi dur khrod du 'gro dgos par mdzed/ khyed la srung ma dgos na/ nga'i dpon gcig rgya mtsho'i 'gram gyi lho phyogs na/ in dra ni la'i rdo sku rang byon zhig 'di pa de spyan drongs la srung ma mdzad par zhu zhus na gnang ba yin gsungs/de ltar slob dpon rgya mtsho'i 'gram du byon nas 'tshol bzhin pa'i skabs/nyin zhig bye thang zhig na sngar gyi lung bstan pa bzhin 'dug pa gcermer ma phul nas na len drar byed pa'i gserdzol ba btab pas/ da lan nga mi sku(nga / bde mchothog 'khor le'i bka' srung thams cad 'du sa/ bi kā ma shi la'i gtsug lag khang zhes pa der 'gro dgos/ mkhyed la srung ma byed dgele na 'di nas shar phyogs su song dang / chos bzang sprin gyi yang rdzong zhes pa zhig mdzed pa de na nga'i chos sgor rnams gter du sbas nas yod/ de bdon nas sgrub sbyong gyis/ nga'i 'bog tsan dan las ba4tshes pa khrig la rab gnas legs paXng bgyis la/ gtsug lag khang du 'dze ga dbeshas/ de la mtshede pa chag med phul dang bstan pa bsrung ba yin gsungs pa ltar/ na len drar phebs nas ji ltar bstan pa bzhin mdzad pas/chos skyetsheng gi zhal dngos su bstan nas grethogs mdzad/nam zhig na len dra'i dkrerdzon lag brgya rtsa brgyad gsar bzhengs grub sde/de dag la srung ma brgya rtsa brgyad dgos par brten/ slar yang slob dpon de nyid phyo phyogs mya ngan med pa'i gling du phebs nas/ chos bzang sprin gyi yang rdzong bya ba ji ra gyi lung bstan pa der bslobs dus/ brag 'dabs shig na/shel gyi mchod rten rang byon 'od 'phro ba zhig yod pa de'i nang / phyag na rdo rje'i rgyud sde rin yo che mang yo gter du sbas mtshed pa mkhyen nas gter bton skabs/31

mgon po phyag bzhi ba/ma kha' 'askutho ma rnams kyis bste dzer ba byed cing srung bzhin pas gter bdon ma thub/de nas : rdzob dpo ni gyis thabs shig dran te/ rang gi ཿthos tre sa spu na ras gzig / su spral nas las sna lha gas mdzad pas /0 mkha' 'a〈sna ma rnams ltad 〈 snal g.ye nga bablo skabs/ ye shes kyi mgod po/rte brgya rtsa brgyad kyi sgrab thabs gter nas bzhes te/ de dag la 'brel ba'i phyi sgri ba nang sgrab khagashe brgya dang brgyad brtsams nas dajo na pa de dag gi srung par gnyeji gtad shādzad cing dpal bde mtshe ga gi bka' lha da srung par ba2tshes par grags/de nas slo ba dpon klu sgrab kyi dngos slob slob dpon zhi ba lha (ar ya de wa )la mgon po 'di'i man ngargo dang chos skor mthongs rdzogs gnang / skabs 21 spyir na margon po la bdun cu rtsa lnga mthod par bshad pa de dag gi nang nas btso bo dang yongs grags lta bu ni/ mgon po phyag drug pa dang / zhal bzhi ba ma ning / mgon po gur/ phyag bzhi ba sogs yin cing / de yang mgon po phyag bzhi ba la klu sgru ba kyi lugs dang / zhi ba sbas pa'i lugs/ phag gru dang / bla ma zhang gi lugs sermegs sna chogs shig sku'od kyang / thams cad kyi gtso po 3 phyag bzhi pa yin par gsungs/mjosnan po zhal bzhi ba la rnam 'gyur mi 'dra ba bcu gsum mthod pa dang / yang bka' brgyud pa'i mgon po ber nag can sogs mgon po'i rigs mang / gnyan lo tsā ba dang /sa sbya pa rnams nas mabethon po zangs kyi gri can lha bcu gsum ma 'di masku na po zhal/ bzhi ba'i 'khor du gtogs par bshad/ yang grub thob 'dar phyu ba sermegs nas rta mgrin yang gsang gi bka' nyan yin par bshad pa sedzegs maskra na po'i chetsher la bshad tshul sna chogs 'dug kyang / zhib cha (9rin chen gter mdzod)yod ji pa'i nang gi mgon po'i chos rmo ra de dag la gzigs par zhu/32

mabe|na po phyag bzhi ba/shig rgya gar — —1gas sha ke ra'i bram ze gser mig pa'i bu dbang phyug la dad pa zhig mthod pa de/ nang pa'i paṇa ṭi da sus kyang rtsod pas mi thub par na len drar rtsod du yong dus/ mgon po 'dis slob dpon klu sgrab dpal gyi ri la bzhugs pa mi stegs pa bslebs pa'i lan bskyal/ rma che'i ma :tsheb dponi 'phags pyolhas brnya na pa dpang du btsugs nas/ rtsod pa'i skabs/ mgon po 'dis grogs mdzad nas pham par mdzad pa'i paṇa ṭi da de'i ming la rta dbyangs sam sku'ongs grags su rlo ba dngon dang/'a so zer zhing / rjes su slob par gyur pa der mgon yo 'di'i man ngag mthongs rdzogs gnang zhing / slo ba dpon 'dis ((mngon par 'byung ba'i rgyud le'u bcu ban/ la brten nas sgru ba thabs kyang brtsams/de'i drung nas slo ba dpon klu'i byang chub dang / des bing ya kirti la gnang /des de ba 0/ kā ra la gnang / des dus zhabs pa che chung gnyis la gnang /de gnyis kyi drung nas : rdzob dpon a bha ya gusta la gnang /des bod kyi mdze tsā ba rga lor gdams ngag mthongs rdzogs gnang / bla ma rga 'otsware drung nas gung thang bla ma zhang brtse na 'grus grags pas (1122——1193)gsan 'di'i drung nas grub thob gling ba rgya ras (1128——1188)'dis spo na shi la ra rna la gnang / des 'phags sde mdze tsā ba dge 'dun bkra shis la gnang / de nas rim par brgyud pa'i snyan brgyud rgyal mchog ma3 tan rgya mchos gsan pa dang / 3 ga don rgya mchog dge 'dun grub kyi 'i dus nas bzung mgon tho 'di dang thun sang gi 'brel ba zhig bung bar mngon rte/ dper na/(rgyal ba dge 'dun grub kyi rnam thar ngo mtshar rmad byeng nor bu'i phreng ban/ las dang po nga skye sa pa'i nub sa 'brog nga la dgra jag byung sde/ mas nga rdo gseb tu bzhag nas bros / sa nga ltar mthong bas / bya rog cig gis bya rog 33

mabo|na po phyag bzhi ba/gzhan dag dang gcan gzan 31gas kyis gatshesnad pa byed par bsrungs te/ bu tsha ma shi bar 'dug pa la/ yo sa zhig 'di pa na re/ wa/ skyo bas pa'i srung ma zhig yin na ni/ rā ba mi 'khyer thang / ma yang mi khrid thang / gnodi pa'i 'dre zhig yin na ni/ bu chung yang mi srung thang zer te bu chung khur phyin zer cing nga rang gi dran yul la'ang de 'dra zhig 'dug mgon yo 'dis phyis kyang de dus dran ngo dang / khyod lta bu'i bstan 'dzin la/ nga lta bu'i chos skyo nga bsne na dgos pa yin byedo/ zhes yang yang gsung gin sku(da pa gsungs te/ bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i rnam thar ro/ zhes gsal ba ltar/ paṇa chen dge 'dun grub kyi sku dus nas mabod po 'di dang thun mong gi dam chig 'brel ba'i mtho rgyus 'di pa de bzhin ri bo dge lugs par maskusnan po 'di dang / dam can chos rgyal gnyis srung pa'i gtso 'o yin/de lda bu'i chos skyong 'di lha sa'i rgyud smad grwa tshang gis mgon po 'di srung ma'i gtso bor mdzad cing / bskang gso shin 'khyongs ltar 'don pa dang /phyis su rgyud smad dang 'brel ba mde pa'i dgon pa tshang mar mgon chos lnga zhes 'don chog gi btso bor mdzad bzhin pa 'di bzhin no/ / 7 (7'phags pa 'jig rten dbang phyug gi 'khrungs rabasan/ deb phreng dang po'i rtsol ngos 214 bar gsal/34

nga shā sna smya ༄༄gye/ snyokṣi /tshetshe /yo mitswa shā rnyo4 〉thre rmyi/shlau yuli // rjorjo phro sa1rdoste/de tho /chos di gyisnga 5 5 7 780// klo/sdi/ldibagyirsā/sa ca'i // gyi 4 ༷ga ci'-i gi /au tshe/ ༷ cho47ma dzha phye rdzordo ༷rnyi ༷cu 5) ༄sdug6 tyā / lo48)mi sdu ༷ nyumā/ rmirasprirsha nari shāsmyu/shlau /sgrornya/ ṇḍaṃ —tshos phro kari snyes ༷dhadma sal0 lo64 4slo nga 458 4tswaspyo nga dra nga ri(sgo: mazi/0 stu sti rte gzhwa dhe po tsā — — —

dam can cho sargyal/dam can tshesnas rgyal/ neshar tsong kha pa blo bzang grags pa'i dpal gyis gtsos pa'i ri bo dge lugs pa'i srung ma gtso bo dam can chos kyi rgyal po 'di nyid kyi 'etho rgyus ni/sngo1 bdag cag ga stoni pa bcom ldan 'das de nyid rdo rje gdan du zhul bzhugs nas byang chub maḥthog tu sems bskyed pa'i skabs su/ bdud kyi dmag bye ba sum cu so drug mthong ba dag ga gnyen por gshin rje gshed kyidakyil 'khor gyisku'i ngo bor bzhengs te/ bdud dpung thams cad tshar bcad nas byang chub kyi lam la 'atre da par mdzad cing / rgyud gsungs nas gdams pa 81ngas rdzogs dpal phyag na rdo rje la gtad/ khyod kyis rgyud 'di bzung nas ma 'ongs pa na nga'i bstan pa la bar du gatshe da pa thams cad bsrung dbesnas pa yin/ zhes gsungs nas thugs rje chen po longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku'i ngo bor bzhengs te/ khro po po dam can chos rgyal gyi lo rgyus ni/ jo nang tā ra ṇa thas mdzad pa'i 17'jigs byed chos 'byung na/dang / mkhas grub dge legs dpal bzang gas mdzad pa'i 17rgyud sde snyi'i rnam gzhagan// pha sang kha dpal 'byor lhan grub gyi 17gsung 'bum thor bun// spe lung bzhad pa'i rdo rjes mdzad pa'i (bstan srung rgya mtsho'i rnam thar) brag sgo rab 'byams pas mdzad pa'i (7je tsong kha pa'i rnam thar chen tshog bcas su gsal ba snying bsdus shig bris pa yin/ phyogs skye nga bcu'i nang gsem kyi gnyen rje dang / sde dpon sum cu'i nang tshan 'chi bdagazub pa rigs drug ga nang tshan chos rgyal thams cad dam can chos rgyal dang ngo ngo gcig par gsungs pas brtag dathothos/35

dam can ཿthosargyal/gshin rje gshed kyi rten dang brten pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs spral nas rgyud gsungs/ gshin rje gshed kyi spral ba'i dmag tshogs rnams gabye'i bya so so'i khams dang ma sa par mthun patsā las rnam pa sna tshogs su spral nas nga'i bka' las 'da' na de dag gi matre lus thams cad 'gas par 'aX'ir dzed /zhes gsungs nagaphyag skra/pe cani gyis rgya mtsho dkrugs pas rlung gi dkyil 'khor byung ste/ sa gzhi thams cad gamatho bzhin pa'i skabs/ rdo rje 'jigs byed kyis gshin rje so mo'i srog gi snying lta bsdus nas/ slar yang srog snying phul nas ji ltar bka' bache(sa pa rnams bsgrab rgyu'i mna' tshig nge ra nas dam/ la btags/dam can cho sengargyal 'ardo phyi ma he'i gare nga can yum tsa min tri dang bcas pa/ gshin spre pho brgyad sa brgyad kyis bste ra ba/ nang sgrab gnyis pa/gsang ba ma he'i gdong can gtso rkyang du sgrub pa dang / srin po zlong ka mgrin bcu dang / klu bdud nag po/ khyab 'ju| bcas bka' snod gsu ma gyis ba〉thor ba'i gshin rje gshed po 'di nyid skyo 'u gas la bcom ldan de nyid 'jam dpal shin tu khros pa'i 'jigs byed chen po'i skur spral te/ 'dzam bu gling gi sto phyogs rim pa bdun gyi sa 'og na/ gshin rjes grong khyer chen yo ma tho / pa der byon nas/lcags mkhar lhatho med bcu drug po thams cad zhabs bcu drug gis mnan te/drag 'dul mdzad pas/ gshin spre gtso 'khori rnams nas rang rang gi srog snying phul nas dam la btags te/ ji srid bskal pa ma stongs bar de srid du sangs rgyas kyi bsnan pa bsrung bar khas blangs/ 'jam dpal gshin rje gshed kyi 'phrin las thams cad tshul bzhin sgrab pa'i dam bcas par bshad pa dang /yang 17gtsug tor rnam rgyal gyi rtogatsu pan/ las/ ston pa rang gi spyan sngar bstan pa bsrung par khas blangs pa mthogs bshad 〈snal sna mo gas shig 'dug pa 36
sa par 'tshal

rgyal po rnam 1thos sras/rgyal rngotho rnam ༄thos sras/—rgyal po rnam cos sras kyi lo rgyus ni/stso sngon yab drang srong rnam mang cos dang / yum lha mo u ma de wa (bodi skad du dpal btsun bzang sa yin par bshad/ )gnyis la sras gcig 'khrungs pa'i mtshan la rnam 11sa sras zhes btags/ nar sersha skabs klu dga' po'i sras po chung par blangs pa de'i rdzongs 5nor bu bsam 'phel phul ba de'i stobs kyis mnga' thang 'byor ba zad mi shes pa byung ste/ sngar 'jig rten du byung ma myong ba'i pho brang dang grong khyer gsar rgyag tshi (7gnod sbyin dbyug pa can gyi rgyudan/(rin chen gter mdzod pod ji pa'i nang gsal/)kyi nang srid sgrub dang / rgyal po rin chen mang / lus ngan po/ ngal sos po dzam bha la/ gshin rje rgyal po/ ma ru rtse/ rdo je che sogs don gcig ming gi rnam grangs lta bur gsungs 'dug pas brtag daskra sa/7 rnam thos sras kyilorgyus 'di nyid bu ston rin chen grub kyis mdzad pa'i(7rnam sras bsdod pan/ ( gsung 'bum brgyad pa'i nang gsem/ ) rje drung dge 'dun bkra shis kyis mdzad pa'i (7rnam sras kyi lo rgyusan/ (7rgyal po chen po rnam chos sras kyi rgyud rab tu grub pa zhes bya ba) ('dul ba lung ) ('dus pa rin po che'i tog) 9rin chen gter mdzod pod sta pa'i nang gsal/ ) rin chen rgyal mtshan gyis mdzad pa'i (7rnam sras kyi lo rgyusag/ (7rgyal po rnam thos sras kyi rgyud yon tan rin chen 'byung gnasag) bcas su gsal ba rags bsdus su bris pa yin/38

snasgorsā /( llīny-i//1 nga//// rji —— rte.auṣṭha wa/ ga rdo sdosnyormyu nga /47 / /tod sa/ 4tshi ḍarsātsha/rmyo༄9/ tstsha tsho 9 nyusko 4 lam/ tshakhri snyirnya nā be lo/snye na/// /chol ni ༷ngargyu ce sgro ri zhirngo na༄zhi ma yo gyi blos tshozhing/ci 7 ༷zhengazeshi dngo 471rdzi // na ñdzardo479wa 4 7 pho spyo/lhote 6 7phyo / /sgyu cho sa da ri(〈sgrodzosko sko ༅tsho (7/ ldi/ 49 khyilha/po〉 ༄ byu ri bawalho'i4 4 9 44)ri ga)4 2 bsle bsnye ༄ngas gre 4 406 44 4 ticho phrogs ngaslong zhu rsā tsho tshesab cher ma ———pa skos zi kṣa mimo:rdzu rdza 49patho — tsho blo 'i khurwa jo na.ekhri/:rdzi

rgyal pe thornam khro sa sras/byas pa'i dbus su mcho chen po gnyis bskyil nasagaser gyizam pa re re btsugs/byang sgra mi snyan dang / shar lus 'phags gling / lha 'dzam bu gling gi phyed tsam dbang du bsdu ba zhig byung zhing / sna ra bu bsam 'phel ② brten nas sems can dbul phe ngas kyis mnar ba rnams la skyabs sbyin mdzad nas sdug bsngal las bskyabs par grags/79rnam thogasras kyirgyud le'u bcu dgu'i ga) gling gzhi'i skabs su byung ba'i lo rgyus ni/ sngoni bcom ldan 'das de nyid rin chen sna bdun gyis grub pa'i gzhal yas khang du phyag rdor 'gyings pa zhes pa'i ting nge 'dzin la bzhugs skabs/ 'kho ra gyi nang nas rgyal po rnam 1snas sras snan las bzhengs te 'di ltar zhus//kye ma batshe ma ldan 'das lags/ bdag gis mi dbul po dang / lha dbul po rnams la phan gdags par 'dod pas de ltar gnang ba stsal du gsemal zhus pas/ bcom ldan 'das kyis nor bu mdzod kyi phyag rgya dang bcas te de bzhin du 'grub pa'i thugs smoni dang dbang bskur nas mtshan byang chub sems dpa' rin chen mang zhes btags/ skabs der sa 'og dang sa steng du gnodi sbyin bye ba drug 'bum sku'id pa de ma thag rnam the sa sras kyi 'khoter du khas blangs/de bzhin klu chen brgyad dang / rgyu skar nyer brgyad/ gnod sbyin chen po brgyad yodi pa de dag thams cad kyang rnam sras kyi 'khor du khas blangs/ gnodi sbyin 'khor dang bcas pa gter gyi bdag pore dbang bskur zhing byin gyis brlabasapar bshad/yang bsede namasarin chen gyis mdzad pa'i (7rnam sras kyi le rgyus na/las byung ba ni/ sngon chad drang srong gang po zer ba zhig yodi pa des gnod 39

rgyal po rnam thos sras/sbyin mdzes ma zhig khyim thab tu bsus pa sras be shra ma ṇa bya ba zhig skyes/ de nas sras de nyid gnod sbyin rnams kyi rgyal por dbang bskur nas pho brang lcang lo can du bzhugs skabs/ nam zhig lha ma yin dang lha gnyis 'khrug rtse da byung bas/ be shra ma ṇa lus besnangs shin tu che ba zhig tu spral nas ri rab kyi rtse mthor bo ma pa bzhag pas lha ma yin rnams nas gzi brdzid dmo bzod par bros/ lha rnams ngal sethos par gyur te mtshan la ngal sems par grags/ phyis su bcom ldan 'das kyi spu na sngar byang chub mtshe ga tu sems bskyed nas bstan srung du dam bcas par gsungs/yang (7rgyal po chen po rnam thos sras kyirgyud las sna tshogs rab tu grub pan/ zhes pa las byung ba'i lo rgyus ni/ sngoni bskal pa dang po'i skabs su 'od zer rnam par rgyal ba zhes pa'i 'jig rten du sangs rgyas nyi ma'i snying po bkod pa'i zhal zhes pa'i sku dus su rnam sras 'di la byang chub sems dpa' rin chen mang zhes zer zhing / de nas bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pa sangs rgyas nas ring po ma 'otshen pa na/ byang chub sems dpa' rin chen mang gi skye ba bcom ldan 'das kyi spya na snga ra ma thong ste/ bdag gis sems can sangs rgyas zin pa dang /ma rgyama'ipa rnams la phan gdags par 'dodi pas ji ltar byas na phan 1tshegs par 'gyur zhes gsermel ba btab pas/ bce ma ldan 'das kyi zhal nas/ khyed kyis sems can gyi doni byed na/ gling 'di'i byang phyogs na rgyal po rnam mang cos bya ba dang / lha sa dpal btsun bzang mo zer ba gnyis yod pa de la mnga' thang 'jig rten 'di na 'gran zla dang bral ba zhig 'di pa de gnyis la sras med pas myangan gyis gdungs pa de gnyis kyi sras su smon lam cobs la sems can 'i phan themags par gyis/ zhes bka' bstsal/40

rgyal po rnam thos sras/de nas byang chub sems dpa' rin chen mang gis ji ltar bka' bstsal ba bzhin du smed lam btab/ nub gcig lha retho dpal btsun bzang mo'i rmi lam du/byis pa gzhon nu yid du 'ong ba zhig mo'i rum du mdzeng ba zhig rmis/ nang par rirgyal ngetho la gnas tshul de zhib par zhus pas/ rgyal ngethos bram ze rig sngags la mkhas pa zhig la dris pas/ bram zes/ byang chub sem sa dpa 'a se ma/sa can gyi don byed nga/ zhig 'khrungs pa'i ltos yin par gsungs/ de nas rgyal po/ ha cang dga' ste/ btsun mo'i lus 〈 snas chus bkrus te gtsang sbra byas/ rmi lam ltar btsun 〈/snar bu zhig 'khrungs pa mtshan rnam ༄thos sras zhes btags/nyin zhig sras de me tog ldum rwa'i nang du spro bsangs la song ska bas/bu mo ma dzes sdu ga yid du 'ong ba zhig dang 'phrad/ rnam cos sras de la yid chags te/ khyed nga'i khrim thab e byed sdus pa sa/ bu mos de ltar khas blangs/ldum rwa'i nang 'khrig pa spu da cing bsdi da/ zhogs pa nam langs ska bas bu mdze de sbra la dkar po zhig tu gyur te rgya mtsho'i nang song /ba de nas zhag bdun 'od ṅka bas mi ra yang snga ra gyi bu sa de mthong nas snga ra lam bzhin 'dus pas/ nyin zhig bu po na re/ nga ni klu'i rgyal po 'i bu mo yin/nga la ming po gsum yod zer bas/ rnam thos sras kyis klu'i rgyal ngo/ra bu mo bsla ngas te/ bag mar skurmeng skabs bu mo'i rdzongs su nor bu rin po che rigs brgyad phul ba gling 'di'i phyogs mtshams rnams su gter du sba sa nas se mas can gyi 'gro don ma dzad pa'i lo rgyus mang po mtshed nga/ dang / 3 ga don rnam sras byung tshul/ rlo ra la bshad tshul mi 'dra ba shin tu mang bas zhib cha rgyud serdzo semar gzigs 41

rgyal po rnam 1snas sras/zhib gnang gal che/neyang (7rgyal po chen po rnam cos sras kyirgyud yod tan rin po che'i 'byung gnasan/ zhes pa'i dpe rnying zhig lag son byung ba'i nang / sngon drang srong gang po zhes pa zhig la bu yod tan can rnam mang cos bya ba zhig 'di/ rnam mang cos la bu be shra wa ṇa zer ba zhig skyes/ bu de gnod sbyin gyi rgyal por dbang bskur nas lcang mtho can gyi pho brang du rgyal po byas/nam zhig lha dang lha ma yin gnyis 'thab pas/ rnam mang the sa de lus songs shin tu che ba ri rab dang mnyam pa zhig tu spral nas g.yul bzlog pas lha ma yin rnams pham ste/ lha rnams rgyal nas nga'abye serdzos par gyur pas mtshan la'ang ngal serdzos ngo ra grags/ yang skabs shig lha dang lha min gnyis 'thab pas/ rnam mang the sa seng ge la rtseṭan nas lha'i gnas bsrungs pas gnas srung pe ra grags/ yang skabs shig lha ma yin gyi dbang pe rab rbede kyi dpag mthong skabs/ sbyal shin tu 'jigs su rung ba zhig tu sgral nas g.yul bzlog pas/lha ma yin rnarmis nas/ ྅sa ngan po 'dis pham ༄par byas song / zhes zer bas lus ngan por grags/7 (7gar mkhan gyi rgyu2) nang rnam sras rang gi sku be ḍū ya'i sku mdog 'dra bas lha ma yin 'dul bas lus ngan por grags gsungs pa las sbrul du sprul ba'i 'o(rgyus mi 'dug pas brtag dbo sa/ 27 (9rgyal po rnam thos sras kyi rgyud yon tan rin po che'i 'byung gnas ) nang / klu'i rgyal po dga' po'i ming la klu rgyal khri gtsug brtan pa dang / rgyal po rnam thos sras kyi mtshan 42

rgyal po rnam 1thos sras/gang ltar spres su rnam sras 'di'i gdams pa'i snyan brgyud bod du ji ltar dar ba'i mdze rgyus ni/ thog par bcom ldan 'dam kyis dpal phyag na rdo rjer rgyud 'di'i gdams pa yongs su rdzogs pa gnang zhing / phya ga na rdo rjes spyod mdzad chos kyi rdo je la rgyud cha tshang gtad/ de nas rim par brgyud de kha che dgon pa ba chen pethos gsan/ de las zangs dkar mtho tsā bas rgyud cha tshang gsan nas 'chad spel mdzad/ zangs dkar lo tsā ba'i drung nas gamathor bo skur stoni gyis gdams pa cha tshang zhus/ gamathor bo 'i drung nas bla ma bsedi nams rin chen gyis paṇa ḍal phul nas rgyud sku dngas rdzogs gsan/ 'di'i drung nas mchims phu ba bkra shis kyis gsan/ des brtag pa jo bzang / lha rje jo bzang yang zer)la gnang / de'i drung nas pad ma bkra shis kyis gsan/ des khro phu 'otho tsā ba byams pa'i dpal la gnang / de'i drung nas dngo na po bse da nams dbang phyug gis rgyud mthongs rdzogs gsan/ des dpon po bla chen bsod nams seng ge ( mkhan chen bsermed nams seng ge min nam snyam/ ) 'di'i drung nas bu la rnam zos dang / yum dpal btsun bzang mo'i ming la lag bzang ser rta ma zhes gsung 'dug pas zhib cha rgyud der gzigs par zhu/ yang rgyud kha shas las rnam sras la bu gnyis mdzed pa gcig dzam bha la dang / mthog ma med gnyis yin par bshad pa dang / yang rgyud kha cig las rnam sras la sras dgu bcu skras gcig sku'od par gsungs pas brtag dbo sa/ rnam sras 'di kha shas kyi byang chub sems dpa' rin chen mang gi spral ba yin par ba'od/ kha shas kyis byang chub sems dpa' sa brgyad pa dang / kha sdug gis (7'dul ba lung na/las byung ba'i rgyal po glebazhi'i ngo bo gcig tu dril ba bcas bzhud tshul sna choganu/ mthod pas zhib cha rgyud sem semar gzigs 'ib gnang dargos/43

rgyal po rnam cos sras/stoni rin po ches rgyud mngos rdzogs gsan bzhes mdzad nas (7rnam sras kyi sgrab thabs na/sogs chos slong mang po ljags rtsom gnang / bu ston rin po zlos rang gi dngos slob 'etshe tsā ba rin chen rnam rgyal la dbang lung rgyud gsum chi tshang gnang / 'di'i drung nas mkhan chen grags pa rgyal mtshan /)sa gsan/'dis rang gi slob ma mkhan chen ye shes rgya mtshor gnang / 'di'i drung nas spre btsun grags pa bsam 'grub kyis gsan/ de nas rim bzhin 'phags sde sku( tsā ba dge 'dun bkra shis dang / khyung po lhas pa/ rje tsong kha pa blo bzang grags pa/ paṇa chen :tshe bzang ཿthos kyi rgyal mtshan/ mkhas btsun skyiskyon tan rgya mtshe /gser ldidam pa 'od zer bzang yo sogs ris med skyes chen dam pa mang po'i snyan brgyudane dar khyab chen po byung ba yin/'brel sku(da yig cha khag las gsal ba ltar na/ rnam sras 'di'i chos skor bod du le'u tshan khag brgya dang dgu bsgrar yod par bshad pa de dag gi nang nas yongs grags lta bu ni/ ste(rtsa rgyud rdo rje sa 'ogan/ dang /(7bshad rgyud 'byung po 'dul byedan// (7gnod sbyin gar mkhan mchog gi rgyud)/ (sna tshogs grub pa)/ (yid bzhin nor bu'i rgyud) sogs mdi pa 'di dag la bodi kyi mkhas pa rnams nas mdzad pa'i 'grel ba rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum ha cang mang yang 'dir skabs doni ma yin pas ma bris shing / de yang dpal mang sku phreng gnyis pa daskasnan maḥtsheg rgyal mtshan (1764——1853)gyis 7 snyan brgyud 'di dag byung tshul la skyor sa lung pa'i brgyud pa dang / yang mar ston tshul khrims kyi snyan brgyud/ 'jam dbyangs rin chen rgyal mtshan nas brgyud pa mthogs bshad srol mi 'dra ba mang yang / 'dir mthongs grags kyi dbang du byas pa yin/

rgyal po rnam 1thos sras/mdzad pa'i (7bla brang bkra shis 'khyil gyi gdan rabs lha'i rnga chenan/ las/rnam sra sa ni lhag pa tshul khrims kyi bslab pa'i srung ma dang / mde thomang po dang rgyud mang ngethor rgyal chen bzhi la bstan pa gtad pa dang / rgyun zhugs pa/ sa brgyad pa thob pa dang / mi slob paldi zung 'jug cob par bshad pa sogs kyi lo rgyus shin tu mang ba ltar gnad che'odi/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar yin no/ /7 kan su'u mi rigs dpe skrun khang gi dpar pa'i shog ngos 234 par gsal/45

rgalachenasdebazhi/rgyal chen sde bzhi/dnghargyal chen sde bzhi ni/ sngoni 'dzam bu gling 'dir klu'i rgyal po dbugs dang / dbugs chen zhes pa gnyis dang / nam mkha' phreng sgra snyan dang sgra chung bya ba gnyis mde/ nam zhig klu rnams la nam mkha' lding nas thub tshod byas te klu'i 'khor rnams bran du bkol/ klu rgyal gnyis sa steng du bros te sangs rgyas 'odi srung gi drung du 0tsheng sne byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed/skabs shig nam mkha' lding gis klu rgyal gnyis la gasna da pa byas pa ga3de pas ma tshugs par brten/ sngoni chad yin na nga gnyis mthong bas bros 'gredze ba la/ da lan mi 'gre ba gang yin zer bas/ klu rgyal gnyis na re/nged gnyis sangs rgyas 'od srung la skyabs su song zin pas/ da khyed tsho'i gnod pas mi tshugs zer bas/ sangs rgyas 'odi srung zer ba de nged gnyis las kyang mthu rtsal che bar 'dug snyam nas klu rgyal gnyis dang mnyam du sangs rgyas 'od srung gi drung du song ste skyabs 'gro gsan pas/ dad pa skyes te khong rnams 7 rgyal chen sde ba'i ni/ rgyal po yul 'a'or srung dang / 'phags skyes po/ sbyan mi bzang / rnam thos sras bcas yin zhing / 'di dag si yo rgyus ni 17'dul ba lung na/ dang / rin chen rgyal mtshan gyis mdzad pa'i 17 rnam thos sras kyi lo rgyusan/ /17po la ta'i ldebs ris kyimatshan 'grel brnyan dpar ma na/ bcas las snying bsdus tsam btus te bkod pa yin/46

rgyal chen sde bzhi/shin tu mthun par gyur/ de nas bcom ldan 'das kyisku dus saklu rgyal dbugs ni rgyal po yul 'khethor srung dang / dbugs chen 'phags skyes po/ mkha' lding sgra snyan ni rgyal po spyan mi bzang / sgra chung ni rgyal po rnam cos sras su 'khrungs te rgyal bu gasnyad nu ded grub ༷/ma gyi lhums su zhugs pa nas mtha' ma sangs rma rgyas par rgyal po 'di dag gis srung zhing skyob par grags/de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis 'khor rnam pa bzhi la chos 'khor ba〈snar dus/ rgyal chen sde bzhis so so'i 'khor stong phrag mang po dang bcas bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar 81nga ste/ skyabs 'aXtshe gsan nas bstan pa srung bar dam bca' mdzad/ stoni pa'i zhal nas/ nga mya ngan las 'das pa'i 'e ga tu nga'i bstan pa la 'jig rkyen mang po mdzeng ba de dus khyed rnams nas bsrung dajo sa zhes zhal gdams mdzad pa'i srung ma khyad par can yin kyang / 'di dag gi ཿthos sketsher sod du ji ltar dar tshul ni rnam cos sras kyi skabs su bris zin pas bskyar rtanib ma byas//(7mngoni pa mdzod na/kyi le'u bcu gsum pa'i skabs su 'jig rten khams gling bzhi(gling bzhi ni/ shar lus 'phags gling / lho 'dzam bu gling /nub ba glang spyod/ byang sgra mi snyan bcas bzhi la zer/ )mthod pa'i dbus su ri rgyal lhun po bya ba/ ngos bzhi dang bang rim bzhi yod pa/ bang rim bzhi sto de'i shar phyogs na/ rgyal po chen po yul 'khor srung dang / lho phyogs su rgyal po 'phags skyes ngo// nub phyogs su rgyal po spyan mi bzang / byang phyogs su rgyal po rnam thos sras bcas rang rang gi 'khor dang bcas pa bstan pa'i srung ma mdzad bzhin par gsungs/47

rgyal chen sde bzhi/yang (7'dul ba lung na/ las byung ba'i lesna rgyus ni/ sngoni bcom ldan 'das kyis 'jam dpal rtsa rgyud gsung ba'i skabs su/ rgyal chen sde bzhi 'jam dpal rtsa rgyud kyidakyil 'khore du bcug sde dbang bskur nas gsang sngags kyi bsnan pa'i srung mar bskems par gsungs/phyis sapa tshab ma thotsā bas rgyal chen sde bzhi'i rgyud cha tshang bodi yig tu bskyur gnang mdzad pa de nas bzung bod du dar srol chen po byung nas lha khang dang gtsug lag khang thams cad kyi ldebs bris su rgyal chen bzhi 'bri sre la 'dug pa bce ma ldan 'das kyi sku dus nas bstan pa'i srung ma khyad par can zhig yin pa'i mtshoni byed yin pa nges shes thub pa yin no/ /

chobs bdag glang sna can/tshogs bdag glang sna can/5tshogs bdag 'di nyid kyi lo rgyus ni/ sngoni chad lha dbang phyug chen po dang lha yokhu/ma de waganyis la sras gnyis 'khrungs pa'i rgan pa de tshogs bdag dang / chung ba de gzhon nu gdong drug yin cing / tshogs bdag 'di mthu rtsal dang rdzun 'phrul shin tu che snabs lha'i dpag dponi du bstothos/ nam zhig lha ma yin dang 'thab pas lha ma yin gyi rgyal pe thags bzang g.yul rgyal te 3snags bdag gi ske bcad skabs/ dbang phyug gis thabs shig dran te sems can gyi mtho ༄de ma yal ba sbyar na sems par shes nas lam du glang chen gyi phru gu zhig ga mabosgo bcad nas sbyar ba slar yang sos te glang sna can zhes grags/de nas yab dbang phyug gis drag po'i rig sngags bslabs te rang la skyabs su 'dzin pa rnams la skyabs sbyin mdzad cing / the(la ba rnams tshar bcad nas bzhugs skabs spyan ras gzigs kyi'akho'adul ba'i dus la babs par mkhyen nas kho pho brang phyi rol gyi skyed tshal zhig tu rdzobasang la song ba'i shul du khorang gogazugs 'dra ba zhig tu spral nas pho brang du byoni skabs btsun mo'i 'khor rnams nas rol cha'i sdun bsu/ te pho brang du gdan drangs/de nasatshogs bdag pho brang du mthong dus dus 'khor rnams nas lha chen 32 chos rgyal gter bdag gling pa 'gyur med rdo rjes spu po'i mdung chu'i gtsug lag khang nas gdan drangs pa'i chogs bdag ga ma rgyus las gnad bsdus tsam bris yin/49
