brtan ma bcu gnyis/brtan ma bcu gnyis/ji brtan ma bcu gnyis ni/ (7thang yig na/serdzogs las gsal ba'i bod kyi yul lha shin tu rnying gras shig yin la/ 'di dag gi 'itshe rgyus ni/ snye da sgrobo dponi rin po che rgya gar dang bal po'i sa mtshams a su ri'i brag phug tu lha 'dre rnams dam la btags te bzhugs skabs/ bodi du gnas pa'i brtan ma bcu gnyis rnams srog snying 'bul du mdzeng dus slo ba dpon gyi zhal nas/ khyed lha 'dre rnams kyis las ci byas/ 〈tsheg snying gang yin gsungs pas/ brtan ma rnams na re/ nged cag gi las ni bodi kyi se mamatshams bsrung ba de yin/srog snying ni so sor yod pas slob da' la 'bul zer bas/ slob daphro 33 (7thang yig na/dang / (7lha 'dre'i bka' thang )/ rgyal mchog lnga pas mdzad pa'i (7brtan mdos dpyid kyi rgyal mo'i glu dbyangasan// 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse dbang po'i (brtan pa'i srog gtadag/ slob dpon pad mas mdzad pa brag ri dug sbrul spungs pa'i sked pa nas rig 'dzin rgod ldem gyis gter nas bzhes pa'i 17brgyags brnga2)/ gter gton dor legs kyi 17brtan ma'i gsol kha)/ rje drung bzhad pa'i rdo rjes mdzad pa'i (bstan srung rgya mtsho'i rnam thar)/ (nyang gter g.yul zlog)(snag sham gter byon)/ (7bsrun zlog) (palas rgya mtsho'i rgyud )paṇa chen blo bzang chos kyinyi mas mdzad pa'i 17brtan pa'i chos skor gyi dkar chag zla tshes gsar par/sogs su gsal ba snying bsdus shig bkod pa yin/51

brtan ma bcu gnyis/thugs mnyes te brtan ma so so'i sgrub thabs gsungs nas phyis su gter du sbas par grags /yang /tshethang yig na/las gsungs pa'i lo rgyus ni/ zhang zhung gi brtan ma dza mun gyis ri bo gnyis su spral nas slob dngon de'i dbar du btsir ska bas/ 〈snab dpon gyis kha ṭwāṃ ga'i ༄/ ba nas gcig phar g.yugs/ gcig tshur g.yugs te sdigs mdzub mdzad pas/ sa bred nas ༷thog snga gas phul te srung par dam bca' byas pa mtshan ༷/ma chen ldetho spre gaX/ bun mar btags/de nas gnam thang la byed skabs/ gnam sman dkar 〈snas :rdzob dpo na gyi steng thog phab pa :snab dpod gyis rdzu 'phrul bstan nas thog de chu bum pa gang du bca ra nas lag mthil du bsnams pas/ tshetshe pe mtshar skyes te phyag 'tshal nas daskul mtsho'i nang du bros/ slob dpon gyis mtsho khar rdo rdze bzhag pas/ mtsho 'khol nas mig g.yas pa zhar/ sha rus bye nas keng rus su gyur te mtsho khar theni nas :thob dponi la bzod gsethol zhus/ sre ga snying phul nas dam la btags shing mtshan gangs dkar sha med the rdzospre spyan gcig ma zhes grags/de nas tse( yug na par byon dus bod kyi bstan ma bcu gnyis kyis slob dpon ri'i bar du btsir ba'i rdzu 'phrul bstan pas/ slob dpon gyis phyag mkhar gyis ri gnyis bsgyel/ bstan ma rnams kyi gnas ri sman ri dang / gangs ri/g.ya' ri sesnags bshig nas drag 'dul mdzad pas/ bstan ma rnams skra ga nas so so'i srog snying phul nas bstan pa'i srung mar dam bca' mdzad pa dang /khyad rka/ra du bod du mi stegs pa srung ba'i dam bca' gnang / de nas bzung brtan ma bcu gnyis zhes mthongs su grags pa 'di dag yin/ de yang bstan ma 'di dag ( bo dpon gyis ji ltar 'dul ba'i tshul (7thang yig na/las gsal ba 52

brtan ma bcu gnyis/'dir drangs na/de nas mang yul stoni la mkhar du byed:zhang zhung dgra lha dza mun zhes ba bas:slob dpon ri brag gnyis kyi bar du bcar bar snang byon pas mo bsrings srog snying phul:gsang mtshan 3tshe spre g.yu bun ma ru btags:gter kha chen yo zhig gi gnyar kha gtad cad nas gnam thag mkhar nag la mkhar 11na:gangs dkar gnam sman dkar sas cog thab ste:slob dpon phyag mdzub la dkris mchor dor bas camo bred dpal sa dpal thang mtsho nang bros:mtsho khar sha rus bye ste bral ba las:slob dpon rdo spre brgyab pas mig g.yas zhar:ma'epyo khar yar byung zhu ba gsermel ba ni:zhes dang /zhes zer sretreg sning phul nas dam la btags:gsang mtshan rdo spre sha med g.yu spretshen maca gter kha chen po zhig gi gter byang gtad:de nas 'o yug bre sa kha ru byon:brtan ma bcu gnyis 11ga mda' bcu gnyis ri yi bar du btsir bar byas pa la:sol dum rar gyur stobs zad byin gyis rlabs:53

brtan ma bcu gnyis/brtan ma bcu gnyis skye nga ma bcu gnyis dang :ya ma bcu gnyis 〈snag gi snying po phulaca dam la btags nas gter ri'i gter kha gtad zhes dang / yang (lha 'dre'i bka' thang )du/de nas la kha kha can byed tsa naca zhang zhung mu dgra dza med lkungs su tshud:spe ba dponi gdan 'dren bang chen mi gsum dang :slob da' slob slob ri gnyis bar du btsir slob dpon bzod par brtsams pa las:slob dpon ri yi mkha' la byon g.yas phyosnags phyag mkhar btsugs nas lam gastothod de:spas ming so rje gsal snang dang 2seng mgo lha lung dang :klu gzi gsum gyis lam gtede shul la tshetsheng — lam phyed pas ni dngangs skrag skyes mo 3 rab tu bred par gyur —thugs spre mi chung la pad ma 'byung gnas la:srog gi snying po 'di 'bul lotsa: la lā panyasrung mar khas blangs dam bca' gter gcig gtad:gsang mtshan the rje g.yu bun ma ru btags de nas 'u yug bre po sna ru oca 54

brtan ma bcu gnyis/bodi khams bstan ma bcu gnyis bar gcod byas:ri gnyis bar du bcar bar byas pa la drersha dponi bar snang mkha' la byed pad pa'i rdzong po skyes pas ngo mtshar nas:nged cag bar gcedi mi tshugs bkra shis zhu sku la mi bsno skyabs su mchi:—1ga snying phul nas dam la btags:gter kha gcig gi gter byang bcol:zhes gsungs pa bzhin slob dpon gyis ji ltar dam la btags pa'i tshul 'etho rgyus zhib gsal bo nga du drangs pa las shes nus shing / 'og tu brtan ma so so'i lo rgyus dang phyag mtshan sogs snying bsdus re zur 'don byas nas bris na/kan/ bdag nyid chen mo du rje kun grags ma/lha mo 'di gtsang sdod nas 'khrungs shing / gung thang dang byang gi gnam mcho phyug mo sermegs su gnas par grags pa dper na/ rgyal dbang lnga pa chen pos mdzad pa'i /tebartan mdom dpyid kyi rgyal mo'i glu dbyangs na/las/byang gi gnam mcho phyug sa ru/ /ting rting gangs kyi dkar sa shag /55

da brtanamabacu gnyis/bdag nyid chen mo khyodi mtshan du/ /rdo rje kun grags ma ru btags/ /zhes byung ba'i lha sa 'di'i sku mdog mthing nag dang / lag na chu srin gyi rgyal mtshan dang me mthong 'dzin pa/ zhoni pa 'brug la chibs par gsungs te/nyang nyi ma 'od zer gyi gter yig (7g.yu pa zlog na/gi gzhung las/gnam ma〉te phyug rmethor grags pa'i mtshan gserdzol ba/ /bdag nyid chen mo du spre kun grags ma/ /sku mdog mthing nag rin chen rgyan gyis spras/ /chu srin rgyal mtshan dang ni me mthong bsnams/ /'brug la chibs nas bstan pa'i bya ra mdzad/ /ces gsungs gsungs pa ltar ro/ /khan/ dpal ldan ha ri rdo rje g.ya' ma skyong /lha sa 'di mod yul spa gro'i yul yab glan zang dmu btsan gyi sras mor 'khrungs shing / gdung rus glan yin/ gnas yul glan yul moni kha dang /jo sa bla ri/ phag ri rnams su gnas pa /rtebartan mdos dpyid kyi rgyal mo'i gla dbyangs na/las 'di ltar gsungs te/ ༄wo yul ngo mo lha ri ru/ /rde rje g.yu bun gangs sman dkar/ /56

brtan ma bcu gnyis/skyi thang khyedi kyi gsang ba'i mtshan/ /rdo rje g.ya' ma skyong zhes btags/ /zhes gsungs pa'i lha sa 'di'i sku mdog sngo nag phyag na rin po che dang rus pa'i rgyan cha/ ral gri/ rdo je zhags pa 'dzin pa/ zhed pa rkyang la chibs pa (7nyang gter g.yul zlog na/las/mon yul jo sa lha ri gsang ba'i mtshan dpal ldan ha ri rdo rje g.ya' skyong ma:sku mdog sngo nag rin chen rus pas brgyan sna ba'i shang lang rin chen zhags pa bsnams:rkyang la chibs nas bstan pa'i bya ra mdzad: ces gsungs pa ltar 63na/ga5) gangs kyi yum chen rdo rje kun tu grags/gdung rus sha za drag lha'i rgyal por 'khrungs par grags pa'i lha mo du spre kun grags pa'am/ rdo rje g.yu bun par grags pa'i lha mo 'di brin gyi la phyi chu bar dang / na len shel gong sogs su bzhugs pa (7brtan mdos dpyid kyi rgyal mo'i glu dbyangs na/las/brin gyi la phyi chu bar du/ /dpal ldan bkra shis tshe ring ma/ /57

brtan ma bcu gnyis/gser thang ma khyod gsang mtshan du/ /ldetho spre kun tu bzang 〈snar btags/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar lha sa 'di'i phyag mtshan ni/ sku mdog mthing nag phyag na rdo spre dang tshe bum 'dzin pa/ ngaper na/ /tshenyang gter g.yul zlog na/las/brin gyi bkra shis tshe ring gsang ba'i mtshan:gangs kyi yum chen rdo rje kun tu bzang :sku mdesnag mthing nag rin chen rgyan gyis mdzesaca gser gyi rdo spre tshe yi bum pa brnya mas:zhes dang / 'jam dbyangs ma khyen brtse dbang po'i (7brtan ma/'i sre ga gtad na/las/yul ni gangs 'phyosna kha g.yas na/ / gangs kyi ༷/ma chen gaX/ bun ma/ /gdung dus gnyan de sha za po/ /dgra lha'i rgyal po'i sring gcig ma/ /seng ge dkar mo'i g.yang gzhi gsol/ /chibs su seng ge dkar mo chibs /phyag na rdo spre rtse lnga bsnams/ /dkar 〈sna ma bdun 'khor dang bcas/ /zhes (7nyang gter g.yul zlog na/dang bshad tshul cung mi mthun pa 'di 58

brtan ma bcu gnyis/nga na/ 'brog chen 'khor 'dul rdo rje bgegs kyi gtso/(7brtan mdos dpyid kyi rgyal mo'i glu dbyangs na/las/yar 'brog g.yu mtsho phyug po ru/ /'brog chen lha lcam dor dril ma/ /g.ya' ma rje thong khyethod gsang mtshan du/ /'khor 'das rdo rje bgegs gtsor grags/ /zhes gsungs pa bzhin yor 'brog g.yu mtsho'i 'brog spre lha zhes pa'i sras sar 'khrungs par grags pa'i lha sa 'di yar 'brog g.yu mcho dang /yar 'brog dar gong / byang 'brog sna brgyad sogs su bzhugs shing / 'di nyid kyi gdung rus 'brog bza' ma yin cing sku mdog nag po/ lag na ru mtshon rtse lnga dang / 'gas pa 'dzin pa/ zhed pa dre'u la chibs pa zhig yin par gsungs kyang / (7stag sham brtan mdos na/nang /byang gi 'brog chen g.ya' po skyong :gsang mtshan rdo rje dril bu ma:na bza' g.yag pags rloni pa gserdzol lcags kyi thede ldem 1thor tshugs can chibs su 'brong bu kha dkar chibs:'khor du byang gi 'brog tshan mang pos bsgor:zhes na bza' g.yag pags sgroni pa spuni pa dang / phyag na lcags kyi cod ldem 'dzin pa/ zhon pa 'brong mchu to dkar ngo can zhig la chibs par 59

brtan ma bcu gnyis/gsungs so/ /can/ gangs dkar sha med rdo rje g.yu bun ma/gtsang gi rdza ri gangs dkar gyi dung ru dkar po'i sras mo la 'khrungs shing / gdung rus sha za yin par grags pa'i lha mo 'di nyid lha phu gangs dkar dang / gangs dkar rdzong gi she stod/ rdo rje brag rnams su gnas shing bstan par bya ra mdzad bzhin pa dper na/ (7brtan mdos dpyid kyi rgyal mo'i glu dbyangs na/las/lha phu gangs ri dkar po ru/ /gangs kyi yum chen 'odi 'bar ma /sha med khyedi kyi gsang ba'i mtshan/ /rdo rje g.yu bun ma ru btags/ /zhes gsungs pa'i lha sa 'di'i sku mdog dkar po/ dar gyi na bza' gserdzol zhing / phyag na gter bum 'dzin pa/ sha ba yu mthor chibs pa zhig yin par grags kyang / 17brgyags brngan na/las/gtsang 'gram rdza ri gangs dkar na :sha med rdo spre kun tu bzang ca ne5 lha sa 'di'i lo rgyus zhib cha g.yu sgron pa'i skabs su gzigs par zhu/60

brtan ma bcu gnyis/rigasasgo mang du 'di cing / ma( rgyus zhib cha gsham gsal yig cha khag dang bsdur nas rtetsheg dpyode gnang gal che/35 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse dbang po'i 17brtan ma'i srog gtadag// (7nyang gter g.yul zlogag/ (9snag sham gter byonan// (7las rgya mtsho'i rgyudan//(7bsrun zlog na// (7brgyags brngashe)/ gter gdon rdor legs kyi (7brtan ma'i gserdzol kha na/serdzogs gter yig rnams las gnas yul dang phyag mtshan rnam pa 'dra min bshad skusnad kyang / 'dir rgyal dbang lnga pas mdzad pa'i (7brtan mdos )gzhir bzung 'og brtan ma bcu gnyis kyi chos skor rnying shos slob dngon pad mas mdzad pa brag ri dug sbrul spungs pa'i sked pa nas rig 'dzin rgod ldem phru can gyis gter nas bton pa'i 17brgyags brngan na/khungs ldan du song gshis/ yi/ga cha de gnyis gung bsgrigs nas bris pa yin kyang / phyag mtshan dang sku mdog chibs pa serdzogs lesna rgyus zhib cha khongs so sor gsal bas 'dir ma bris shing / paṇa chen blo bzang chos kyinyi mas mdzad pa'i (7brtan ma'i chos skor be'u bum dkar chag zla tshes gsar bag/ zhes pa'i nang snga rabs gter yig dang / phyi rabs mkhas pa rnams kyis mdzad pa'i brtan ma'i chos sgor ji snyed cig bzhugs pa khyon bsdo mas chos rlo ra brgyad rgyalhag gi dpe two bkod 'dug pa zhib cha gsung 'bum pod gsum pa'i shog ngos calngaX nas 700 bar gsal bas der gzigs par 'tshal/61

brtan ma bcu gnyis/dge ser shel gyi kha desnag 'dra:chibs su sman sha dkar mo chibs:'khor du sman sa stong gis bskor:zhes gtsang gi rdza ri gangs dkar na gnas shing sku mdog dkar la ser ba shel gyi kha dog dang 'dra zhing / dar zab kyi na bza' mtha' can du g.yu yis brgyan pa/ gser dang mu stag gi dbu rgyan gsethol ba/ chibs su sha ba yu mo chibs pa/ 'khor du sman sa stong gis bskor bar gsungs so/ /chan/ gser chen mkha' lding rdo rje glang mo che/jo mo kha rag dang rma chen sbom ra'i nye 'gram gyi 'dar bu stong thang spre'i sras resnar 'khrungs shing / gdung rus khyung bza' yin par grags/ pa'i lha re 'di gnas yul ni/ (7brtan mdos dpyid kyi rgyal mo'i glu dbyangs na/las/ru mtshams dze 〈 snakha rag tu/ /stong thang spre'i lcam khyung bza' sa/ /khyung btsun khyethod kyi gsang ba'i mtshan/ /〈 snaspre dpal gyi yum du btags/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar lha mo sna'adi sku mdog dkar motho/ khyung pa zhon pa/phyag na me 'etsheng dang rma bya'i thul ba 'dzin pa/ yang ska bas rer mi pags kyi :thog pa byed pa/ lag na mi snying dang dug mda' themags pa/ ser mo thom bdun gyis 62

brtan ma bcu gnyis/bsterdzor nas bzhugs par gsungs pa dang / yang re 'gar sku marethog dmar ser/② ga na dgra sna dang zhags pa 'dzin pa/ dre'u nag la chibs pa sermegs bshad tshul sna tshogs 'dug pa dper na/ (7brgyags brngan na/las/yul ni rma chen sbom ra na:sring gcig kha rag khyung btsun ma:chibs su gyi lang rta dkar zhenica zhes dang / (7stag sham brtan mdos na/las/yul gcig snye 〈 snadag yul na:khyung btsun rdo rje dpal gyi yum mthing nag gdug pa'i rngams tshul can:na bza' mu men mdzes pa gsermel:brag nang spungs pa'i cod gdengs can:chibs su drel nag ning dkar chibs:'khor du sman mo stong gis bsgor:zhes kyang gsungs so/ /jan/ kha rag khyung btsun rdo rje dang/la gyi yum nub yul ka tshang/ du dngha lha gang ri'i sras mor 'khrungs shing gdung rus dzña bza' sa/ rda yul/ thang bkra dang byang spo da smad kyi mcho 'gram/ nub rgya mcho 63

brtan ma bcu gnyis/rnams suganas par grags pa'i lha mo 'di (7brtan mdos dpyid kyi rgyal mo'i glu dbyangs na/las/byang sto di dmar gyi mcho 'gram du/ /btsan po rdo je ye shes mchog /khong ting khyod kyi gsang ba'i mtshan/ /mkha' lding rdo spre klu mor btags/ /zhes gsungs pa gang ltar sku mde ga dpar mdangs can/ phyag na 'dar dril dang me 'ong bsnams pa/ snyad pa khyung chen la chibs pa zhig yin cing / yang /rtenyang gter g.yul zlog na/las/byang stod ro dmag mtsho bdag gsang sdu'i mtshan:gser chen mkha' ljing rdo spre klu mo ni:sku mdog dkar dmar dar dang rin chen brgyan:sbral zhags dang ni rin chen phur bu bsnams:kṣiṃ maḥthog chibs nas bstan pa'i byar mdzad:zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /sku dgaterayigakha shas las jo sa nags rgyal dang / ub chos lamar sa rgyal/ rdo rje g.yar sa bsil/ do spre drag rgyal ma sogs lha cho 'di'i ma tshan gyi rnams grangs su gsungs 'dus pa sa brtag dbos/64

brtan ma bcu gnyis/ nyan/ rma ri rab 'byams rdo rje drag mo rgyal/rma chen sbom ra'i sring sa dang gdung rus rma bza' yin pa dang / rma chen rtsom ra'i nye 'gram ri rgyud du gnas par grags pa'i lha mo 'di (7brtan mdos dpyid kyi rgyal mo'i glu dbyangs na/las/khams kyi rma chen :thom ra'i mgul/ /byang gi stang stang stang sa btsun/ /thakaser mthershatha/ 'o/sa mkhan gsang mtshan du/ /rdo spre drag mo rgyal zhes btags/ /zhes dang / 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse dbang po'i (7brtan pa'i srog gtad na/las/yul ni rma chen thang brgyud na/ /rma chen sbom ra'i sring gcig mo/ /gdung rus gnyan de rma bza' mo/ /byang gi rting ting stang mo btsun/ /g.yag pags 〈snang gi :thog pa la/ /khyung ga3thog stong gi sham thabs can/ /chibs su 'brong bu ra gug chibs/ /phyag na maḥthong gi phur ba bsnams/ /nyi 'edi ma bdun 'khor dang bcas/ /zhes rma chen slom ra'i ri rgyud du gnas shing / gdung rus gnyan yin 65

brtan ma bcu gnyis/pa/ chibs su 'alngardzong bu dwa bru/ga ḍūtshen pa/ g.yag pags ༷1na pa/ khyung chen gyi ga31ga pa'i sham thabs gsermel ba/ phyag na maḥthong gi phur ba mthod par gsungs pa dang / yang (7nyang gter g.yul zlog na/las/rma chen ྅thom rwa'i sring gcig gsang ba'i mtshan:rma ri rab 'byams rdo je drag mo rgyal:be con dang ni rin chen gzhong ba 'dzin:'phar bar chibs nas bstan pa'i bya ra mdzad:zhes sku nga gi bshad tshul dang cung mi mthun pa'ang mthod do/ /ta) gong btsun de mo thod khams skyong /kong po'i yul gyi kong rje dge mo'i sras sar 'khrungs shing / kong yul bre sna chogs su gnas pa gdung rus she bza' yin par grags pa'i lha ma tho'adi (brtan mdos dpyid kyi rgyal mo'i glu dbyangs )las/shar phyogs kong yul bre sna ru/ /kong btsun de sa 'od 'bar ma/ /kong bza' khyod kyi gsang ba'i mtshan/ /rdo spre bod khams skyong du btags/ /zhes byung ba'i lha mo 'di'i sku mdog smug nag dar dang shing pags byon pa / lag na mda' dang rin po che'i za ma tog 'dzin pa/ sprin pa'i gseb 6 6

brtan ma bcu gnyis/kyi rlung ba zhon par grags te/ (7nyang gter g.yul zlog na/las/kong po'i tong btsun de mo gsang ba'i mtshanaca smug nag dar dang shing pags rled pa spyod:mda' dar dang ni rin chen za ma tog:sprin gyi rlung bskyo da bstan pa'i bya ra mdzad:zhes gsungs pa dang / (7yang rnya ga rigam bsta na mdos na/las/kong yul kong btsun de mo g.yu bun ma:spyi mdog dkar sa rnya ga sa ri bkra chibs:me long dang ni rdo spre rtse dgu ba /mas:zhes sku mdog dkar zhing stag sa ri bkra la chibs pa/ lag na me long dang rdo spre rtse dgu 'dzin par gsungs pa'ang yod/than/ btsan la la re sdo rje sman gcig ma/gnod sbyin snying 'phrog gi bu sar 'khrungs shing / e nyag la ro dang bsam lding rgyab ri/ na len shing len sogs su gnas pa dang gdung rus she bza' ma yin par grags pa'i lha sa 'di nyid (7brtan mdos dpyid kyi rgyal mo'i glu dbyangs na/gyo/sa/ e gnya' la ro'i gnas mtshedag tu/ /gangs kyi ram shag la ro sman/ /67

brtan ma bcu gnyis/btsan mtho drag khyestod gsang mtshan du/ /rdo spre sman gcig ma ru btags/ /zhes byung ba'i lha sa 'di'i sku mdog dam ra ljang can/ rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ lag na dar dang dnge sa grub kyi 'brang rgyas 'dzin par grags te/ (7nyang gter g.yul zlog na/las/e nyag la ro'i spo bdag gsang ba'i mtshan:mtshan la la ro da spre sman gcig ma:sku mdog dmar ljang rin chen rgyan gyis brgyanaca lhab lhub dar dang dngos grub 'brang rgyas bsnam/sa mdzo mor chibs nas bstan pa'i bya ra mdzad zhes kyang gsungs so/ /dan/ sman btsun chen po rdo rje g.ya' ma skyong /g.yar chasna thang gtsug gi sras mthor 'khrungs shing / rta nag tshwa kha 〈 snadang khams kyi g.yar sa thang / dar mdo gser sdings/ yar stod g.yar thang serdzogs su gnas pa dang / gdung rus g.ya' bza' mo yin par bshad pa'i lhas 'di sku mdog dpar mo/ phyag na rin po che dang tang shag 'dzin pa/ zhon pa yu sar chibs par gsungs pa dper na/ (7nyang gter g.yul zlog na/las/gtsang gi 〈 snamatho nags rgyal gsang ba'i mtshan:68

brtan ma bcu gnyis/sman btsun ug ཿthos rdo rje g.yar mo snabasril sku mdog dpar ngo rin chen rgyan gyis spras rin chen 'bar ba sgra snyan ting ting shag:sha yu chibs nas bstan pa'i bya ra mdzad:ces dang / yang (7brtan pa'i srelag gtad na/las/yul ni g.yer thang g.yer rgod na/ /g.yar thang gtsug gi lcam mo 3/ /gdung rus gnyan te g.yar bza' mo/ /mo btsun ug chos gajigar ོ bsril/ /sgral nag gtams pa'i g.yang gzhi gsermepa/ /smobs su rnar bu shad la chibs/ /phyag na se nga lding phur ba bsnams/ /dmag nag ma bdun 'de'or dang bcas/ /zhes byung ba'i sgral nag gis gang ba'i g.yang gzhi byed pa/ snyasnan pa rnar bu shad chibs pa/ ༄phyag na seng lding gi phur ba cogs par gsungs shing /yang (7brgyags brngan na/las/yul gcig dpe med lce ba na:sring gcig u/ga chos g.yar sa bsril :chibs su rus sbal mas dgu chibs:zhes kyang gsungs/69

brtan ma bcu gnyis/ nan/ g.yu yi dril bu rdo rje zu le ma/yar lha sham po'i sring mor 'khrungs shing / bod kyi dbus ri'i gnas dang yar klung spang phu/ byang gi gnam mcho phyug mo/ ngo cho/ g.yu/ ri/ dbu ru ka tshal ( dbu ru rnyi nga tshal yang zer )sogs su bzhugs nga dang / gdung rus shebaza' yin par grags pa'i lha sa 'di nyid (7brtan rma dos dpyid kyi rgyal mo 'i glu dbyangs na/las/bdud kyi ngo mo g.yu ri ma/ /rdo spre ye shes g.yu dril ma/ /she bza' ma khyerdzod gsang ma/tshan du/ ༈)tho spre gzugs legs ma zhes btags/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar sku mdosnag dmar ser dang / phyag na dril/ bu dang rin po che'i pad ma 'dzin pa/ zhes pa snag la chibs par gsungs te/ nyang (7gter g.yul zlog na/la/sa/bdud kyi rdzo sa g.yu ri gsang ba'i mtshan:g.yu yi dril bu rdo spre gzugs legs ma:sku mdog dpar ser rin chen rgyan gyis spras:rnya na pa'i dril bu rin chen pad ma bsnams:stag la chibs nas bstan pa/'i bya ra mdzad:zhes gsungs kyang (7brgyags brngan na/las/yul/ gcig dbu ri'i ka tshal na:70

brtan ma bcu gnyis/sring gcig rdo rje g.yu dril maca chibs su ntu rta sngoni sar chibs:zhes lha mo 'di dag slob dngon pad 'byung ma gyon sngone nas sod du gnas pa'i yul lha 'etshe rgyus shin tu ring ba zhig yin cing / dus phyis su paṇa chen blo bzang ཿthos rgyan ( 1567—1662)dang / rgyal mtshe ga lnga pa chen ngetho sethogs nas gaXrdogs cher mdzad pa zhig 63na/brtan pa'i chos skor shin tu rnying gras slob dpon rin po ches mdzad par grags pa'i brgyags brngan 'di nyid brtan pa'i chos sterdzor snga 3snas yin la/yang sgoms su lha bzo ba rnams la lha mosna 'di dag gi phyag mtshan dang chibs pa/sku mdog sogs gcig gyur med snabs phyis su (7brgyags brngan na/gyi daso'i sa gzhi ltar bris na dge phan che bar mthe nga ste 'dir phyi rabs pa rnams la gzigs rtog ched cha tshang drangs na/yul ni rdo spre brag dpar gyi sring gcig gangs dkar sha med ma:chibs su dre'u rta rkang gsum chibs:yul ni rma chen sbom ra na:sring ba/cikra/ kha rab/ khyung btsan ma:37 dong chen rab 'byams pas mdzad pa'i 17bstan srung rgya mtsho'i rnam thar dam chen dga' byed na/nang brtan ma 'di dag thugs rgyud gcig pa dang / dpal he ru ma'i thugs ka nas byung bar gsungs pa dang / g.yu sgron ma dang g.yu yi rdo je zu le ma gnyis gcig tu ngos 'dzin mdzad pa cung zad nor ba min nam snyam pa mang bas brtag daskra sa/71

brtan ma bcu gnyis/chibs su gyi lang rta dkar chibs:yul ni dbu ru ka tshal gyi:sring gcig rdo rje g.yu sgred maca chibs su chibs rta sngoni sa chibs:yul ni ma hā de wa yi:sring gcig rdo spre kun grags mas chibs su chu glang sngon mo chibs yul ni lho yul de snying gi:sring gcig skyi mthing g.ya' ma skyong :chibs su gser sha yu mo chibasaca yul ni snga phyi de grong na:sring gcig ug ཿtshes g.yar mtho bsril:chibs su rus sbal mgo dgu chibs:yul ni bal yul gser phug na:canye ka dzhardo ṭi ral gcig maca chibs su g.yu 'brug sngoni mo chibs:yul ni na len shang len na:btsan la therdzol ba'i sman gcig pa:chibs su dre'u rta rkang gsum chibs:yul ni kong yul kong phug na:gangs kyi yum chen g.yu bun ma:chibs su stag sa ri bkra chibs:72

brtan ma bcu gnyis/yul ni mang yul mang tang na:che zhe gtsug gi 'edi 'chang maca chibs su 'brong bu dar ma chibasaca yul ni dbu ru snying po yi byang gi ma ting ting mo btsun:chibs su 'brong chen 'gying ba chibs yul ni sgrab yul ka tshal gyi mda' lag btsan ma thogadug pa 'dul:chibs su dom bu snying dkar chibs zhes gsal ba'i /rtebargyags brngan na/lag bris ma dpe thung zhig lag seni byung ba'i ma yig gi yig nor khag cig dag bcermes dang 'brel bkede pa yin kres zhib cha brgyags brngan rang du gzigs par zhu/ /

pe har rgyal po/pe har rgyal po/ba cochethos rgyal khri srelang lde'u btsan skabs nas dam tshig 'brel zhing /gzhung sa dga' ldan phe brang gi srung ma dpar nag gnyis kyinang tshan srung ma dmar sto pe har rgyal po dang ngo po tha mi dad pa'i chos skyong rdo spre dregs ldanan 'di nyid 7 pe har zhes pa ni legs sbyar gyi skad dod yin te/ 'od skad du dkor bdag gi skad don du 'jug par gsungs pa dang / yang bo don gzhan zhig la pe har zhes pa lha srung gi doni la'ang 'jug par gsungs pas legs sbyar dang sbrags nas rtog dpyod gnang gal che/ gnas chung rdo rje dregs ldan 'di nyid pe har rgyal po dang ngo co dbyer ma mchis pas sku gsung thugs mthon tan 'phrin las bcas kyinang nas gsung gisprul ba rdo rje dregs ldan yin par gsungs/39 'di'i thad (7rgyal mchog sku phreng bcu bzhi pa chen po mchog gi bka' slo ba na/ nang /rtsa ba rgyal po sku lnga nges don la gang yin dung min rung / thun sang snang por dregs pa'i sde dpon sum cu'i tshan pe har rgyal po'i tshul du ma da pa dang / pe har yang rgyal po zhes rnam 'gyur gcig de sku gsung thugs sku(na tan 'phrin las zhes pa phyes sku'ong dus rgyal pe sku lnga'i rnam par bstan pa dang / yang de rnams 'phrin las sgrub pa'i gnas ska bas rnam 'gyur mi gcig pa shar sku'ong dus rgyal pe byes chas (byes chas zhes pa yig tshe ra mi/na nam snyam )zhes pa rnam pa gcig la shar sku'ong mkhan/ yang skabs rer rgyal po dang / blon po zhes sprul ba yang sprul phyes yong dus rdo rje dregs lngan blon po'i tshul 74

pe har rgyal po/kyi'abyung khungs thad bshad 〈snal sna snangags 'dug pa'i nang nas yig cha khungs pa (thang yig ) dang / (rba bzhed )/ o rgyan rin yo che'i (rnam thar zangs gling man// (7rgyal po'i bskang mdos yid bzhin nor bun/rnams su gsal ba'i mdze rgyus mthongs grags ni4/shar mthong mkhan/ yang skabs rer rdo rje dregs ldan gtso bo'i tshul sogs sku lnga'i rnam 'gyur mi gcig tu ma nges pa shar mthong ba bcas yang snying rdo rje dregs ldan nub phyogs gsung gi rgyal po'i bka' blon yin pa red/ ( 1070'ormer wa ra ṇa mir bstsal pa'i bka' 〈snab phyi dril las khungs kyi dpar pa'i tu ga ngos 20 par gsal/)ces gsungs/gyi (nor lha nag po'i rgyud) le'u gnyis pa/ (shel phreng dkar po'i rgyud)/ (thang yigan/ (7rba bzhed zhabs btags ma)/ (7lha 'dre'i bka' thang na/o rgyan gling pa'i gter ma/ (rgyal po'i bskang mdos yid bzhin nor bu)/ khomado smad chos 'byung deb ther rgya mtshog/ (7o rgyan rin po che'i rnam thar zangs gling man//17bstan srung rgya mtsho'i rnam tharan// rig 'dzin pad ma gling pa'i bum thang thar ba gling gi seng ge brag nas sbyan drangs pa'i (tshadrag po'i me rlung 'khyil ba'i lo rgyusan// blo bzang 'phrin las kyis mdzad pa'i 17gnod sbyin chen po'i 'phrin las dam can dgyes pa'i sprin phung na// rgyal mchog sku phreng bdun pas mdzad pa'i 17gnas chung gi gsermel mchodan// 17gnas chung khog zhugs gsal ba'i 'dod gsedzelan// (gsu 'bum ja pa'i nang gsala'i rgyal mtshe ga thub bstan rgya mche sa mdzad pa'i 17dpal ldan dmag zor rgyal sa dang / rgyal chen sku lnga/ rdo rje dregs ldan bcas kyi bskang gso mdor bsdus stang 'dzin lha yi rol gar dngos grub gter gyuran/ (gsung 'bum pod gnyis pa'i le'u tshan tsha pa'i nang gsalatabacas su gsal ba khungs gtugs nas bris pa yin/75

pe har rgyal po/sngoni bskal pa dang po'i skabs su pe har 'di nyid lha yul du lha'i srung ma yin par grags shing / nam zhig lha yul nas sa la babs dus shing gi bya chen poshig spral nas de'i nang du bzhugs te bsrebs pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis rgyal po shing bya can sdu grags/ de nas bha ṭa hor gyi yul du phebs nas de ga'i sgormem grwa 5ga po zhes pa'i srung ma mdzad cing bzhugs/de nas chesnas rgyal khri 〈snang lde'u btsan gyis bsam yas lhun gyis grub pa'i gtsug lag khang gsar bzhengs grub ste srung ma nus mthu can zhig dbe sa gnad che bar mthong ste/ mkhan :thob gnyis nas bka' 〈snas mdzad skabs/chos skyethong rgyal po pe har 'di legs par gzigs nas/ rgyal pos :thob dponi la gsethol ba btab pa bzhin/ rnam sras rta bdag brgyad kyi 'ate1ra du gnod sbyin bye ba'i chogs kyis bsgor ba'i rdzu 'phrul bstan nas btsan po'i dpag sogs su gnyer sa/tad mdzad/ skabs der rnam sras kyi gzugs ris dar gyi steng gami mgoni brtseni zhes pa zhig gis ri mor bris pas dar de la phyis su rgyal po'i bla dar zhes grags/de nas btsan pos rang gi nang blon lha bzang klu dpal zhes pa dmag dpon du bskos te/ mdo smad (khams kyi g.yar sngo thang zhes bris 'dug) du song ste/ gru gu'i dpag dang 'thab ste bha ṭa hor gyi sgom grwar dmag drangs 4/ bha ṭa hor zhes pa ni/ brag dgon bstan pa rab rgyas kyis mdzad pa'i 17mdo smad chos 'byung deb ther rgya masno / las/ mkhan :tsheb chos gsum bka' ba〈snas te pe har sku lnga bsam yas srung mar 'gugs ched rgyal pos ngan lam ta ra klu dong dmag dpon du bskos te dpag btang / lha ṭa hor gyi sgom grwa bcom/ rgyal bu ཿ/ pa la dang /76

pe har rgyal po/te bcom/ skabs der pe har 'di nyid bya 3de kyi rnam pas nam mkhar bros pas/ rnam sras kyi dmag gi khre2 nas gzhedi sbyin zhig gis pa11 she/mda' brgyab pas sa la lhungs pa phyis su sa der bya the(da ga31ngas zhes grags/de nas bodi dmag gis pe har gdan 'dren zhu skabs/ pe har gyi zhal nas/ nga bod du mi 'gro/ cis kyang 'gro dgos na/ nga'i 'khor dang /sems rten gyi mdza' nge sermegs mnyam du khrid daskra sa gsungs pas/ bodi dmag gis de ltar byed par khas blangs te/ za hor rgyal rgyud kyi mi gcig dang /shel gyi spa lcag sku rgyu g.yu las grub pa'i thub dbang gi sku brnyan gsung byon ma bcas sku gsung thugs rten mang po dang / smor rdzas shin tu mang po bcas gdan drangs te rim gyis bsam yas su bslebs / :thon 'bangs g.yu'i thub pa rang byon/ bsre 'gag smug chung sermegs rdzas dang sku'o byad thams cad 'khyer/ slob dpon pad mas phyag rdor gyi ning nge 'dzin mdzad de rnam sras 'khor bcas kyi dmag gis chos skyong bkug nas pe har dkon mdzod gling gi lcog tu rten btsugs dam la btags zhes gsungs pa'i hor yul ni gan gu'u dang nye ba'i yu gur gyi sar ngos 'dzin cing / byang gru gu'i rgyal khab tu dmag drangs pa ra bshad pa'ang wo rgyud gru gu'i yul khams la byed do/ /(mdo smad chos 'byung tan su'u lcags dpar ma'i 3snag ngos 14 par gsal/ )zhes bsal zhing / (7deb ther dpyid kyi rgyal mo'i glu dbyangs na/nang / gha (hor gyi sgom grwa gtor shul da lta'ang mtshed ces gsal 'dug42 7rgyal po 'i bskang ma dos yid bzhin nor bu)yi nang / khri srong lde'u btsan rang nyid dang / slob dpon gnyis kyang pe har gdan 'dren du phebs rlo ra gsal bas brtag 77

pe har rgyal po/rnams nas phebs bsu'i dga' sto na dang 'brel bsam yas su gdan drangs/btsan po gyisrong lde'u btsan mkhan :thob rnams nas bka' ba〈snas mdzad de/ pe har dkor mdzod gling gi srung mar gtad pa nas bzung btsan po khri srong lde'u btsan dang thun sang ma yin pa'i dam tshig 'dres can du song ste/ dus da lta'i bar gzhung bsten srung ma nang du snying nye la bkra shis/ phyi ru dpa' zhing gtum drag che ba'i srung ma nus mthu can 'di byung zhing / de yang 17rgyal ba dge 'dun rgya mtsho'i rnam thar dpag bsam sbyod bzang na/ las/ 'o na chos rgyal chen po'adi ye shes pa yin min gyi dpyad gzhi sna tshogs 'dug pa de ji ltar lags zhus pas bka' bstsal ba/ 3thos rgyal chen ngetho 'di ye shes pa gcig yin bsam pa ni 'di/ rdo rje'i slob dpon 'dzi rgyan rin po che pad ma 'byung gnas sangs rgyas gnyis pa mngoni sum des/ ཿthos kyi rgyal po chen po lta bu dbang po snan po'i rdo rje'i slob ma khyad par can de gsang sngagasakyichogazab ༅sgrab chen bka' brgyud kyi dkyil 'khor bcug cing dbang bskur dam la bzhag sudabang dus su khas blangs pa'i dam tshig dang sdomadze pa la gnas pa'i srung ma khyad par can 'di lta bu ye shes pa yin nam bsams/zhes gsungs pa dang / yang 7gong sa lnga pa'i (7rang rnam du ku la'i gos bzang na/ du/ tshes gsum gyi snga dro pe har lcog tu gnod sbyin chen po sku dgos/43 shes rig par khang nas bskyar du dpar ba'i (7'phags pa 'jig rten dbang phyug gi 'khrungs rabs na/ deb phreng dang po'i shog ngos 277 par gsal/78

pe har rgyal po/ thab zhus/ mkha' 'gretho ye shes mtsho rgyal phyag gi 〈 snaspre ཿthos rgyal byang ba'i bla rdo khyad can de dbu gtsug tu bzhag nas tshethos sman btab pa'i bdud rtsi zhal du gserdzol te/ dpal ces rgyan sangs rgyas gnyis pa nas rim par brgyud rig 'dzin mnga' ris pa chen po legs ldan bdud 'joms rdo spre yab sras/gdams pa 'i bka' babs drin chen bla ma dam pa dang bcas pa'i bar gyi mtshan brngod de brnya na 'gro'i phan bde spe la ba dang / 'phrin las rnam pa bzhi sgri ba pa'i dam tshig bsgri gas pas/ dam las 'da' na rdo spre dmyal bar skye ba'i 'dzogs pa mthod/ sngar 'da' ma myong gsungs pa dang sbrags bdud rtsi zhal du gsemal/sngo da gsang ba'i bdag nge/tho/ dpal rta mgrin/ ces rgyan pad ma 'byung gnas bcas kyi ྅ na snga srog snyi nga phul ba nas bzung snga ra nas da bar gyi lo rgyus shin tu rgyas par mdzad/ces 7gong sa lnga pa chen pos chos skyo nga 'di la thugs re chen pos phab gnang mdzad bzhin pa sku nga 'khod tshig 'bru'i sog nas nges shes 'drongs pa dang /yang chedzes su rig 'dzin chen po thobadud 'dzemams yab sras nas rim par brgyud tshul gas la/ zhing / gsang ba'i bdag nge dang / dpal rta ma grin sethogs kyi spu na sngar srog snying phul ba gsal bar gzhigs na 'ordzo rgyus gzhan zhig kyang mdzed las che ba gang ltar ri so dga' ldan pa'i phyogs su rgyal mchog dge 'dun rgya mchos bsnye na mchod mdzad pa dang / de'i spres rgyal mchog bsetred nams rgya mcho dang thun sang ma yin pa'i 'brel ba zhig byung / de nas 7tre nga sa lnga pa slo (pa'aphags pa 'jig rten dbang phyug gi 'khrungs rabasan/ deb phreng banyis pa 'i cos ngos 447 pa ra bsal/79

pe har rgyal nge /chen pos dga' ldan pho brang gi srid 'gan bzhes skabs/ pe har 'di gzhung bsten srung par bkur te/ dus da lta'i bar brnya na srung dpar nag gnyis zhes mthongs su grags pa 'di yin cing / de yang pe har rgyal po dang ngo bo dbyer ma mchis pa'i gsung gi spral ba rdo rje dregs ldan 'di nyid kyichos skori shin tu mang pobazhugs pa'i nang nas lhan tu rnying khongs lta bu ni/(7bal sa zhu lan gyi rgyudan// (7'bag seng rol pa'i rgyudan//(7ra tsa gser gyi dra ba'i rgyudan// (7srog bdag gser gyi ga pur gyi rgyudan//(7spu gri las rgyudan// /tsheganod sbyin nor lha'i rgyudan// lcags phreng nag po'i rgyudan/ sogs kyi snyan brgyud rim bzhin dar srol chen po byung / chos sgor 'di dag (7rin chen gter mdzodan/ nang gsal bas zhib cha der gzigs/ )spri la ba'i chos skyo nga chen po 'di nyid spyir na/ rgya nag ri co rtse lnga dang / li yul lcasnga ra spug po/ bha ṭa hor gyi 〉tshem grwa/ dpal sa skya/ bsam yas pe har daskasnar mdzod gling sethogs su bzhugs par gsungs pa dang / khyad par gzhung sa dga' ldan pho thobrang gi gzhung bsten srung ma dpar ngethor bzhugs pa 'di yin/de yang lo rgyus gzha/ji zhig yod pa ni/ sngon slob dpon rin po che bsam yas shel gyi brag phug nga tu bzhugs bzhin pa zhag gsum serdzong ba'i the rengs shig la/ pe har 'di nyid seng ge dkar sa zhig la zhon nas 'khor 5 bsam yas shel gyi brag phug ni/ (7shel phreng dkar po'i rgyudan/ las bha ṭa hor gyi nye 'gram du mthod par gsal ba dang / 17thang yigan/ nang yar klung shel gyi brag phug tu 61da par gsal ba bzhed sre la mi mthun pas brtag dbo sa/80

pe har rgyal po/brgyad brgya dang bcas te bsrebs nas/ drersha dponi la nyams sad nas slob dponi gyi dbu la gnam rdo lug po tsam zhig g.yugs pas/ sgrobo dponi dran med du brgyal/ slob dpon brgyal sangs dus/ dkyil 'khor gyi thig rtsa dang /yo byad gang sar gtor 'di pa gzigs/de nas slob dpon stang nge 'dzin la stomasapar bzhugasanas drag 'dul mdzad skabs/ pe har 'di nyid gzhoni nu lag na shel phreng cogs pozhig gi cha byad bzung nas bsrebs pas/ slob dponi gyis su yin dris pas/ dge bsnyen na re/ nga bdud kyi bu yin/ khyed kyis nga dang dam tshig bsre nus sam zer/ slob dponi gyis/ dam tshig bsre na khyede kyis sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa srung thub bam gsungs pas/ pe har gyis/ bode kyi lha khang da nga mchodi rten bcas nga la gtad na bsnan pa bsrung rgyu yin/ gal te ma gtad na gzhedi pa byed rgyu yin zer/ de ltar slob dpon thugs mnyes nas (7gzir mdosan/(17rin chen bter mdzod)pod nyi shu pa'i nang 'dug ) sogs pe har gyi chos skor gsungs nas sre ga snying bzhes te dam la btags/ pe har gyis kyang ji srid ma stongs bar bsnan pa bsrung bar khas blangs par gsungs pa'i 'o rgyus zhib cha (thang yig )nang 'di ltar gsal te/de nas dre ba dponi pad ma 'byung gnas kyis:bsam yas shel gyi brag phug dbeshangs par bzhugs:zhag gsum song ba'i phyi pa'i nub tho rengs:bsam yas la semags bodi kyi gtsug lag khang :81

pe har rgyal po/dkon srung rgyal po pe har 4zhes kyang bya:dge bsnyen chen nge rgyal nge thoshing bya can:bdud pe yab spre nag po snazhes kyang byaca seng ge dkar mtho zhig la snyad nas su g.yas kyi ru 'dren dpa' bo rnya ga chas brgya:gamathon gyi ru 'dren nyan thos dgra bcom brgya:rla da kyi rjes nyul ban de nag po brgya sngon gyi shul sel bud med nag po brgya:phyi mee slo po mon bu bha ṭa brgya:spyi yi skye tho sogs 'bag seng gar mkhan brgya spra la ba ya/nga spra la/ spre/ dang spre 'u brgya:ṭwāṃ ba dpon dudzo du nyams sad byed du byung — gnam rdo 'u ga tsam spyi po'i gtsug tu phabaca bye rdzob dpon brgyal zhing dal gyis ngos rnams dkrugs:brgyal sangs tsa na ting nge 'dzin gyis bkugaca slo (7sro ga bdag gser gyi ga ngu ran/ zhes pa'i pe har gyi rgyud nang / mang po ska la to re/spyi ring la na to re/ 'dus/ pa'i chan to ra/ brgya byin gyi bdag po/ gnam gyi ya bzang skye sa gcig mgul lha bsangs/ ma tree sems dpa'/ 'bo ngas po'i rgyal pe rwa rdo rje legs pa / rgyu ska ra rgya'i po/ yab shud dpar po'am dregs pa lcam sring / tshangs pa dung thod can/ gnod sbyi na gang ba bzang ngo / nge har rtso gas ma tshan gyi rnam grangs 3 bur gsungs 'dug pas zhib cha gzhung der gzigs rtog zhu/82

pe har rgyal po/dge bsnyen gzhed nu can zhig gtsangs kyis byung :lag na shel phreng 11gas nas mdun na 'dug:slobo dpon gyis ni gnod sbyin rigs 'dra ba dge bsnyen tshul du stoni pa su mee bu dge bsnyen na re nga ni bdud kyi bu:bdud kyi bu dang dam tshig bsre nus sam:slotho dponi zhal nas dam tshig bsre nus na khyod kyis sangs rgyas bstan pa srung nus sam:pe har na re ma 'ongs sod khams kun:lha khang mchodi rten nga la gtad pa na:bstan pa srung nus ma gtad gnod pa byedaca nga ni 'khu zhing dam 'da' ldog por 'gyur:de nas slob dponi pad ma 'byung gnas kyis:phyi rabs lha khang mtshede rten bzhengs pa rnams:sku gsung thugs rten pe har gtod par byas:ludage bsnye na bstan pa srung bar khas blangs serwa /zhes gsungs pa ltar lags shing / yang (7nor lha nag ngo'i rgyudan/(/tsherin chen gter mdzod pod ti pa'i nang 'dug)las byung ba'i lo rgyus ni/ sngoni mgon po legs ldan gyis/ gnod sbyin nor lha nag po la/khyod kyi skye rgyud ji 'dra yin zhes dris pa dang / nor lha nag pos/ nga'i skye 47 (thang yig)dbus dpar ma'i shog ngos 140 par bsal/83

pe har rgyal po/brgyud ni/ sngoni bskal pa dang po'i skabs su pha ye med 'phrul rgyal dang /ma klu smin dkar mo margo 〈snag can gnyis la sras sgos spre brang dkar bya ba zhig dang / gnyis pa gza' bdud nag po/ gsum pa khyung chen pe har/ bzhi pa sethog bdag shel gling / lnga pa rdo spre legs pa khyung bcas byung zhing / yang skye ba de yi phyi ma la/ pha mi rje btsan po dang / ma klu mo gos sngon ma gnyis la rmo nga gsum skye sa pa brdol ba'i nang nas maskra na po legs ldan nag po dang / klu btsan nag yo/ bdud mo thobya rkang gsum byung /de nas tshe 'phos te yab yag sha mgrin sngone dang / yum klu mo sbal matre khrag mig ma gnyis 'dus pa las lcags chethong nag ngetho gcig skyes/ pha ma gnyis nas gredzes byas te mthar lcags lhasnang de gshags pas/ khye'u 'jigs su rung ba zhig byung ste/ gasnarmed 'tshe rgyun mi chad pa byas pas/ pha ma gnyis yid chad nas/ ma 'ongs pa na/ gnyen sto drag shul can zhig nas dbang du sdud pa/ra 3snag ces dasad pa sor/ skabs der tshangs pa shri ral can gyis 'dul ba'i dus la babs par gzigs te/ stang nge 'dzin gyi 〉 tshem rdzobs la brten nas drag 'dul mdzad pas/ tshangs pa'i 'khethor du khas blangs te bka' las mi 'da' bar dam bcas par grags/yang 'o rgyus gzhan zhig 'di pa ni/ sngo ni yul a mi ta zhes pa der pe har 'di'i skye ba zhig dang / mgon po legs ldan gyi skye ba blon po'i bu zhig mthod pa de gnyis shin tu 'dris grogs su gyur nas gnyis ka rab tu byung ba'i kha chad byas/ rma khan po zla 'od dun ting zhu ba las rab tu byung sde/ rgyal po/'i sras de'i mtshan la zla 'od gzhon nu dang / blon po'i bu'i mtshan la dun ting nag po zhes btags/ blon po'i bu de spyodi lam zhi dul che zhing sgom sgrub nyams len

pe har rgyal potho/la dga' pos che ba dang / rgyal po'i sras de cos bsam dang nyams len la de tsam do snang med snabs/ khethong gnyis thugs snang dang :de lam ma mthun/nam zhig lha khang 'atre nga bo dgu 'dus zer ba zhig gi nang bram ze chos bzang zhu ba'i bu mo mdzes sdug yid du 'ong ba zhig 'di pa de la zla 'od gzhon nu sems chags te/ nyin zhig ཿthos skra sa gdan du bting nas nyin bdun la 'khrig pa spyad cing bsngad skabs/ mi stegs pa'i stoni pa bar snang zer ba zhig 'di pa des masang ste/ gtsug lag khang du 'khrig pa sbyad pa de byas nyes chen po yin zer nas sun 'byin byas pas/ rgyal bu zla 'odi gzhes nu ngo tsha zhing thugs khrems nas mi stegs pa'i stoni pa de'i tshesnas be|sa steng pho mtshan zhugs/slar yang nyin bdun la 'khrig pa sbyad cing bsngad/gnas tshul de khong gi grogs po dge slong dun ting nag pos gsan nas/slad phyin de ltar ma gnang zhes 'dul ba'i bslab pa dor ba'i nyes dmigs gsungs pas/ zla 'odi gzheni nu shin tu khros te/ seng ge zhig tu brdzus nas dge slong dun ting nag yo la gnod 'tshe sna chogs brtsams pa phyag na rdo rjes skyabs te gzhedi pas ma tsugs/de nas tshe 'phos te chu mig byang chub 'bar zer ba zhig gi skye ba bzhes/yul der nad mug byung sde/ lpo gos ma reg par yul gzhan zhig tu slong mor song skabs/ sngar gyi grogs po dge slong dun ting nag po dang mjal nas lo rgyus zhib por zhus pas/ dge slong snying rje skyes te 'tsho ba gang 'do ltar gnang / skabs shig nor rdzas la yid chags nas dge slong gsode la nye skabs/ phyag na rdo rjes skyabs te gnod pas ma tshugs stabs dge slong 'di la tshe rabs thams cad du gnod pa skyel ba'i mthog smod btab/85

pe har rgyal nge /de nas tshe 'phothos te glan mi byang chub 'bar (mtho rgyus kha shas las glan mi byang chub 'od tses 'byung ) zhes pa'i skye ba blangs te dge slong dun ting nag por gnodi 'tshe rgyun mi chad pa byas/ de nas yang tshe 'phos te/ mi je btsan po dang / klu mo thodung skyethong pa'i sras su skye ba blangs nas/ mtshan badzra gu hya sam te zer/ sngar gyi bag chags dbang gis dge slong dun ting nag por gnod 'tshe brtsams pa gsang bdag gis skyabs/yang tshe 'phos te yab bdud po slos rje dang / yum klu gza' smin dkar ma gnyis kyi bur skyes nas dge slong dun ting nag por 'khon lan slog sde/3 sna'aphrul sna tshogs bstan pas phyag na 〈 snarjes slar yang skyabs/de nas skye ba gnyis blangs pa'i mtha' ma mi bdud brang dkar zhes pa'i skye ba blangs pa'i skabs/ sngar gyi grogs po dge slong dun ting nag co dgra bcom pa'i skra 'phang thob nas/ dge slong legs ldan nag po bya bar gyur pa'i skabs/ phyag na rdo rje dang dge ) snang dun ting gnyis kyis dam la btags te mna' :rdothaka blangs//yun ring ma song bar mi bdud brang dkar blo log ste/ slar yang lcags khrab can 'jigs su rung ba zhig tu brdzus te mabedzin petho legs ldan (dge 〈snang dun ting nag po )gyi rkang pa g.yas par serme brgyab nas bros pas/ legs ldan nag pe thophyag na lde thorje'i spyan sngar serdzong nas gnas tshul zhus pas/ phyag na the maspre'i zhal nas/ da khyed rang sa thob pa'i dgra bcom pa yin pas rang nyid yi dam gyi sku'i ngo bor bzung ste/ 'dul daskra sa pa'i bka' gnang ba bzhin/ legs 86

pe har rgyal po/ldan nag po de nyid drag po'i skur bzhengs te/ dpal rta mgrin gyi nga rgyal sgom/ tsan dan gyi bing chen klad la bskor nas drag 'dul mdzad pas/ mi bdud brang dkar dpa' zhum nas/ phyag na rdo rje'i spyan sngar yong sne/ rang gzugs bsnan skabs/ gsang bdag gis rdo rje snying gar bzhag mna' chu kha la blud nas mtshan la spu gri 'bar ba zhes btags pa dang / 17gasnadi sbyin nor lha nag po'i rgyudan/ 'di gsungs par grags/phyigasasmobo dponi bod du byon dus bsam yas su pe har dkor mdzod gling gi srung mar gnyer gtad mdzad pa de nas bzung btsan rtsosgosang sne'u btsan gyi srung ma gtso bor mdzad cing / rjes su ris med skyes chen dam pa mang po dang / lhag par paṇa chen sku phreng rim byon dang / rgyal mchog 5 phreng rim byon gyis bsten cing mchod pa dang / yang sgom su 7gong pa lnga pa'i sku dus nas gzhung bsten srung par mdzad pa rnam thar the so'i nang gsal bas/ chad lhag bzlethos gsum gyi de gas gzhi mchis tshe khungs mtho mthor gzigam zhib gnang gal che/ legs ldan nag po ni/ mtho rgyus 'gar mabothon po zhal bzhi pa yin par gsungs pas brtag dgos/87

lha chen tshangs pa dkar po/lha chen tshangs pa dkar po/(khribatsan ponadre nga btsan sgam po'i skabs nas dam tshig 'brel ba'i srung ma khyad par can lha chen tshangs pa dkar ngo zhes pa gzhung sa dga' ldan pho brang gi gzhung bsnyen srung ma 'di nyid kyi le rgyus zad brjod tshul sna chogs 'de kyang /skabaga'adir rje drung bzhad pa'i rdo rjes mdzad pa'i (7tshangs pa'i 'phrin skul nyin byed snang ban/ las/sngoni tshe lha brgya'i mdun ma rnam rgyal gyi/ /khang bzang mdzes khrir khyod nyid khol por bzhugs/ /dpal chen gsang bdag mthu yis dam la btags/ /rta maḥthog gsung gis thub bsnan srung rma ra balha sa/ /bar du myong btsan chogakyi rgyal po yi/ /mi 'gyur 3thom 'khe ra khra 'brug gtsug lag khang / /phyi nang gnyer gtad dam tshig rjes su bskul/ /de'i 'og pad ma 'byung gnas spre 'bangs kyis/ /ma bzheshe) dang ( nga yig)/ (tshangs pa'i 'phrin skul nyin byed snang ba)/(she4phreng dkar po'i rgyudag/ (bsnan srung dam can rgya mtsho'i rnam thar)/ paṇa chen blo ba nga chos kyi rgyal mtshan sogs kyis mdzad pa'i srung ma 'di'i 'phrin skul dang /bstod tshogim khag pa gzhi bcol nam snying bsdus shig bkod pa yin/88

7——bye /rig( 6 7lha / te 'a nali/bshi / sna /gyisamyang༄4pho/7 )ṣṭhaposnyo /rdo chi ༄rig che mju༄ ༄khu snye 〉ཿ kṣi zlo 17 )na ༄/ji sdo sle khyu15( ci smya /khri ri'i rtodze sa tsoX tsārsāsgro rgyu༄dzo pho4/7 kyi/ sgro rdzo/dzo/ rdzi lho la byu / / )deb sna tshosna36 4 )///gi//// dzi 0 4 nya 4 ri ༷sidharmā rnyi wa rsharme/kṣi/sdo lcu/ shiṣṭha/ /// ////slo// na snang3ba ca ne

lha chen tshangs pa dkar po /khrag 'thung lha yi dkyil 'khethor zhal phyes nas/ /dbang bskur rdo rje rim pa gtsug tu bkod/ /'od skyo nga bde skyo nga bstan pa'i srung ma ru/ /rab bsko sa rdo rje g.yar dam dran mdzod la/ /rgyal bstan spyi dang 'jam marbeton gnyis pa'i brnya na/ /yangs pa'i khyon 'dir 'khol med rab tu spel/ /bsil ldan ljongs 'dir 'thab rtsod mu ge dang / /sad ser than pa mi shis mtshan pa semags/ /nyes brgya'i dpal mtsho'i phan bde snang ba rgyas/ /dga' ldan pho brang chab srid yar 'phel mdzod/ /mtha' 'dul yang 'dul rnams kyis legs masnodan pa'i/ /chos 'khor spyi dang khyad par semang btsan che'i/ /thugs dam lha dbang dbu ru'i gtsug lag 'di/ / rdzogs ldan ma gsar de srid srungs shing skyetshengs/ /ca'izhes gsungs pa ltar/ sngod chad lha maḥthog tshangs pa dkar po 'di nyid lha'i dbang yo brgya byin gyi co brang du zhabs 'bring ba mdzad cing bzhugs/de nas gsang bdag gis dam la btags/ rjes su dpal rta mtshethog rethol pa'i gsung gis sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa'i srung mar bstedzes par grags/spres su glerdzos rgyal serdzong btsan sgam pe sa (581——649)khra 'brug 3 khang gsar bzhengs grub ste phyi nang gi sku gsung thung/sa rtenathams cad srung ma 'di la mi rje drung bzhad pa'i rdo rje'i gsung 'bum pod ca pa'i 'og ngos 37 par gsal/89

lha chen tshangs pa dkar po/gnyer du gtad/ rgyal po rang gi srung pa'ang mdzad pa de nas bzung btsan po srong btsan sga ma po'i thugs rtse gnod sa'i srung par gyur te/ rgya nag gi thang rgyal rabs dang dpag 'khrug skabs/ lha chen tshangs pa 'di dgra lha'i gasdu bor bsgos/de'i rjes su slo ba dpon rin po re bod du byon skabs/ mi ra yang dam la btags pa'i tshul mdzad nas/ khrag 'thung sol pa'i dkyil 'khor du bcug sde/ ji srid bska la pa ma spo ngas pa de srid du sangs rgyas kyi brnya na pa bsrung bar khas blangs/ btsan yo khri srong lde'u btsan dang slob dpon gnyis bka' bgros te bsam yas gtsug lag khang gi rnam dag khrims khang gling gi srung par gnyer gtad mdzad pa ska bas der bris pa'i mtho rgyus /rtarba bzhed na/las gsungs/de'i rjes su chos skyo nga 'di'i snyan brgyud rim par brgyud nas 7gong sa lnga pa chen po'i sku dus nas/ gzhung sa dga' ldan pho brang gi srung par gnyer gtad mdzad pa (7rang rnam du ku la'i tre sa bzang na/du gas la//dus de nas bzung da lta'i bar gzhung gi gal 'gangs can gyi phyag las rnams tshe sa skyetsheng 'di ṇitsheg zhugs kyis bka' lung phab gnang mdzad bzhin pa/deng sang la sa chos skyong zer ba 'di yin/yang chos skyong 'di dang 'brel ba'i gter yig khag gcig las byung ba'i lo rgyus rim par bkod na/ sngon bdud gar gyi dbang phyug gi chung ma bdud sa pad pa'i phreng can zer ba zhig 'di pa de sbra ma par gyur te/ phru gu skye la nye skabs/ mngal gyi nang nas/ mgrin shlau nas thoni na dasku da dre / skye 〈 sna nas theni na mi gtsang / de bas rtsibs ma kha phyes nas theni na dga' zer ba'i chig lab byed pa mas 1tshes nas/ shin tu skrag nas sems can spyi mtshungs bzhin mngal che( 90

lha chen tshangs pa dkar po/nas theni 31ga zer yang ma nyan par pa'i rtsibs ma gshags nas dre sa/ ma dran pa sos skabs/ e ka dzā ṭi zhes pa'i bu mo zhig skyes yodi pa mthong / khyod su yin zer bas/ kho mo ma rang gi bu mo yin/ ming po dkar po sbyan gcig 'dul dgos pas ji ltar bgyi zhes sdus tshe/ yum gyi zhal nas/ bu mo song la gsang ba'i bdag pyo/ra zhus/ sgor du sgrol/ ging gi dbang yang zhus shog ces zhal bkod gnang ba bzhin/ bu mo gsang bdag gi spyan sngar song ste/gnas tshul zhib rgyas zhus pas/ gsang bdag gis mas ba//ra ba ltar/sgrol gong gi dbang bskur te/ gser gyi spu gri ring mo zhes pa gnang /de nas ma smad gnyis nas bsre phor dpar po zhig gi nang / khrag dang nu snyasna sbyar nas blugs/ mda' dar zhig gis g.yab mtshe byas te/ bu gcig ma la mi dbe|ngas dam/ ma snyarme ma ngar mtho mi bzhes sam/ ma khrag mngar rmetho mi bsten nam/ zhes rgyang 'bod byas pas/ dkar po sbyan gcig bsrebs te/ bsre phor nang gi nu 'o 'thung grabs byed skabs/ sring sa e ka dzā ṭis gser gyi ral gri ring mo g.yugs pas/ ming po'i lus la khel te rtsibs ma kha gshags pa'i nang nas snyi nga gsum byung ste/ nam mkhar 3tsher ba gnam thel dkar po spun gsum byung / yang gsum byung ba sa la 31ra bas/ sa thel khra nge spun gsum byung / yang gsum byung ba bar sna nga du sethong sde/ bar thel khra bo spun gsum byung / pa'i lag tu snying gcig zin pa rang gi bu skal du nyar/ phyis su bu de dpal rta mchog rol pas dbang bskur zhing sa ngas rgyas kyi bstan pa'i mig rgyan gyi srung mar bka' bachetshes par bshad/yang 'otshe rgyus shig la/ sngod yab tshangs pa dung gi zod phreng can dang /yum mnar gza' rbede phreng ma gnyis la sras tshangs pa dkar po 'khor le rdzo bcu ba 91

lha chen tshangs pa dkar po/bya ba zhig 'khrungs/ nar son dus za 'og gi slog pa gyen/ pa ṭa'i cod dkris bcings/ g.yu yi sge rags bcings/ gser gyi lham yu ring spyod/ rta maḥrmeg gser gyi shugs can la zhed nas yul khams 'grims te/ nyin motho bar snang la rgyug mtshan mtho spyo1nga khyer nang la nyul nas cethor rdzas brkus/skabs shig lha yul du song ste/ lha'i bu mo der bzang bya ba bslus te/lha'i yid bzhin nor bu brkus pas/ phyag na rdo spres lce nas bzung sne/ sa la brdabs/ lag gi sna ra bu 'phro ga ༷rtog snying bzhes nas mtshan in tra sems dpa' zhes btags/ lha'i bu mo yang gnang ste/ gling 'di'i phyed ka dbang du sdu da pa'i rgyal por gyur/in tri sems dpa' rgyal por gyur pa nas bzung / slog pa seng ge dkar mo'i gong lag can zhig gyon/ dar thod dpar po zhig dkris/ rnga dkar po thozhig la zheni nas yul khams 'grims te/ phe mthemang tshad kyi 〈snag bcad/sa mabong tshad mthog g.yem spyad de bzhugs pa'i skabs/ nyin zhig lha mo e ka dzā ṭa'i skye ba byang srin 'brog sag klus ra na 'o ma bsgo bzhin pa'i skabs/ zangs zo thob ke'i nang du g.yugs/ 'i ma khrag tu 'dzag pa 'thung bas/ e ka dzā ṭi tsuganu'i'o 'khanas/ za 'ethog gi zhabs de ra g.yu can 'phyar nas brgyab pas/brla 1thoge tu khel te rkang pa 'theng po ra serdzong / snyerdzog snying phul nas mtshan nam mkha' bzang po zhes btags/ de nas bod kyi rgyal po stod kyi steng gnyis sgo gas kyi ༷thog lha mdzad par grags/yang gong gsal brjod babs dang mi mthun pa'i mtho rgyas gzhan zhig ni/(7srog bdag gser gyi ga puran/las byung ba'i lo rgyus yirno te/ sngo na yab rgyal po rga ze bde ba dang / yum bde ba'i slog phreng ma gnyis la bu zhig skyes pa 92

lha chen tshangs pa dkar po/rig pa rno zhing / skyes 'bras mtshar ba/ rig byed mtha' dag la byang chub par sbyangs pa dang / lhag doni bram ze rig par shin tu mkhas par sbyangs/nam zhig ri bo hi ma la ya'i rtse mor song ste/ phyag na rdo spre dang mthu 'gran pas/ma thub par yid chad de/ ngas da bar mu stegs kyi mthu bslabs nas rdzu 'phrul shin tu che na yang / da lan khyodi kyi rdzu 'phrul gyi cha tsam mi do ba'i rgyu mtshan gang yin zhes sdus pas/ phyag na rdo rje'i zhal nas/ nga ni byang chub mtshesnag tu sems bskyed cing sa la gnas pa yin na/ khyethod nga la 'gran pa'i ྅tshebs ga la 'di gsungs pas/ 'e thon nga yang byang chub mtshethog tu sems bskyed nas sa 'thob par 'dod pas ji ltar bgyi zhes zhus tshe/ phyag na rdo rjes mtshan tshangs pa dung gi 1snar tshugs can du btags/ deng phan chad sa the ba pa'i byang chub sems dpa' yin gsungs nas/ rin po che'i dung gi cod paṇa mu stag dang gser gyis shan pa zhig matre la bskorsha nas/ cod paṇa 'di ma phud par sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa bsrung dbo sa par bka' balhathos te byin gyis brlabs/ de nas bzung mtshan li byin ha ra zhes grags shing / sngod ma las bcu 'gyur gyi rdzu 'phrul dang mthu stobos che bar grags/mdor na 'otho rgyus mthongs grags ni/ btsan po srong btsan sga ma pos khra 'brug lha khang gi srung par bskos pa nas bzung rim bzhin bod kyi rgyal rim byon dang / lhag doni btsan po khri 〈snang lde'u btsan gyis bsam yas gtsug lag khang gi rnam dag khrims khang gling gi srung mar gnyer gtad mdzad/ 7bye nga sa lnga pa chen po'i sku dus nas gzhung sa dga' ldan pho brang gi gzhung bsten srung mar mdzad pa'i lo rgyus gong du brjod pa ltar yin no/ /93

gnyan chen thang lha/gnyan chen thang lha/gnyan chen thang lha zhes pa'i srid pa chags pa'i lha dgu'i nang tshan gyi yul lha 'di byang chub sems dpa' nam mkha' wi nga po drag po/'i chul bzung bar grags pa gang ltar rjes su khra thob dpon rin po ches dam la btags te bsta na srung du gnyer gtad mdzad pa'i mdze rgyus ni/ (7lha 'dre bka' spang na/las/mabedzi so gru gu'i yul du slebs pa laca mjug ma khams kyi sermeg chu g.yo/ra thang brkyang :sbral dkar zhig gis ya ma 'phrang bcad nga/ na:sgob dpon sbra la gyi ṅge da par phyag mkhar btsugs:klu yi rgyal rdzo nee le zod dkar khyod:dri za'i rgyal po zur phud lnga pa zhes:khyod rang phar serdzong 'kherdzor chogs ga3tshem dang gsung ༷ thang 05 tha/ngas/ 95 11sa/ pas/ ba/ngas/ zhu nas/:(7lha 'dre bka' thang na/o/ rgyan gling pa'i gter ma dang / rwa ye shes seng ges ma dzad pa'i (7dwa lo'i rnam thar kun khyab stan pa'i rnga sgri na// (7rba bzhed zhabs/ btags man//lha brag gter byon gyi (7zang lha'i gsol kha na// 7gong sa lnga pas mdzad pa'i (7gnyan chen thang lha'i 'phrin las bdud phyi'i chu rgyun)/ (7rgyal po'i bka' thang )o rgyan gling pa'i gter ma/ rgyal mchog lnga pa'i (7rang rnam du ku la'i gos bzang na// klong chen rab 'byams pa/'i (7yang stag chen mo 'i lo rgyusan/ sogs gzhir bzung nas bris pa 'o//94

gnyan chen thang lha/rtse sa nag bzangs g.ya' sngoni nyi nyil gyis byung ca ma bzede zhal zas 'khethor tshe gas sna sna gas drangs:byis pa g.yu yi zur phud can du gyur dar dkar ral gu zhig gyon phyag/ sgor byas:〈snag snyi nga phul nas dam btags gter brgya gtang:gsang mtshan rdo spre mchog rab rtsal du gsermel zhes gsungs pa ltar slob dpon rin po ches 'dul/ nas brnya na pa srung ba'i srung mar brlo sa pa'i lo rgyus de dang / ya nga rba gsal rnya nga gis mdzad pa'i /tsherba bzhed zhabs btags ma na/las/ khra thob dpon pad mas gnod sbyin chen po la dpar thab stsal gsungs nas zangs la sdo ga pa brgyab nga sa thang lha khre sa pas gangs la bdug bcethom byung / sprin chags 'brug dang blosag dang ser ba babs/ de nas gal ta la cog la snying drung du byon nas bod chos byed ma ster ba'i klu dkar po mi srun pa zhig 'di/ de dam 'og bcug la 'dul dgos gsungs pa dang / klu de phyi'i rgya mtshor ba3thor/ de bzung la dam 'og tu bzhug gsungs nas/ dkyil 'khethor lnga bzhengs nas zhag gsum darbetongs pa mdzad pas/ gangs kyi btug bcom zhi yul kyang sdodam par gyur/ klu'ang dpa la thogs/ thang lnga bka' nyan du khas blangs//tab zhes dang /yang bshad tshul ga'an zhig ni/ tā(nga chen rab 'byams pa'i (1308 1363)(7yang tig chen mo'i lo rgyus na/las/ de nas sku lha thang lha'i rtsar yong ba dang / thang lhas gnod sbyi na stobs cher sprul te za byed kyi mche ba 32 shes rig dpar khang gi ((rba ba'ed 'bas btabs ma'i na/shob ngos par gsal/95

gnyan chen thang lha/gtsigs pa na bzod par gsol te srog snyi nga phung nag slo ba dpon la dro drangs te kha zas dang spu na gzigs dpag tu med pa/sa mtshe da do'i/ /zhes bshad chul cung zad mi mthun pa lta bu 'dug pa gang ltar dus phyis/ su btsan po khri srong lde'u btsan gyi srung ma mdzad par marngothon te/ dper na /tshergyal po'i bka' thang na/las/dbus gdung ru bzhi'i yul lha khyod:chos skyo nga rgyal yo lha yi sras: khri srong lde'u btsan sku lha yin: zhes gsal ba ltar bod kyi yu/la lha spri dang khyad pa ra du dbus gtsang phyogs kyi yu/la lha yin pa ma zad/ chos rgyal/ khri srong lde'u btsan gyi spyi 'i srung ma gtso bo'ang yin pas yu/la lha thams cad kyi yang spre lda bu yin cing / de yang lha brag gter gton gyis mdzad pa'i /tshethang lha'i gso pa kha na/las/sku lha 'i yab smras:'o de gung rgyal lags: lha sku'i yum smras pa g.yu bya ga31ga lags:khri zhes thang lha'i yab dge bsnye na chen po 'o de gung rgyal (srid nga/ chags pa'i lha dgu'i nang tshan )dang / yum rgyal mtho g.yu bya ga31ga gcig ma gnyis 53 klong chen rab 'byams pa 'i gsung 'bum pod ka pa'i shog ngos ji par gsal/5 (7bka' thang sde lnga na/shes rig dpar khang gi dpar ma'i 3snag ngos 43 par gsal/55 sle lung bzhad pa'i rdo rjes mdzad pa'i (7bstan srung rgya mtsho'i rnam thar na/la dwags dpar ma'i 3snag ngos 134 par gsal/96

gnyan chen thang lha/kyisras yin pa lta bu zhig brnya na 'dug pa gang ltar kyang the spre g.yu sgred ma mched 'khor su ma brgya drug cu dang / dregs pa'i sde dpon sum cus bskor ba'i srung ma khyad par can 'di'i ཿthos stothor rnams rig 'dzin rbedzid ldem pas gter nas bteni pa'i man ngag rnams 〈snang chen rab 'byams pa sermegs brgyud rim bzhin dar khyab byung cing / khyad par du 7bo nga sa lnga pas kyang srung pa 'di gcigs cher ma dzad nga ((rang rnam du ku la'i gos bzang na/du/ thang lha la rten 'dzugs/ gserdzol ma tshetshed rgyas nga/ra phul ba dus mtshungs/ par thang lha'i gangs kyi sged par 'ja' chon gyis 'khyud pa dang / nyi ma shar ba'i bkra shis legs/ gamatholta mchod nyung ngu zhig brtsams shing zhal byang btab pa'i dar tshon sna lnga bsnar/khazhes gsal ba ltar srid pa chags pa'i lha dgu'i nang tshan gyi thang lha 'di shin tu rnying gras su song gshis rgyal dbang lnga pa chen pos bdag skyo nga mdzad pa 'di mu / dgongs gzhi dang dgos pa rgya chen po mtshed par gsungs/yang rwa ye shes seng ges mdzad pa'i (7dwa le'i rnam thar kun khyab rnya na pa'i rnga sgra na/zhes pa'i nang / rwa lo rgya gar du slo ba gnyer la byon te tshur cod du bye na pa 'i lam khar/ spang lha'i gangs 'dabs brgyud nas byed ska bas/gnyan chen thang lha 'khor dang bcas pa bsu bar bla bas te/ nga'i pho brang du cis ca (7'phabs pa 'jig rten dbang phyug gi 'khrungs rabs na/deb gnyis pa'i thog ngos 364 par gsal zhing / rang rnam nang gsetho'i mchod nyung ngu zhig brtsams par gsungs pa de (7gnyan chen thang lha'i 'phrin las bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun ga)zhes pa de yin par 'dug cing / rgyal mchog blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum pod bcu gnyis pa'i nang gses nga pa'i 3thog ngos 1 nas 26 bar gsal/97

gnyan chen thang lha/kyang phebs par zhu zhus pa ltar phebs pas/ gangs ri de la chedze gcig 'di pa nang du serdzong bas/ shel dkar gyi pho brang sum sog can zhig la gser gyi rgya phib dang / mtha' 'khor du mcho bskyil nas 'di pa de'i nang du phebs te/rin che potho brtsegs pa'i bzhugs khrir 'khedi nas bsnyen bkur dpag tu med pa mdzad/ ba zang lha'i pho brang du nyin gsum bzhugs pa'i ring 'jigs byed kyi gdams pa mtshengs rdzogs spang lhar gnang / dbang yod du gser bre bdun dang /lha rta brgya/ chu rta sngoni po sum brgya/ lha 'bri zal sa stong / klu lug kro mo khri phul nas sa thag ring po'i bar phebs skyel mdzad/ de nas thang lhas phul ba'i nor rdzas de rnams jag pas mthong ste bla ma bcom pas/ rwa le'i slob ma rwa chos rab kyis/ thang lha la/ khyed kyis bla par phul ba'i sku chas rnams mdang nub jag pas 'phrog sermeng bas rogs mi byed dam zhus pas/ de nub rang du jag pa de rnams ltog pas rshab sogs kyi 'ordzo rgyus khyad mtshar mang po 'dug pas zhib cha rnamothar der gzigs par 'tshal/

bkra shis tshe ring mched lnga/bkra shis tshe ring mched lnga/bka' brgyud bstan pa'i srung ma gtso sor bzhugs pa'i lha mo thobakra shis tshe ring mched lnga ni/rdo rje gdan gyi byang phyogs na/ /bal bode gnyis kyi sa mtshams na/ /gangs dkar shel gyi pode paṇa can/ /zhes spre btsun (7mi la ras pa'i mgur 'bum na/las byung ba'i jo mo bla rir gnas pa'i tshe ring mched lnga 'di rnams brtan ma bcu gnyis las sku(gas su med par bshad kyang / yang skabs 'gar gdul bya'i dbang gis lha mtshe tshe ring mched lnga zhes logs su mdzad srol mthod pa/ gang ltar lha mo tshe ring mched lnga ni/ bkra shis tshe ring ma/ mthing gi zhal bzang ma/ mi gamadze blo bzang ma/ pode paṇa mgrin bzang ma/ gtad dkar 'besna bzang ma ste lnga yin la/ lha sa 'di dag sngo ni yab rnyasna lha 'theng po dang / yum 'brang yul sman gcig ma gnyis la bu bdun dang / bu po lnga 'khrungs pa'i bu po spun mched lnga yin par bajod cing / tshe ring mched lnga'i lo rgyas zhib cha ma mthong yang /ska bas 'dir /rtsomi la ras pa/'i mgur 'bum do/las ༷grang ba rnams kha slong byas te bris na//rtamagur 'bum na/de nyid las/ spre btsun lags/ kho mo cag gis slob dpon pad ma 'byung gnas bod du byon pa'i dus su kha la rong rmo ra spo na bsus nas maco 'tshams la phyin pas/ slar phyag rgya gnyan po'i zing rog tu 99

bkra shis tshe ring mched lnga/mnan te bka' 'bangs bgyid par gtsigs pa phab/ rang sngags sre ga gi snying mdongs gsermel du phul/ de'i dus na'ang mdo rgyu 'bras kyi chos mang du thos/ yang rgya gar gyi dur khrod mun pa sgra rje tsheg ces bya bar rmethob dpon phyogs kyi be( cha dang / brtul zhugs ྅thod pa nag nge 'bas las dkyil 'kho ra chen ngethor dbang bskur ba thob cing / gsang ji gas rdo rje theg pa'i chos mang du cos/zhes byung ba ltar/ spre btsun mi la'i drung nas lha sa 'di dag gis byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed de rtso zar gyi sdom len pa'i skabs su dri ba dris lan gyi tshul du zhus pa'i tshig 'bru 'di'i cog nas tshe ring mched lnga 'di dag sngoni chad rgya gar gyi dur khre da mun pa sgra rjethog ces par bzhugs pa'i khrathob dponi phyogs kyi skra chas dam la btags te/ brtul zhugs (1da pa nag po'i dkyil 'khethor du bcugs te/ dbang bskur/ byin gyis brlabs/ de nas :thob dponi pad ma 'byung gnas bod du byon dus kha la song sgorme zhes pa'i lung pa de'i mdo nas phebs bsu dang 'brel :thob dponi la glags 'tshol bas/ :thob dponi gyis drag 'dul mdzad pa bka' lha da kyi srung mar khas blangs/de'i spres suje btsun mi la ras pa'i drung nas sangs rgyas kyi bsnan pa'i srung par khas blangs pa'i 'otho rgyus ni/nga ྅thon spre btsun mi la ras pa de 57 (terje btsun mi la ras pa'i mgur 'bum na/dang / pa ṇa chen chos kyi nyi mas mdzad pa 'i (tshe ring mched lnga 'i cho sa 'dod 'jo'i bum bzang )/ (gsung 'bum pod ca pa'i nang bzhubs) zhabs drung 'jigs med nor bus mdzad pa'i 17lha sman rgyal sa bkra rshas tshe ring pa'i mchod chos tshe dang la myur 'grub man// (gsung 'bum pa pa'i mthog ngos 672 pa ra gsal) ma kha' khyab rdo rjes mdzad pa'i (rkebastan srung bkra shis tshe ring

bkra shis tshe ring mched lnga/nyid :thob dponi pad ma 'byung gnas kyis byin gyis brlabs pa'i gnas ri/sman lung chu dbar gyi dben gnas la 〉thom zhing bzhugs pa'i skabs/ chu phe ma'abrug gi mtho/ dbyar zla ra ba'i tshes bco brgyad kyi nam gung mthol ba tsam na/gnod sbyin skoza sa lnga gtso byasapa'i lha 'dre 'byung bo'i rigs mang po chogs nas/sa gamatho ba la semags pa'i cho 'phrul bsnyan pas/ rje btsun gyi thugs dbye ngas la/ spyir na lha 'dre 'di rnams sems kyi snang por tsam las/ doni du 'o gas su med pa mdo rgyud bstan bcos nas gsungs pa 'di yin/ 'od kyang 'byung bzhi gdos bcas kyi phung po 'di skyes pa'i mtha' ma 'chi ba yin pas/ khyed rang lha 'dre rnams la byin pas chog da lta bzung 'dzin 'phrul ba'i mig por lha 'dre'i gzugs brnyan mthong ba yin pas/ de la gzigs shing sgrag datre sa deni ci la 'di/ 'od kyang lan chags sha 'khoni du gnyer ba khyed rnams la zag bcas kyi phung po 'di ster gsungs nas rang gi lus byin nas/ da phyin chad bsam pa ngan pa zhi nagazag pa med pa'i snying je chen pos rgyud mthongs su gang bar gyur cig ces rnyed lam btab pas/ der tsholags pa'i lha 'dre rnams kyi sdig sems zhi nas gnodi sbyin spyodang / bye brag tu tshe ring mched lnga na re/ rnal mched lnga'i mchod 'phrin dgyes rgyu'i dpal bskyedan// (gsu nga 'bum yod kha pa'i nang bzhugs/ 1 (pa.o rgyan rin po che'i rnam thar zang sa gling man// (lha 'dre'i bka' thang na/snyen rgyan gling pa'i gter ma sethogs yig cha khungs ldan rnams las thar thor gsangangab snying bsdus shig bris pa yin kyang / mtho rgyus zhib cha 17mi la'i mgur 'bum na/mcho sngon mi rigs dpe skrun khung ga lcags dpar ma'i shog ngos 471 nas 731 bar gsal bas der gzigs par zhu/1(31

bkra shis tshe ring mched lnga/'byethor ba khye da lus la mi chags par sha khrag mchodi sbyin mdzad pa 'di shin tu nge mtshar che/ da phyin chad sems can la gasnadi 'tshe mi byed zer nas khe re rnams gnong zhing 'aspyodi pa skyes nas spre btsun la 'aspu(da bshags phul bas/ rje btsun gyis/ spyir phyi rol gyi lha 'dre bar du gcedi pa thams cad rang re'i rnam rtog gi nyer len las byung ba yin/ khyed chos zer ba ltar bden pa red/ 'od kyang nga rnal 'byor ba'i lugs la skyed du mi blta/ lus ngag dge spyor ② bskul na bsam gtan myur du skye ba'i rgyu yin/ bdud rigs chos skyetsheng du zhal 'gyur zhing / chos skyong spral skur mthong bas rkyen dngos grub tu 'bab/bar chad lam du slong / rnam rtorgo chos skur shar/ gsung skyed marsha grol te thun sang lam gyi sne zin pa'i zab chos mang posam mar ba 'ikhotsā ba'i gsung drangasate mgur gyi lam nas tshe sa 'chad pas/ der sku'od lha 'dre rnams 'argyadi nas bzede gsemal zhus/ da phyin chad khyedi kyi bka' gsung ltar bsgrub zer nas dam bcas/de na chu sa sbra la gyi mtho/ dbyar zla ra ba'i tshes bcu gcig gi nub por/ mdzes sdug slad du 'ongs pa'i bu mo lnga byung ste/ rje btsun la phyag 'tshal nas/ ba men gyi zho phul nas rje btsun gyi g.yod zur du bsngad nas nged cag rje btsun gyi drung du ཿthos zhu bar bcar ba yin zhus pas/ rje btsun gyis lha 'dre yin par besna nas/ khyed rnams nas sngoni chad byas pa'i las la 'argyadi pa'i sems kyis rma 1thol zhing bshags pa dang / da phyin chad sems can la gnodi cing 'tshe ba mi byed par dam bcas na/ skyabs 'gro'i sems bskyed sbyin 3thog gsungs pas/ de ltar khas blangs te skyabs 'gro'i bslab rdzom dang / ngo sa sgrol pa'i rig pa gtad pa'i dbang bsku ra nas/ da phyin chad nga tsho dam 102

bkra shis tshe ring mched lnga/tshig bsdus pa'i dponi :thob yin pas legs nyes gang byung rung skyabs dkon maḥthog gsum ma galta gas gzhan mi 'atso la ba semags kyizab ཿthos mang porme gsungs de byang chub kyi lam la bkodi/ tshe ring mched lngas kyang sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa spyodang / khyad par du rje btsun gyi rigs brgyud du gtogs pa rnams bsrung zhing skyabs par bgyi'e zhes dam bcas/de lda bu'i lha sa bkra shis tshe ring mched lnga 'di dag bka' brgyud pa'i srung ma tsam du ma zad/ mi 'o dga' ldan pa'i rgyal ba sku phreng rim byed dang /paṇa chen sku phreng na rim gyi gsung 'bum khrodi du bkrashis tshe ring mched lnga'i mchod gtor dang / 'doni chog gsol kha/ lha sa 'di dag la brten pa'i g.yang 'bod sogs mang po mthong rgyu 'dug pa gang ltar slob dpon rin po che dang /rje btsun mi la bzhad pa'i rdo rje sogs kyi bka' sdod srung ma dang / bod kyi yul lha'i nang nas kyang shin tu rnying khe ngas sdi g.yang gi 'phrin las ((la ba zhig yin par gsungs sem/ /103

beg rtse/beg rtse/gzhung bsten srung ma khyad par can 'di dge lugs pa'i rgyal ba sku phreng rim byed dang / paṇa chen sku phreng rim byon gyis bsne na pa'i srung ma zhig yin la/yang 〈snas su dpal ldan sa skya pa rnams kyis gtsigs su 'dzin pa'i chos skyong zhig yin/ba( beg rtse'am dregs pa lcam sring du grags pa'i srung ma 'di'i mtho rgyus ni/— sngoni rgyal po gser gyi shugs can dang / btsun mo ātpala'i rgyan gnyis la sras spun mched gnyis 'khrungs pa'i gcen ngo/'i ming la grags ldan zer zhing ba3snam ldan 'das shākya thub pa yin pa dang / gsung po'i ming la grags skyes zer ba da lta'i bog rtse 'di nyid yin/nar sod pa na khong gnyis cho sa kyi lda ba ma mthun par brten/ tshetshe 'etshe su rgyal na de'i lta ba'i rjes su 'brang rgyu thag bcad nas cho 'o tho'agyed pas gcen po rgyal nas/ da khyed rang nga'i tshe sa la zhugs dbeshas zer bas/ gcung pe sa ma chos skyong 'di'i yo rgyus tshar chen blo gsal rgya mchos mdzad pa 'i (7beg rtse'i yo rgyus ga) las byung ba 'o1 rgyus gzhan dag dang sbra bas nas gnad bsdus tsam bsko da pa yin/ma chos skyong 'di'i mtshan gyi rnam grangs ni/ gnod sbyin chen po zangs kyi beg rtse dang /btsan gyi rgyal po/ ag sa rgyal po/ jag me'i yab/ btsan rje zla ba zod dkar bcas se / /104

beg rtse/ma nyan par bros/ gcen gyis rjes 'ded byas te bzung skabs nga bsad kyang tshetshes la mi zhugs/ de bas nga 1thongs dang ma 'etshengs pa na ngas khyed kyi bstan pa srung bar khas len/ da lan nga cis kyang glerdzod zer nas 'grerdzo skabs/ gcen pos dpang rtags su bse'i mda' gzhu dang / byu ru'i dbyug pa/ ya lad bcas gnang sne/ ming 〈snag bdag yab shud dpar ngetho zhes btags nas gcen po'i drung nas brnya na nga/ bsrung bar dam bca' mdzad de gcen nge/ dang zhal gyes/de nas bcermem ldan 'das sangs rgyas nas ring ngo ma 81na pa zhig na/ga'edi sbyin zangs kyi ral pa can dang / srin 〈sna khrag gi ral pa can gnyis la byu ru'i slo nga gnyis btsas/ rmo nga de gnyis bar snang du 'phur nas gza' 'dul ba dang / sa gzhir 'dzul nas klu 'dul te mthar pha ma gnyis kyang gsod la nye skabs/ pha ma gnyis gnod sbyin ma hā de wa zhes pa'i rtsar song ste rlo nga de gnyis 'dul ba'i skyabs 'jug zhus pa de bzhin gnod sbyin ma hā de was ting nge 'dzin la snyerdzoms par bzhugs pa'i ngang nas kha ṭaṃ g.yugs te 〉tho nga gnyis brtol ba'i nang nas khye'u dpar pe thosgra gnya' ltag tu khebs pa/ zangs kyi beg rtse dang ral kha spyod pa/ bsre'i mda' gzhu dang zangs kyi ral gri bsnams pa/byu ru'i mkhar pa 'dzin pa zhig byung skabs/ ma hā de was gnod sbyin khyod su yin zer bas/ mi dmar des/ nga gshin spre gshed po'i gsung gi spral ba yin/ nga'i ming la skyes bu dbang gi mdog can zer/ srog bdag darmor po yin zhes dri ba dris lan gyi tshul du (7ma ru rtse gshan pa sgrol byed kyi rgyud na/cha tshang gsungs par grags/dus phyis ྅/rgya gar gyi gsang sngags la mkhas par grags/ pa 65 tsa ra nyi 'od ces pa zhig gis ma hā de wa'i drung nas ma ru rtse'i rgyud kyi phyag len cha tshang 105

beg rtse/gsan pa dang / (7rgya gar bam po dmar na/po zhes pa'i srung ma 'di'i rgyud gter nas btoni te sgru ba thabs mdzad pas shin tu mthu rtsal che ba byung / de nas a tsa ra nyi 'od kyi rang gi bu paṇa ṭi da zla ba nag stor (7ma ru rtse'i rgyud na/kyi gdams pa yongs su gtad cing / des rang gi bu a tsa ra dpar po zhes pa de nyid la gtad/ phyis su a tsa ra dmar po bod du phebs skabs/ grwa zang gtsug lag khang du par ba mtho tsā bas chos skyethong 'di'i sgra ba thabs sogs kyi phyag len gsan cing a tsa ras phyag sogs mdzad nas chos bhyong 'di'i rgyud cha tshang bod yig tu bsgyur gnang mdzad/de nas gnyan che( tsā ba dar ma grags kyis a tsa ra dpar po'i drung nas chos skyo nga 'di'i gdams ngag yongs surdzogs pa gsan nas (rwasprib thabs chog bskul na/ zhes pa gsar :tshem mdzad nas rgya cher spel/ gnyan 'o〉 tsā bas gnam kha'u gnang ba dang / gnam kha'u nas sa chen kun dga' snying ngethos gsan pa phyis sus chen gyis rang gi nye gnas sa ba shud pu bkra shis 'od zer la srung ma 'di'i chos rlo ra mthongs rdzo gas gnang des grub chen 'dar phya ru ba zhes par gnang zhing / phyis su grwa ba mngon shes (1012——1090)kyis chos skyo nga 'di'i chos skor gter nas bcetshen rte 'chad spel mdzad par grags/yang (7slob dpon rin po che'i rnam thar na/khag las 'phros nga/'i lo rgyus ni/ sngon chad klu'i co brang bsam gtan gling zhes pa der klu'i rgyal co khri gtsug brnya na nga bya ba khrig skud/da/ de la sras zhig 'khrungs pa'i mtshan la nā ga be li ta zer/ de tshe 'phos nas 'dzam bu gling gi dbus kyi rgyal po yon tan rab gsal gyi sras su 'khrungs pa'i ming la tsan tre badzra zer zhing / nar soni ska bas rab tu byung nas 'gre 03 bskyangs/ de tshe 'phos nas yab gang co dang 106

beg rtse/yu/ma lag bzang bya ba gnyis kyi sras su 'khrungs/ 'dis 'jam dpal ye shes sems dpa' brnya/bas pas 'al mnged sum du gzigs/ mthu rtsal bsam gyis mi khyab pa shārnyes par gyur te bcom ldan 'das kyi sbyan sngar bsnan pa bsrung bar khas blangs/ batshe ma ldan 'das kyi bka' ltar srin ngetho ya man tā ka 'dul bar bskos pa de nas bzung ma ru rtse ru grags /de nas ma ru rtse de nyid yul gru gu'i rgyal po rta mgo can zer ba des lha ru bzung nas mchodi pa phul te mtshan yang ku be ra zer/ de bzhin du rgya nag rgyal posna rgya rje btsan nge thozhu bas rgya yul he ta'i srung mar mchodi de mtshan mdung dmar can du grags/ de nas bodi du 〈snab dponi pad mas chos rgyal khri sre nga lde'u btsan (790——844)gyis rgya nag dang gaX/la 'khrug skabs rgya dpag cham la phab pa'i ched dmag gi dugra lhar bskos te bod khams skyong ba'i srung mar gyur pa zhig yin par gsungs/chos skyong 'di'i chos skor mang po yodi pa dper na/ gnubs sangs rgyas ye shes (841—— )kyis mdzad pa'i 17sretreg bdag yab shud dpar po'i sgrab yigan/ ru lag rgyang gi brag nas bte pa 'i srung ma 'di'i sgrab thabs/ stospa 〈sna skyer chu dang mang yul byams pa sprin gyi lha khang nas bteni tpablo (7beg rtse'i sgrab thabs na/ sogs ha cang ma nga ngo / /sto beg rtse 'di'i snyan brgyud bod du ji ltar byung ba'i rim pa rags tsam ma (lha 'dre bka' thang zhinang nag rgya lha phu 'es pa'i banas rir slob dpon rin po che'i drung nas grub sob 'dar chas srung ma 'di'i rgyud gsan pa ra 'khod 'dug pas brtab dbos/107

beg rtse/ paṇa chen blo bzang chos kyi nyi mas mdzad pa'i /tshelcam sring gtor chog gsar bsgrigs kyi nang mchodi zur bsdebs na/las/bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pa/ lha chen ma hā de wa/ a tsā nyi 'odi grags pa/ sras zla ba nag tho/ paṇa ṭi da ṅga ya ṅga ra'i/ gnyan po 'o tshetsā ba dar ma grags/ gnam mkha'u dar ma seng ge/ sa skya kun dga' snying po/ 3snas bu bkra shis 'od zer/ grub thob 'dar 'phyar ba rin chen bzang po/ po dong ba brtson 'grus rdo rje/ jo sras sangs rgyas rin chen/ slob dponi shes rab rgya matsotho/ bla ma bsede nams dbang phyug lcang spe ba seng ge 'bum/ kun mkhyen dpal ldan seng ge/ ཿthos rje rin chen bkra shis/rte gas ldan mabo na posna/ bla ma gzhoni nu dpal/ kun mkhyen mus srad pa chen ngo/ rje shes rab rin chen/ tshar chen blo gsal rgya mtsho/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse dbang phyug rje btsun bsede nams tshe sa 'phel/ grub mchog dbang phyug rab brtan/ rje bsedi nams mchog ldan/ zur chen chos dbyings rang grethol/ rgyal dbang lnga pa blo bzang rgya mtsho/ gnas brtan 'jam dbyangs grags pa/ 'khul zhig mang the sa rgya mtshorme/ 'jam dbyangs bde ba'i rdo rje/ ngag dbang mchog ldan/ grub brnyes dge legs rgya mtsho/kle nga ba)thol bla ma ngag dbang blo bzang / blo bzang mkhas btsun/ grub mchog blo bzang bstan 'dzin/ paṇa chen blo bzang dpal ldan/ spre bstan rgyan ཿthos 'phel/ blo snabazang bstan pa rgyal mtshan/ bde chen blo bzang tshul khrims sogs rim par brgyud pa'i lo rgyus zhib cha paṇa chen chos kyinyi ma'i gsung 108
beg rtse/'bum du gzigs par 'tshal 61 gsung 'bum yod nga pa'i shog ngos 440 nas 443 bar gsal/ 09

dam can rdo rje legs pa/dam can rdo rje legs pag /(dpal he ru ma'i spral bar grags pa 'i chos skyong chen po dam can rdor legs 'di'i skyes rabs sna/ sngoni sangs rgyas 'od srung gi dus su rje'i rigs shig tu 'khrungs te nar moni pa na/ 'odi srung gi drung nas dge bsnyen gyi 1thom pa blangs nas byang chub maḥthog tu sems bskyed/skabs shig rang skra/khyim mtshes la ra zhig 'di pa brkus nanu'idur khrode du semang ste ra bshas nas ra sha zas/ ra pags spuni nas pho mthong tshad bsad cing rme thom1rmeng tshad la 'khrig pa sprad cing bzhugs pa'i skabs/ nyin zhig shwa ba dug zas 62 dam can rdor legs kyisgor gtso bo (7shud pu'i yig rnying na/las byung ba'i yo rgyus dang /(lha 'dre bka' zang )/ (rdor legs zla ba'i rgyud)/ (rdor legs mgar nag ga rgyudan// (7dge bsnyen dgra gsang nag po'i rgyudan// 17rig 'dzin ra/gling pa'i gter yig na/bcas su gsal ba gzhir bzung nas snying bsdus shig bkod pa skyodun/0 rdor legs la seng zhon dang / ra zhon sogs ngo bo gcig kyang rnam pa mi gcig pa mang zhing / (rkerig 'dzin ra/gling pa'i gter yig ) sogs las dor legs 'di'i chibs su ra la zhon pa dang / dbu zhwa skya le brgan spu na pa/ phyag g.yas na rdo rje rtse dgu thogs pa/ gamadzen na mi'i steng 'dzin pa/ btsan 'khor sum brgya drug cus bskor bar gsungs pas brtag dbe|sa/110

dam can rdo rje legs pa/nas shi ba zhig gi sha zas pas rkyen byas te sku grethongs/de nas tshe 'phogate bdud gza' smin dkar ma zhesapa'i sras5'khrungasapa lhobo4rtsal 'gran zla bral bas sems can grangs med kyi sre ga bcad nas 'di pa'i skabs/ dpal rta mgrin thugs khros te phyag gi dbyug to 'phangs pas dbu la khel ba tshal bar gas nas rnam shes dag zhing du bkodi/de nas slob dpon pad ma 'byung gnas rgya gar g.ya' ri gong gi brag phug tu bsnyen mtshams la bzhugs pa'i skabs/ nyin zhig gi nam gung tsam la mi dkar seng ge dkar sa zhon pa/ lag na rdo rje rtse dgu 'dzin pa/ phying zhwa gyoni pa zhig mthong ste slob dponi la zhwa ma phud par phyag gsum 'tshal nas nga ngo mkhyen nam zhus pas/ 11ba dponi gyis ma mkhyen pa'i tshul mdzad nas khyedi su yin dris tshe/ mtho rgyus zhib par zhus pas :thob dponi thugs mnyes te dam tshig gi yi ge dzhainge ra bcug nas dam la btags/ des kyang bka' las mi 'da' ba'i mna' bskyal/ rjethog snying phul nas bstan pa bsrung bar khas blangs/phyigasaslobo dponi bodi du byed dus rdor legs kyis bsu ba mdzad nas slar yang gsang sngags kyi bstan pa'i srung par gnyer gtad mdzad pa'i le rgyus zhib cha (7lha 'dre bka' thang na/nang gsal bar gsungs yode/yang (7rdor legs zla ba'i rgyud na/kyile'u brgyagasum pa lagabyung ba'i lo rgyus ni/ sngon srid pa'i bu mo lnga'i nang tshan che zhe mu kha le dang / bdud po yang rje bla med gnyis la rdo je legs pa 'di 'khrungs shing / nar soni skabs/bu de'i snying gar rme ba nag po zhig 'di pa mtshan mkhan la brtag pa zhugapa shin tu bzang bas phyag na rdo rje la dbang bskur du bcug zer ba ltar masagasang bdag gidrung du 'khrid de rgyu mtshan zhus pas/ gsang bdag gis dbang bskur zhing 111

dam can rdo rje legs pa/mtshan la rdo rje legs pa zhes gse la/de yang (7dor legs pagar nag gi rgyud na/le'u brgyasalasabyung ba'i mtho rgyus ni/ sngoni rgya gar gyi gnas ri sum ro phyags zhes pa'i yul zhig na srin po byi la'i gdong can dang / yum bdud sa spre'u gdong can gnyis la bu spyang zhi'i gdongo pa can shin tu 'jigs su rung ba zhig skyes pa nar mod skabs gshis spyodi rtsub pagasdig lasagatshogalobyed bzhin pa yul 'brog gnas grethong khyer zhes pa der drang myong sra se na zhes pa'i ra rdzi zhig yodi pa'i ra khyu'i khrod nas sbyang zhi'i gdong pa can gyis ra bsad nas zas pa drang srong yid ma rangs nam bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar song ste sbyang ki'i gdong pa can 'dul ba'i gsol ba btab/bcom snan 'dam kyis gsang ba'i bdag po la bka' bstsal te/ gsang bdag drag po'i skur bzhengs nas srog gi snying po mdongs gsol du phul bar gratha/sa/yang kho ga spyang rol ba'i rgyud na/las slo lung bzhad pa'i rdo rjes bdus pa gong gsal ma thorgyus dang cung zad mi mthun pa lta bu zhig gsungs pa 'dir dpyad gzhi'i ched bawo na/sngoni rgya gar gyi gnas ri sum ro myagasazhesapa'i yul du srin posde'u'i gdong can dang / bdud sa khrag gi gdong can ma gnyis la bu moni pa nag po zhes mthu rtsal shin tu che ba zhig 'khrungs/ bu de nar sod skabs gshis rgyud rtsub drags pas bdud kha la me 'bar dang 'thab pas mtshoni phe ga ste nyethongs/skyeb gyim yul gnyan zhes par mgar ba batshe rig la shin tu mkhas pa mtshan rdo rje bde mchog ces pa cig mde pa phyag na rdo rjes srog gi snying po bzhes nas 'dul bar grags/112

dam can rdo rje legs pa/yang (7dge bsnyen dgra gsang nag po'i rgyud na/laga'adi ltar gsungasate/ sngoni phyag na rdo rje 'khor dang bcas pa lcang lo can gyi gnas na bzhugs skabs/ 'khore gyi nang nas lha chen tshangs pa snan las bzhengs te phyag na rdo rje la lha ra ba gsum mdzad nas gnodi sbyin ser skya nag pordor legs)'dul ba'i gsol ba btab pa ltar/ phyag na rdo rjes dbang bskur nas bsnan pa'i srung mar bsgos pa'i lo rgyus 'di pa/ gang ltar rjes su lo chen bee ngo tsā nas chos skyong 'di'i chos skori rnams bsgyur te spel ba kong chen rab 'byamasapa'i 17bsnan srung dam can rgya mtsho'i rnam thorjo dam can dga' byed na/las gur mabe(na gyi 'etho rgyus 'chad pa'i skabs sagasungs/chogaskyong 'di'i chos skor khungs ma rnams ni/ khodam can rdo rje legagapa'i gsang sgrab dgra bo'i srog gi skru gri na/dang / (7dam can mgar ba nag po'i rgyud )/ ga (dam can skyes bu chen po'i sgrub skor)/ khodam can pagar ba nag po'i 'phrin las rjes gnang dang bcas pa dam snan re skong na//17bka' srung dam can rdo rje legasapa'i srog gi'akhor lo'i sgrab thabagaskore lagaphyi sgraban// 17gter srung rdo rje legs pa'i rjes gnong bstan srung snying bcu〉༄// 17zugs rje chen po'i bka' srung rdo rje sman btsun lcam dral gyi sgrab zabs )sogs (rgyud 'di dag (rin chen gter mdzod )stod nyi pa'i nong gsal )sgrab thabs dang chos sgor mang po bzhugs/ de lta bu'i chos skyong chen po 'dig gsang sngags spyodang / khyad par du dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i bka' sdod kyi srung ma yin te/ rig 'dzin rasna gling pa'i gter yig (7dam can rdo rje legs pa'i gsang sgrub srog gi skru gri na/las/thugs rje chen po gsang ba 'dus pa yi/ /113
