tsi'u dpar/ tsi'u dmar/srung ma 'di'i ma tshergyus gter stoni pad ma dbang rgyal gyis bsam yas mchims phu nas gdan drangs pa'i (7spu gri dpar po'i rgyud na/las gsungs pa'i 'itshe rgyus ltar snying bsdus tsam bkodi na/sngon sangs rgyas 'edi srung gi sku dus su yul lcang ra smug po zhes pa de na rgyal po li spre gsang ba dang / btsun sa utpala'i bdag sa gnyis la sras shig 'khrungs pa'i mtshan la li sras mcho ra po zir ba phyis sunges 'byung gi bsam pa skyes nas rab tu byung /de nas nags tshal zhig gi nang gcig pur :rdzom zhing bzhugs pa nyin zhig yul de'i rgyal po'i sras mo bde ba 'byin zer ba zhig yode pa nags tshal de'i nye 'dabs su khrus kyi rdzing bu zhig yod pa de'i nang khrus byed bzhin yod skabs/dug sbral chen po zhig gis so brgyab pa dge slong gis mthong ste rtswa sman gyi lde gu byugatsu bzhin pa 'khor gamathog gis mthong ste dge slong dang sras mo gnyis nas 'khrig pa ྅rtod bzhin 'dug ces rgyal por snyan phra zhus skabs/ rgyal pothos brtag dpyad ma byas par dge :thong gsede pa'i pho nya btang ba sras mos cos 'phral 'ordzo rgyus zhib par zhus kyang ma gsan stabs/ nga dang dge :thong gnyis la nyes pa med bzhin du 'khethor gasku(ga gi phra ma gsan na nga skye ba phyi par dge slong dang lcam sring du gyur te khyed rang 'khor dang bcas pa gsode par shog ces dasad btsugs te g.yang la mtshe ngas nas lcebs/ tshul de dge : thong gis gsan pas/ rgyal 115

tsi'u dmar/po'i khrims chad la 'jigs nas rta zhoni nas yul phran gzhan zhig gi rgyal por skyabs bcermel bar semang /de nas dge slong de yid chad nas/ pho mthong tshad kyi sge bregs/rmetho macwathong tshad la mdzeg g.yem mdzad cing bzhugs pa rgyal po sa yul dmag bsdus te dge slong bzung nas bkrongs/ sku gshegs khar rgyal po 'khor dang bcas pa sre ga gcodi par 3thog ces smed lam mthog 'debs mdzad nas gshegs/tshe 'phos ma thag nub phyogs kyi dur khrod 'jigs su rung ba zhig gi nye 'gram du yab btsan rje zla ba cad dkar dang / yum gnod sbyin gdong dmar ma gnyis kyi sras su 'khrungs/ de nas sngar gyi sras mo thobade ba 'byin kyang khrim de'i sras mor 'khrungs pas/ khong gnyis spun mched du gyur te mtshan sras po spyan gcig ma zhes grags/sngar gyi smod lam gyi mthus spun mched gnyis nar soni pa na/ rgyal po 'khor dang bcas pa tshar bcad nas yul mi rnams sdug la skyethor bzhin pa'i skabs/ dpal rta mchog rol ba drag tu khros te gnod sbyin de'i srog snying bsdus nas dam la btags te/ (7gnod sbyin spu gri dpar po'i rgyud na/cha tshang gsungs/de nas ma kha' 'gro ma rdo je bde byed ma zhu ba zhig gis sngar gyi gsungs pa'i rgyud de yi ger bris nas dur khrod me ri 'bar ba zhes pa'i brag gseb tu sbas te ya ba skya bdun zhes pa'i srung mar gnyer bcol mdzad par grags/rjes su smerdzob dpon pad ma 'byung gnas gnas der byed skabs ya ba skya bdun gyis bar chad brtsams pa slob dpon drag po'i skur bzhengs te drag 'dul mdzad skabs/ slob dpon la phyag 'tshal te skyabs su bzung du gsol zhes zhu 116

da wa tsi'udapar/ba 'then pa slo ba dpon gyis khyod su yin gsungs pas/ nga gnod sbyin tshi'u dmar bya ba yin/ sngoni chad dpal rta rma grin gyis dbang bskur zhing brnya na pa 'i srung par bache thos pa yin zhus pas/ :thob dponi gyis dam la btags te mtshan kun khyab rdo rje drag po rtsal zhes gsol/de nagatsi'u dpar gyi rgyud cha tshang slob dponi gyis gter nas bzhes te bod du byed skabs srung ma 'di dang rgyud rnams spyan drangs nas bsam yas rta mgrin gling du rta mgrin gyi thugs kur gter du sbas te srung ma 'di yang rta mgrin dregs pa zil ga33 gyi bka' yi srung par barme thos /yang bshad tshul gzhan zhig sku(da pa ni/ pad ma gar dbang blo nyesas mtha' yas kyis mdzad pa'i /rterta mgrin gsang ba 'dus pa'i bka' srung gasnadi sbyin dpar nag gi 'phrin las rjes gnang dang bcas pa sgruthog 'gas 'khyil ba na/las/chos skyo nga chen po 'di nyid phyi ltar na lha srin sde brgyad rje po/ nang ltar na rnam sras mdung dmar can/ gsang ba gza' 3de mig dpar te spral ba'i cho 'phrul ci yang sto na pa yin la/ gsang chen rdo spre rtse mo'i brnya na pa rlung ba'i phyir du dregs pa rang rgyud pa'i tshul yang bzung bar mdzad de/ gu ru rin po che nyid dur khrodi bsil ba tshal gyi nub byang he chen brdal ba na shārnya rakṣita zhes pa'i mtshan bzung nas spyo ra skyo la brtul zhugs chen po'i spyodi pa mdzad pa'i skabs su 'di nyid gasnadi sbyin tag shā gdong dpar ces bya bar gyur pa spun dang grogs su sbrel ba de tshe 'phos nas gnod sbyin rag shā 'bar byed dang / srin sa dmar sham pa'i bu phung byed shan pa dpar nag bya bar skyes te/ mthu rdo bas rdzu 'phrul shin tu che bas sde brgyad yongs kyi rje dpon du gyur pa'i tshe/ bcom ldan 'das

ci'u dpar/gsang ba'i bdag pe sa 〈snag snying blangs te dam la bzhag sangs rgyas bstan pa'i srung par gnyer gtad/ gnod sbyin rang gis kyang rgyud sde gsol du phul/phyis slob dpon chen po bal yul yang le shedi du bzhugs pa'i tshe khorang dngos susku(nga nas 〈snag snying dang / rang rgyud kyang phul nas bstan pa bsrung bar khas blangs/ gu ru rin po che rang nyid kyis kyang thun mong ma yin pa'i bstan srung du bstothos/ sgrub thabs rgyas bsdus mang du mdzad nas gter kha rnams sbas/ོzhes be nga gsal lesna rgyus dang cung zad mi mthun pa lta bu zhig gsungs pa/ gang ltar phyis su gzhung bsten srung par gyur pa deng sang mthongs grags su bsam yas chos skyethong chen po zhes pa 'di yin no/ /4 (parin chen gter mdzod ga/pod nyi pa'i nang yod pa'i (9gnod sbyin shan pa dmar nas gi 'phrin las rjes gnang dang bcas pa blo ga zhags 'khril ba na/zhes pa'i 3tsheg ngos nas 7 pa bar gas04/118

rdo rje g.yu sgron ma/rdo rje g.yu rsā ma/gibartan ma5 bcu gnyis kyi gtso mo ṭa rje g.yu sgroni pa'ang gangs dkar sha med du grags pa 'di nyid kyi mdze rgyus ni/ sngoni rgya gar nub phyogs skye'o rgyan gyi yul na rgyal yo zhin dra bo ddhi la zer ba der bu po lnga 'di pa'i nang nas che ba lha lcam le min kā ra zer ba des rang gi ming po rmedang mnyam du 'khrig pa spyad pas/0 (rig 'dzin 'ja' chon snying tsho gter byon gu/ rje chen sa ngan song rang grol )/(7brtan mdos dpyid kyi rgyal mo'i thu dbyangasan//(7lha 'dre bka' thong na/o rgyan gling pa'i gter ma/ (rdo rje gzhog rgod ma'i bstod pa )/ (rin chen gter mdzod na/bcas su byung ba rnams bsdus te bris pa yin/ lha sa 'di brtan ma bcu gnyis kyi nang ma tshud pa med kyang / (7rdo rje gshog rgod ma'i 'phrin las 'dod 'jo snye ma'i na/nang /sman btsun chen sa (tshe ring mched lnga )mched lnga dang / /brtan ma bcu gnyis 'khor gyis ba〉thor/ /sman phrag 'bum phrag du mar bcas/ /mcho da sbyin gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol/ /((7rin chen gter mdzod )pod nyi pa'i nang gi gong gsal dpe ming gi shog ngos 3 par gsal)zhes brtan ma bcu gnyis las mthogs su mdzad pa dang / mtho rgyus mang shos kyinang brtan ma bcuganyis rdzogayu sgron ma rang dang ngo bo tha mi dad par gsungs pa dgongs gzhi sku'od par snam nas skabs 'dir mthogs su bris pa yin lags/tho 17thang yig na/las bstan ma zhes bris 'dug pa ma zad/ yig rnying rnams su'ang 'bri tshul gcig gyur med pas brtag daskra(sa/119

spre bye rje g.yu 6sgron ma/yab kyi chad pa phog pa la mos/ da lan khyed kyis chad pa ma gcod/ de bas kho mo rang gis srog bcad chog zer nas/ ral gris mo rang gi sge bcad tshe khrag dkar pe thobabs pa dbugs ma chad par co brang la bachesnar ba lan bdun byas pa thams cad kyal mtshan te/ ming la phag rmetho dbugs ma chad ma chen rmetho zhes par bkutha/sa//de ltar bu mo tshe 'phos te bod du yab lha rgyal stag zhu dang yum gang sman rgyal mo gnyis kyi sras su 'khrungs shing / phyis su slob dpon rin po che cod du byon ska bas bal bodi gnyis kyi sa mtshams lha ri gangs ri dkar por gnas shing bzhugs pa dper na/ rgyal dbang lnga pas mdzad pa'i /tshabartan mdos dpyid kyi rgyal mo'i glu dbyangs na/las/lha phu gangs ri dkar po ru/ /gangs kyi yum chen 'edzid 'bar ma/ /sha med khyod kyi gsang ba'i mtshanang/ /rde thorje g.ya bun ma ru btags/ /da mi nga sastod rdzo gzhas gsungs pa ltar lha phu gangs rar gnas pa' rda rdza g.yu sgra na ma 67 rgyal dbang lnga pa'i gsung 'bum pod ca pa'i ཿthog ngos 13 par gsal/ཿ phreng 'grogater gton shes rab 'od zer gyis gter nas bdon pa'i (rdo rje gshog rgod pa'i bstod pa na/las rdo rje mchog ma dang / 'brog bza' lha rgyal ma/ gar dbang ma/gnas g.yon ma/ gong btsun de sa/ rdo rje bod khams skyo nga / lha sa 'od 'bar rma sermegs mtshan gyi rnam grangs su gsungs shing / pon gyi mtho rgyus nang 7 sa 'di'i mtshaX 120

rdo rje g.yu sgron ma/'di nyid slobo dpon rin po che mkhar nag la khar byon skabs gangs dkar sha med mas phyag mdzub mdzad nas bkra shis chu nang du g.yugs pa de ma thag re( rang gi bla mtsho dpal mtsho zhes pa de'i nang du bros/ slob dpon gyi mtsho khar rdo spre bzhag —drag 'dul mdzad pa mtshe 'detshel nas mo'i lus kyi sha thams cad 'tshigs nas keng dus dkar seng nger song / mtsho khar bros byon pa/sa rlo ba dpon gyis rdo je 'phangs nas mig g.yas pa zhar/ de nas smerdzob dpon gyi spyan sngar mthong nas ji gsung thams cad bsgrub rgyu'i dam bcas te sdusag snyi nga phul nas dam la btags/mtshan sha med rdo spre g.yu sgro ni ma zhes gsol te gter kha zhig gi gter byang bcol ba'i lo rgyus zhib cha (7lha 'dre bka' thang na/las/de nas mkhar nag la khar byethon tsan:gangs dkar mo'i brkungs sog 'thums:1thog dpar dgu ni dus gcig phab:slob dpon phyag mdzub bkra shis chu nang bskyar:mo breng dpal mo dpal mtsho'i nang du bros༈rdo rje mcho khar bzhag nas mcho khol 'i mo'i sha rus bye nas keng rus dkar sengs song ji mcho nag gyon mtsho 'di'i sgo chod dam:de skad zer te mtsho khar bros te byung :slob daphro rdo rdze 'phangs pas mig zhar sobar chod byed na de khyer de la gom/:la 'phrul zhang ting zhes bris 'dug pas brtag dbo sa/ 121

rdo rje g.yu sgron ma/slob dpon spyan drangs 'di skad zhu:kyi ston pa'i zhal skyin rdo rje thod 'phreng rtsal bar gcod mi bgyi thugs dam dgongs la lhodaji sku ma'i phung po 33 sang snying re rje:'bras su sems 'di zhe ma 'tshol bas nyams:ci bgyi bka' nyan 11ba dponi 'bangs su mchi 〈snag snying phul nas dam la btags:gsang mtshan sha med rdo rje g.yu sgred ma:gter kha gcig gi gter byang bcol:zhes gsungs kyang / lo rgyus 'ga' zhig las rma chen sbom ra'i nye 'gram du gnas pa'i gzhi bdag 'dar bu stong thang rje'i sras sa yin par bshad/yang (7g.yu sgred ma'i 'phrin las 'dod 'jo snye ma na/las/ཿthos khrims bsnan pa'i snga rabs la/ /kun bzang dpal chen spyan snga ru/ /khas blangs dam bcas mna' besnar ba'i/ /g.yar dam gnyan po'i rjes su dgongs /de'i 'og bstan pa'i bar ma la/ /rig 'dzin pad ma'i spyan snga ru/ /khas blangs dam bcas mna' ngethor ba'i/ /g.yar dam gnyan po'i rjes su dgongs/ /de'i 'og nyang ban chen yo sogs/ /rig 'dzin brgyud pa'i spyan dza ru/ /122

rdo rje g.yu sgron ma/ khas blangs dam bcas mna' ngethor ba'i/ / 1 g.yar dam gnyan po dgotengasasu gsol/ / rtazhes rim par brgyud pa'i 'o thorgyus mdo tsam gsal ba gang ltar/ bod kyi yul lha rnying gras 'khrul med cig yin cing / dus phyis su ris med ཿthos brgyud khag gi mabeshan khang dang btsan khang khag gi rtsig ldebs su brtan ma bcu gnyis kyi ldebs bris mang po mthong rgyu yode pa mdor na mdo dbus gtsang gsum du dar srol che ba'i srung ma zhig yin cing / phreng 'bo gter gtoni shes rab 'ode zer gyi khogater phro rdo rje gshog wo pa'i bar pa )las/o rgyan yul du chos dbyings mkha' 'gro'i gtso/ /rdo spre gdan sogs gtsug lag khang skyong ma/ /'od khams skyethong mdzad bstan ma mthongs kyi gtso/ /dpal ldan rdo spre g.yu sgron khyod la bstod/ /ces gsungs pa bzhin lha mo 'di brtan ma bcu gnyis kyi gtso mo lta bu'ang yin par gsungs so/ /7 (rin chen gter mdzod )pod nyi pa'i bong 'khod dpe ming gi shog ngos 7 nas 7 bar gsazung/71 (7rdo je gshog rgod pa'i bstod pa )lag bris pa'i shog ngos 2 par gsal/123

sridapachagasapa'ilhadagu/ ———srid pa chags pa'i lha dgu/(7rgyal yo bzhi mgyogs kyi rdzongs na/zhes pa'i gter yig las byung ba'i lo rgyus ni/ spo na nam mkha' nas 'od thig rdog po gcig byung ba'i nang nas rmo nga zhig byung / de brdol ba'i nang nas mi 'jigs su rung ba stag gi gzugs can mchu to thung zhing mche ba rno ba zhig byung /yang rgya mtsho'i nang nas :tho nga zhig byung ba'i nang nas klu mo bya rbode kyirnam pa ya mchu gug cing sder sa rno ba zhig byurngachi / nam zhig stag dang bya rgod de gnyis byang khams sna brgyad ces pa'i yul zhig tu sha ba dar ma rang ༷thog rang gis bcad pa zhig gi ro'i 'khris su 'dzoms nas/ stag gis sha ba'i ro'i stod nas zas/ bya rbede kyis smad nas za skabs stag gi kha chu bya rgod kyi khar serdzong sne/chags pa'i sto bos kyis 3 ma mar gyur/der bya rnya ga gnyis gros byas te sgo nga gtong ma'i tshang 'tshal du song bas/ sems can gzhan gyis gzhedi pa'i dbang gis tshang 'a〈snag sa zhig ma rnyed par rim gyis shar phyogs rgya yul shel dkar po'i g.yu bad can zer ba der thon skabs/ zla ba tshang nas dung gi sgo nga dkar po dgu dang / lcags kyi rmo nga sngod sa dgu skyes pa'i nang nas rgyal chen gnam lha dkar po dang / 'o de gung khu 'di dag gi lo rgyus ni/ (rgyal po bzhi mgyogs kyi rdzongs)((rin chen gter mdzodan/ pod sta pa'i nang gsal )dang / bon gzhung (7gzer migan// /rtesrid pa'i mdzod phugan/ bcas su gsal ba snying bsdus tsam bkod pa yin/124

srid pa chags pa'i lha dgu/rgyal mgul lha bsang ba/ stag gi dkar po de gcen po bzhi dang / steng gung spyan gcig dang / g.ya' spung skyes gcig btsan 'asku nga dmar petho/yab shud dpar yo ste gcung bo bzhi 'khrungs pa'i spun mched dgu la sre ga bdag rgyal po thomached dgu zhes grags/rim bzhin lcags kyi 〉tshe nga'i nang nas gnam 'atre nga sngoni po/ bar 'gong khra bo/ sa 'gong nag yo/ 'phung 'grong dpar po ste gcen bzhi dang /de nas ltogs gnya' gnon/ rgyal 'gong 'od can/ 'phung 'gong shu can/ ngan 'atre nga ser betho/ byur 'bo nga gnya' bdud bcas gcung be snalnga ste 'arbegeng so spun dgur grags pa bcas 'otho rgyus kyi rtsal bon pa zhig mi 'dug rung gna' dus kyi yig char sethong gshis rtsa chen du rtsis nas bskasnad pa yin/'di'i kha skong du lo rgyus tshad 'pher gzhan zhig mthong ba ni/ g.yung drung bon gyi bstan 'byung khag las byung ba'i mtshe rgyus yin te/ de yang ྅rngon nam mkha' nas sprin dkar perdzo 'khrig pa'i nang nas lha gcig thang gi rgyal ba zhes pa zhig byung / 'dis rdzu 'phrul gyis sku lha gnam gyi 'then dgu dang / sa'i 'then gnyis byung / de gnyis 'dus pa las bu bdag cag 'al 'e la dang /bu sa bsre ba gnyis byung / de gnyis 'dus pa las las chen spre dang /mgon sras lha je/ lha brang chen/ 'brong je 'o de gung rgyal sogs srid pa'i 73 yang zer sre la gzhan zhig la/ sku lha 'od 'then de'i sras sku gnam 'then dang / de'i sras sku lha gung thang / de'i sras lha char 'phen/ de'i sras lha mang 'then/ de'i sras sku rten 'then/ de'i sras sku lha nying 'then/ de'i sras sku lha ma 'then/ de'i sras sku lha tshangs 'then yin zhes bshad 〈snal yang 'dug125

srid pa chags pa'i lha dgu/ lha rabs mched bzhi byung /nam zhig spun mched bzhi spang steng du gdan bstang nas 3tho rtsen pas/bgres rim bzhin sho rgyal ba gling 'dir dbang bsgur ba'i rten 'brel du go nas yab lha brdal nam mkhar sermeng / phya lha bam smon phywa yul chu chen du serdzong /rgya lha 'brong rnam rgya yul du song / 'o de gung rgyal bod du o te gling dgu'i bdag po snamadzad/de nam yab lha brdal phrug la sras bdun dang sras rme thogacig byung ba/gtso rong bcos po dang / khri dkar snag gzigs/ then tshe zo 'brang /gnam btsan sa btsan/ gnam 63ba/sa sa 6)gas/ ba/nam zin sa zin/khri bar bdun tshigs te sras bdun dang / thang nga lha mo sne sras sa gcig bcas brgyad 'khrungs/de nas gtso rong bcos po zhes pa de la sras sku lha mur ma sogs sras gsum 'khrungs pa de dag rgya nag gi dgra lhar bkur/ then tshe zo 'brang la sras gnyis 'khrungs pa rgan pa sku lha dgra rgyal dang / gzheni pa le phying he dgu gnyis gru gu'i dgra lhar gyur/gnam btsam sa btsan la sras pho lha dpa' nge thodang / dpal bcu garting bcug dpa' ngetho mkhar dbru/ ste sras gsum/ gnam legs sa legs la sras pho lha dpa' bo dang / mo lha'i srin lha/ byis pa'i chung lha bcu gsum 7 'o de gung rgyal zhes pa'i mtshan ni/ bon lugs ltar na/ 'o de gung rgyal 'khrungs skabs 'od zer 'dzam gling du khyab cing lha'i dgung la bzhugs/ 'dre srin thams cad kyi dgung du rgyal ba'i rgyu mtshan gyis 'o de gung rgyal zhes thogs par bshad/126

srid pa chags pa'i lha dgu/'khrungs pa dang / gnams zin sa zin la sras ma༄tshe ba'i la btsan dang /dpa' ba'i gru btsan gnyis 'khrungs/phywa lha bam chen la sras lnga 'khrungs pa ste/ lha chung de de/ lce chung g.yang dkar/ phya lcam rna sa/ phya lcam nee rog phya lcam gting skyetsheng ste lnga'o/rgya lha 'brong gnam la sras dgu 'khrungs pa sde/ kha 'odi rgyal ba/ nyi 'od rgyal ba/ zla 'od rgyal ba/ brag lha 'khrungs khrung / gar gar gar rje/le por phyug yo/ kho go chen yo/ mgor de lha byang g.yung / khu bzhengs rgyal ba bcas 'khrungs/de nas 'o de gung rgyal gtsang stod du song nas thang nga gtsang mo dang 'dus pas sras gtsang lha phu dar 'khrungs yang skyid rong du song ste/ thang nga skyid sa dang 'dus pas sras skyid lha byam 'khrungs/ mdo re nag tu song ste/ mdo sa dang 'dus pas mdo lha ri bo 'khrungs/ yang yar klung sog mkhar du sermeng ste/ yar sa thang nga dang 'dus pas yar lha sham po 'khrungs/gnya' nang du semang ste / gnya' mo dang 'dus pas gnya' lha spyar po 'khrungs /kong por song ste/ mchis sa dang 'dus pas mchis sam lha thang bo 'khrungs/dwags yul shing nags su thang nga nag mo snadang 'dus pas dwags lha sgam yo 'khrungs/ kong yul bre snar song ste/ thang nga kong sa dang 'dus pas sras gung btsun de mo sna'akhrungs/ yum g.yu bya gtu(ga gcig ma dang 'dus pas

srid pa chags pa 'i lha dgu/ sras thang lha spun mched dgu 'khrungs kopar grags pa gang ltar/ sod kyi srid / pa chags pa'i lha dgu ni 'o de gung rgyal nas brgyud pa'i spun mched dgur grags sgyupa 'di yin zhing /'di dag gi gnas yul ni/ mkhar sgang gtsang stod na dwags lha spre dkar/ mang 'a ris bsto thor gsum na sku lha ge mthod/ myang yul snod smad na ha so gang bzang / g.ya' ri stod smad na shangs lha sge ru/ yar klung na yar lha sham po/ chos 'khor rgyal du rta rgod shel lca gas/ rsha 4yo na dwags lha sgam po/kong smad na kong lha dkar po/ nyang 'o kru ring na nyang lha btsan drug lho brag tu // lha mkha' ru/ ru mtshams na ༷/ lha snga bzhi/ 'dam na gnyan chen zang lha/khams na rma chen 〈snam ra bcas gnas par bshad pa 'di ngethon lugs ltar bris pa yin/ ( mjug gi rnam grangs nang gi srid pa chags pa'i lha dgu'i mtshan bris 'di pa der gzigs rtog gnang bar zhu/ )75 spun mched dgu co 'di dag gi mtshan dang / rigs rgyud/ yab yum se gas la bshad srol mi 'dra ba khag mang 'tshed pa dang / yang sgos su 'o/ rgyus 'ga' re'i nang55ba sras/la lar btso 'khor gyi tshul/ la lar spun mched du bshad pa sermegs sna chogs shig skuld cing / srid pa chags pa'i lha dgu re re'i 'otshe rgyus zhib gsal 'khod pa zhig bdag gis ma mthong yang / de dag gi nang nas grags che zhing 8thongs grags lta bu dper na/gnyan chen thang lha/ yar lha sham po/ rma chen sgom ra sogs kyi lo rgyus cung zad re rnyed pa so so'i 'o rgyus thad du gzigs par zhu/17

rma chen sgom ra/rma chen sbom ra/rtse/rma chen sbom ra'am ngo bo phying dkar ba'i lo rgyus ni/— sngon chad rgya gar bha ga la'i rgyal po bha ga la zhes pa jo bas 'gyor mnga' thang gis phyug pa 76 mi chen sbom ra la mtshan mang po byung ba gsung rab khag las btus te 'dir bkod na/jo co ni ser/ jo bo nying dkar ba/ dmag dpon jo co rgyal mtshan/ dga' ldan 'brog gi dge bsnyen/ gzhi bdag rdo rje dpal ldan/ rdo rje dpal rtsal/ mi chen 1tshemar/ pe ma rgyal/ dge bsnyen lnga ngermo rgyal mtshan serdzogs mtshan gyi rnam grangs shin tu mang /7 'di'i lo rgyus ni/ rje drung bzhad pa'i rdo rjes mdzad pa'i (7dmag dpon chen po jo bo rgyal mtshan gyi gserdzol maḥrmed btsan the|la rnam sol na/dang / (7bka' gdams glegs baman/ le'u bcu drug pa las byung ba'i (7dad pa brtan po'i rnam tharan/ paṇa chen blo bzang chos kyi nyi mas mdzad pa'i (7nee ser jo bo'i 'phrin skul bka' rgya man/( gsung 'bum gsum pa'i 31ga ngo 4 407 nas 703 bar bas la/ ) brag dbedan pa bstan pa rab rgyas kyis mdzad pa'i 17mdo smad chos 'byung deb ther rgya mtshog brag sgo rab 'byams pas mdzad pa'i /tsherje tsong kha pa'i rnam tharan/ (7bka' thang sde lngan/ bu'o rgyan gling pa'i gter ma/ paṇa chen blo bzang chos kyi nyi mas mdzad pa'i (ne ser jo bo'i gtor chog dngos grub 'gug pa'i shing rtan/(gsu nga 'bum pod gsum pa'i 'og ngos 47/ nas 404 bar gsal/ )129

ga mi ren sbo ma ra/zhig skuld pa de la byang chub sems dpa'i rnam spral sras dad pa brtan po zhes pa zhig 'khrungs/ nam zhig dad pa brtan po'i 65 dmo tshethor 'byin ma bya ba bstu na gyis // gshegs/ 75ba kyis ma yi/ra phag khra ma zhes pa zhig chung par blangs/ phag khra pa'i sems la/ sras dad pa brtan po de nyid dbang zob na kho mo dang kho mo'i bu la dbang mi zob par shes te/ phrag dog gi dbang gis na rdzu btab/ yun ring drag bskye da ma byung rnya bas/ rgyal ngo/ bha ga la na re/ khyed kyi nad 'di la sman bce sa dang rim grerdzo gang gis kyang mi phan par 'dug pas khyed la thabs 'dra e/ mdzed ces dris pas/ phag khra mas/ thabs shig ma/thod kyang khyed kyis nyan 6she mtsheng mi shes zer/ rgyal pos/ khyed la nga'i snying sprad na'ang phangs sems me da zer/ phag khra mas/ 'o na nga'i nad 'di drag byed la srin po'i grong khyer pang ka ngu/ra na me tog ku sha na zer ba'i sman zhig yod/ sman de khyed kyi bu dad pa brtan po serdzong na 'ordzon zer/ rgyal po'i sems la/ btang na ni rang gi bu srin po'i kha la bzhag pa dang khyad par med/ ma btang na ni btsun re ra sems chags pas btang na dga' snyam nas sras dad pa brtan perdzo srin po'i ༷/la du brdzangs/de nam dad pa brtan po de nyid srin yul/ du nyon la nye ska bas/ srin po 'i sgo srung dang po dang 'phrad de/ khyed rang gang nas yin/ gang du 'gro ma khan yin zer ba'i lan du snga phyi'i lo rgyus zhib mor zhus pas/ srin ngo 'i rmo srung na re/ khyed rang ma yar gyis phrag dog byas pa/ 'dra/ me tog ku sha ṇa zer ba de sman ma red/ srin ngo rgyal yo lang ka rma grin bcu'i bu mo/ yin/ sman zhes pa mtshar ba'i don dang / me/ tog ni mdzes nga 'i don mee/na/ ku sha ṇa zer ba mi nga ngo ma/ yin/ de khyed kyis mi lo/na/ de bas phyir glo na dga' zer/ dad 130

mi chen sgom ra/pa brtan po sa/ yab kyi bka' gcerdzog mi nyan/ srin ngethos zas na'ang sha khrag gi stod spu da 'di 'dor mi thub pa ci la yod zer bas/ srin po 'i rmo srung de rgyal sras gzhed nu de'i sni nga ྅ thobs la dad pa skyes nas phyag 'tshal te/ srin po'i grong khyer lang ka pur la 'betho ba'i lam kha dang / srin po rnams la ji ltar bshad daskra sa pa'i thobs shes bsla bas nas ma 'ongs pa na brnya na pa mnyam du spel ba'i smon lam btab sne/ bzhon pa glang chen zhig phul ba'i srin po'i 'o tho srung dang po 'di da lta'i jo bo phying dkar ba 'di nyid yin khring / rgyal/ sras dad pa brtan po 3/ 'phags pa sbya na ras gzigs bas ma ba'in mi 'i srid nga/ra bzung ba'i nang gi skyi rabs shig yin/de lta bu'i chos skyo nga 'di nyid 'phags pa spu na ras gzigs kyi gdul zhing la rnyethon lam mnyam du btab pa'i srung ma dam tshig la gnas shing / yang 〈 snas su bod kyi srid pa chags pa'i lha dgu'i nang gi yul 3 shin tu rnying khongs shig kyang yin/dus phyis su 'od du ji ltar byung ba ni/ pa ṇa chen blo bzang chos kyi nyi mas mdzad pa'i 17ne ser jo bo'i 'phrin skul bka' rgya man/ la/sa/sngo na tshe srin yul lang ga'i grerdzong khyer du/ /sa skyo nga dad pa brtan po'i spu na snga ru/ /thub brnya na srung la khas blangs dam bcas shing / /bden tshig ྅1na lam dag pas mtsham sa sbya ra ba'i/ /thugs bskye da rmo 'phar phye ba'i dus la/ babs/ /snang ma/tha'i rnam spral di bi ka ra (jo bo rje )dang / /sbya na ras gzigs dbang rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas so gas / /131

zhe 34byengebyed rte/sna34 snang/྅3 byed rnams kyi bka' gdams ring lugs maḥthog /gnyer du gtad pa'i srung par ma bste dzes sam /khyad par pad dkar 'chang dbang dge 'dun grub/ /dkyil 'khor gtso bo rnams kyi rdo rje bkas/ /bkra shis lhun gyis grub pa'i chos grwa che/ /phyi nang sgyudi bcud gter du gtad mdzad nas/ /spyi bor rdo spre bzhag nas bdud rtsi byin/ /tha tshig dam bca' gnyan ngetho rna bar bsgrags/ / rang gis khas blangs bzung ba bsnyel lam ci gzhes gsungs pa ltar/ chos skyong chen po 'di nyid spo na rtso na pa thub pa'i dbang po'i spu na snga ra byang chub mchog tu sems bskye da de brnya na pa srung par zhal bzhes gnang zhing dbang bskur/ de'i rjes su sems can rnams kyi tshe srog skyo ba pa'i ched du bsam bzhin srin po'i rgyal po la/nga ka mgrin bcu'i sgo srung gi skye ba bzhes nas 'phags nga/ sru na ras gzigs kyi rnam spri la rgyal sras dad pa brtan po dang / sngo na gyi las 'phro'i dbang gis tshul mjal te ma 'ongs pa na 'phags pa spya na ras gzigs kyi gdul zhing du brnya na nga srung bar dam bcas shing /de'i rjes su slo ba dang/ rin tho re rga du phro ska bas rla ra yang dam la btags pa 'i tshul mdzad pa /(lha 'dre bka' thang na/du gsal ba ltar dang / de nas dpal ldan jo so spre a rti sha sod du phebs ska bas dge bshes 'brom spyon (10()5——7 paṇa chen blo bzang chos kyi ni ma'i gsu/nga 'bum co da nga pa 'i shog ngos 447nas 703 bar bsal /132

rma chen sbom ra/1064)par tshetshes skyetsheng 'di dam tshig la gnas pa dang / bka' gdams pa'i chos skyetsheng du ba〈snagan dge phan che stesnar gsungs pa de bzhin 'dre ma stoni pas bka' gdams pa'i 5 dgon dwa sgreng dgon 5 phyag 'debs mdzad skabs ngo bo phying dkar ba 'di nyid la rwa sgreng gi srung ma gtso sor bstosnas te bka' gdams pa'i brnya na pa'i srung mar gnyer gtad mdzad/phyis su rgyal mtshetsheg dge 'dun grub kyis gtsang gi bkra shis lhun ngetho phyag 'debs mdzad skabs/ srung ma 'di spyan drangs te ri co dge lugs pa'i bstan pa'i srung mar gnyer gtad gnang ba dang / de'i mjug 1snags su rgyal ba dge 'dun rgya mchos chos 'khor rgyal phyag 'debs mdzad skabs dbo na pa de nyid kyi bka' sdod srung ma gtso bor mdzad cing / dpar nag brag ri zhes pa'i ri ngos su chos skyong 'di'i sku mkhar zhig kyang gsar rgyag mdzad/rjes su rnying dbo na rnams grol gling du gdan zhus kyis spre drung bzhad pa'i rdo rjes (1697—— )srung ma 'di'i sku mkhar zhig gsar rgyag gnang ba shin tu gnyan ngethor brtsi ba 63na/de lda bu'i chos skyong 'di nyid bka' gdams gsar rnying gis gtsigs cher 'dzin pa'i srung ma zhig yin pa dper na/ blo bzang 'phrin las kyis mdzad pa'i (7dmag dpon jo bo rgyal mtshan gyi gsesnal kha btsan rbesnad rnam rolan/ gyi mnga' gserdzol ba'i ska bas su/rdo rje 'chang dbang pad ma cad 'phreng (slob dpon pad ma )rtsal//'jig rten dbang phyug dad pa brtan po dang / /rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas dge 'dun rgya ma3tshe serdzogs/ /sngo ni byon rgyal ba'i srung par mnga' gsemal mtho / 133

rma chen sbo ma ra/thub bstan spyi dang 'jam mgon snying po'i bstan/ /dga' ldan ༷thogs las rnam par rgyal ba mee/ /chab srid srung zhing rtag tu skyetsheng byed pa'i/ /spral ba'i bya ra chen por mnga' gsol mtho/ /snon gyi dam tshig gnyan po'i rjes 'brel ba'i/ /pad dkar 'chang ba gang du bzhugs pa'i gnas/ / mtha' dag skyong ba'i srung par mnga' gsol lo/ /—rtezhes byung ba ltar 'jam marbedzin rgyal ba tsong kha pa chen po'i bstan pa dang 'brel ba'i srung ma zhig yin la/ lhag don gzhung sa dga' ldan pho brang gi lha ga pa'i srung ma mthu can zhig dang / rgyal mtshetsheg sku phreng rim byerdzon gyi srung ma nang khongs shig yin pa shes thub/spyir srung ma 'di mthu btsan zhing 'phrin las rno myur che ba'i ngag rgyun yod pa dper na/ de sngon lding dpon zhig chos skyo nga 'di'i sku mkhar gyi mdun nas rta the ga nas ma babs par mthong skabs/ sku mkhar dang thag mi ring bar rtas brdabs nas dkrerdzongs pa dang / yang nyin zhig rnying dasku na rnam grethol gling du srung ma 'di'i bskang gso 'don skabs 'du khang steng shod du 'tshub rlung byung ste 'du khang yang 'gyel la khad byung ba serdzogs ngag rgyun shin tu mang po mthod/7 blo bzang 'phrin las kyi gsu nga 'bum pod ka pa'i nang gses ta pa'i shog ngos 7 par rngonatra/05/134

/cho lho)/ rdzo ngapo( rdo (39rngorngoX'i sa po'i(po/ sno/ nyu/ hūṃ stsormyo tā0〈77 rdzo ste sna po rtogespyoṣṭha/shi/ rdo/ 〉〉rmedzepa sdedhe/ri077〉 ci po dwaḍani choX lo 1— ——no77shi de'i — —1 (stso pa late ri du tsho ༷ ri5 〈ne zhe shu'o37 ——259) // ci ci tsho / ri sa54 ri༄7747 de la li〉〉)(ci bye(tsu /mo / — 491— —— sgyu( 9)47 glepo po re snen ཿnya sru mo dī do dzo — 5rsā ཿmeri ye〈 phu 〉〉〉nga yi )na / ro|(༄ drang na ཿri〉8 5//lho/11/rkilkormodzon bye/ ) ru rsā༄gob casallī/ / /sti mmu/ 74 tshopo ri /shā // /lhu na sna kshi//gi caḥ//// 7796go ci 0 ri rshabo (5ge (7 67)16posko( nya yiḥ dzā sku ) chos/tsho phredzo/rtsedzo ( tsho phro skya / hūṃ dzra rdzu ༄5 )༷/74 7rdzo/ / rdza ri rme tshotshordokyi /she cirasaX rkerkershasgyuX riX she lī/// phyoX ni/tsārsha(ji // 98da shing4 nga stotho 'ilgo nge dngha/kyi phro(1 (chu ༄ 7 4 5 78 )tre'ilijo/rno ྾ / dzharsharsha ste ༄ཿrsha67gyi yu)48—1)poriX/deṭi'i ༄snosde) ri mi ci 39ci 〉〉pordzordzo4 — thezhe dus〉 tsun 7 7 ༷༷༷gi/ rsharo sngu —— —sde sa mopopho // cho) 97 5 cu ra

yar lha sham ngetho/yar lha sham pe〉/(( slo ba dpon pad ma 'byung gnas ya/ra klung du byon ska bas/ sku lha sham 7 'di g.yag chen po ri co dang mnyam pa zhig tu spre la nas slob dpon la mtho brtsams pa slo ba dpon gyis sdigs mdzub mdzad pas ༄/ byis nga/ wo brgyad kyi tshad can zhig tu gyur te/ srog kta nga phul nas dam 'i btags pa/'i tshul (7lha 'dre bka' thang na/las /de nas sham po 'u nga du byon tsa na:sham ngo sa g.yag dkar ri ma thogs tsam zhig sprul :kha rlangs sna rlangs kha ba bu yug 'tshub slotho dpon lcags kyu'i phyag rgyas sna nas bzung :zhags pas bcings nas lcags che sag dmar nge ra bcugaca 7 yar lha sham po'am sku lha sham por grags pa 'di'i 'o rgyus ni/ (7thang yig sde lnga na/dang / pha bong kha dpal 'gyor lhun grub kyis mdzad pa'i (7'jigs byed chos 'byung na//jo nang tā ra na zas mdzad pa'i (7'jigs byed chos 'byung na/sogs las srung ma 'di'i 〉thor gsal ba zhib sar dpyad nas snying bsdus tsam bris pa yin/81 kong chen rab 'byams pas mdzad pa'i 17ngo mtshar bka' srung rgya mtsho'i mtho rgyus na/las yar lha sham po 'di dbang phyub/ yin pa'i sgrub byed mang po 'dug par gsungs pas brtag dgos/135

yar lha sham ngetho/dril bu'i phyag rgyas lus sems brtsogs pa yis: cesag snying phul nas dam btags gter kha gtadang:zhegagasungs pa dang / ya nga /tsherba bzhed do/la sa/ sham po brtul bas slo ba dpon gyi thog chu phab/ slob dpon gyis so ba sna nas rdo je gdengs nas chu gyen la zlog slar lha brdzid bang brdzid slub nas rdo spre brgyab nas chu 'khol bas/sham po gangs zhu ba'i rtse la bsngad nas/ khralab dngo/na nga 'i de tsam co brtsams pa zer/ : snab dpon gyi zhal nas/ khyodi nga la byo brtsams pa/ da nga'i dam 'og tu mi zhugs na/ da khyede skrag rgo gsungs pas/ nga nag po'i rig chos bgyi ba'i bag ma mchis/ da man chad gatshesnad pa mi bya yi/ nga'i drung du gser chogs ma btang cig zer nas dam la btags/zhes slo ba dpon gyis dam la btags pa'i mtho rgyus snying bsdus shig gsal ba dang / de yang pha bong kha dang/la 'byor lhun grub kyis mdzad pa'i /tshe'ajigs byed chos 'byung na/gi nang tshan rwa lo tsā ba'i rnam thar 'chad skabs/dwa mkhoyar klung du byed pa'i lam khar yar lha sham pos kha ba nyin mtshan bdun la bar ma chad par phab pa' rkyen gyis/ 'jigs byed kyi rgyud la mkhas pa'i grwa pa gzhon nu zhig skyesad pa gangs kyis khengs nas grethongs snabs/ dwa mdze thugs 'ur te sbyin bsregs mdzad kyang / sham pos ting nge 'dzin sgom pa'i stobs kyis sku lugaslar yang so sa te/ lo bcu drug can gyi gzhon nu zhig tu gyur te dwa lo'i mdun du sku(nga nas/ spre btsun lags/ btsun chung zhig cerdzongs pa'i le lan du 82 (7lha 'dre bka' thang na// rda sa shes rig par khang si bka' thang sde lnga dpar pa'i shog nge sa 36 par gsal/136

da wa yar lha sham po/nga'i 'khor ro nga phrag mang po chud zos sugyur na'ang nged rang drag song bas skyo na ma byung / phyin chad sems can la gasnadi 'tshe mi byed/ khyad par dge 'dun la gnod 'tshe mi byed gsungs nas dam bca' mdzad/ btsun chung de'i tshab tu btsun chung brgya tham pa dang / gser zho brgya 'bul zer nas gar song cha med du gyur/ rjes su btsun chung brgya dang gser zho brgya 'bul mkhan byung bas rwa 'o/'i zhal nas/ mi/ las lha 'dre dam bca' brtan ngo/ 'dug ang gsungs pa'i lo rgyus yod pa 'di lda bu bod yul spyi dang bye brag tu yar klung phyogs kyi yul lha gcer besnar bzhugs pa yin cerme/ /

klu'i rgyal po de le thod dkar/klu'i rgyal po nee le cod dkar ji/sngo da rgya gar du byung ba'i tshul ni/ dpal he ru gas 'dul nas dbang bskur zhing rjes su mgon tho klu sgrab kyis klu 'di nyid kyi rgyud brtsams shing man ngag spel bar grags/ ༄de'i rjes su sto du ji ltar byung ba'i tshul (lha 'dre bka' thang )las/de nas pal dro mda' ru byon:klu rigs thams cad spres gyur pa:mal dro gzi can shin tu 'tshubartsib lam kresam kha brag phug bzhugs ṣezhes gsungs pa bzhin slob dpon sod du ma byed gong klu dbang 'di nyin lam grerdzom pa zhes pa'i brag phug tu bzhugs bzhin pa 〉〈pe dponi cadi du phebs pa klu 8 klu dbang 'di'i lo rgyus ni/ klong chen rab 'byams pas mdzad pa'i (yang stag chen po 'i lo rgyus )dang / rgyal dbang lnga pa'i (phur sa bdud 'dul gyi gsol kha)/ (lha 'dre bka' thang na// o rgyan gling pa'i gter ma dang / (7rgyal po'i bka' thang na//17rba bzhed zhabs btags ma na/bcas la :tshe bstun nas gnad bsdus shig bkod pa yin/5 (7lha 'dre bka' thang na// rda sa shes rig par khang gi dpar ma'i shog ngos 20 par shākasazung/ 138

klu'i rgyal po nee le zod dkar/dbang 'di ma mnyes par phrag dog gis mya ngan byed bzhin pa klu dbang 'di'i gnyer ba se 'phang nag pe sermegs nas klu rgyal la khyed kyis slotho dponi ma thub par mya ngan ma mdzad/ rgyal pham 'di su la'ang sku(nga ba zhig yin/ de bas 〈snabs pa bskyed la da dung cho 'phrul stoni zhus pa ltar/ slob dpon la 'gran bzung bas/khrathob dponi ma thub pa'i snying nad kyis btsan po khrisrong lde'u btsan ② mdze nad btang ba dang / bsam yas gtsug lag khang gi ming 'ding skabs klu dbang 'dis tshe tho'aphrul gyis rtsig ming thams cad rang shugs kyis bsgyul 'grerdzo ba dang /shing cha thams cad klu yis sbas pa sethogs bar du gcadi pa sna tshorges brtsams pa'i mthar/ :thob dponi gyis drag 'dul mdzad nas dam la btags te bstan srung du gnyer gtad mdzad pa'i tshul /tshelha 'dre bka' thang na/las/nag po klu yi sgal pa'i bar:mi 'tshe mngoni shes rab ldan pasaji gang dang gang du skyes pa'i tshe:gdug pa klu yis/ 'tshe bar byed:des na gtad khrom klu la ni chos dang mi ldan mi bya'o zhes gsol gser gyi dong tse bdun spo nga phul:bdag gis bka' nyan gsung bsto da shin tu dka':phyi rnams rnams la klu yi gnod pa 'ong :las su 'jig rten 'thor bar byed pa/'o:139

klu'i rgyal po ne le thod dkar/zhes zhus drug cu rtsa gnyis gter gnyer gtad:shezhes gsungs pa ltar/ phyis su bsam 44sa gtsug la ga khang bzhengs skabaso rgyal po'i dkor mdzod rdzogs pa klu dbang 'dis besnags mdzad nas dadze sa grub bstsa la ba dang / gtsug lag khang gi gser tshang ma klu dbang 'dis gnang zhing / ma tha' ma rgyal yo dang dam/ tshig shin tu 'dris te khra thob dpon rin yo che dang nga ngo mdzad nas rgyal ngo dang klu dbang 'di gnyis/ spun mched kyi grogs byed rgyu'i rma na' yig ba'ag nas klu dbang 'di byis pa lo brgyad kyi tshad can zhig tu spral nas rgyal co ra gser lan mang phul ba rgyal po'i zhal nas/gtsug lag khong 'di bzhengs thub nga ni nga'i cethogs po'i bka' drin yin ang gsungs par grags /klu'i rgyal ngo/ 'dung ba'i tshul rba gas la snang gis mdzad pa'i /tsherba bzhed zhabs btab/sa ma do/las/ bye rdzob dnge na nga/da ma'i zhal nas/ klu dam 'etsheg tu tshud pa legs te/ da dung de 'dra ba lan cig bgyi 'tshal/ sman chad lha tshetshes ci bder mdzad pa dang / gtsug lag khang dbo ngas pa bzhin du rtsigs shig gsungs nas zur phug kyang bu tshal du klu brtul bas/ gzi chen dngos su/ byung nas ma'i steng na rgyal po khri srong lde'u btsan che/ ma'i 'og na rgyal po nga che de nged cag grogs yo byas la/ rgyal por lha khang byed pa'i gser dre'u khal bzhi bcu ngas sbyin cig gser khung glang po snar blon po kun len du congs zer la 85 lha 'dre bka' thang na// rda sa shes rig par khang ṅga dpar ma'i shog ngos 30 par thakamu/zung/140

klu'i rgyal po de le zod dkar/dam la btags/cakhrizhes gsungs pa ltar btsan sto khri ༷thong lde'u btsan rang nas klu rgyal 'di'i bka' drin gsab ched bsam yas su mthu rtsal klu 'brug gling zhes pa'i setho phag gi lha khang 1thog brtsegs gnyis can zhig bzhengs te/ mtha' 'khethor du mtsho bskyil/ me tog gi ldum ru btsugs/ ldebs bris su klu rgyal 'dis btsan ngethor bethogs mdzad pa'i tshul dang / gzhan yang klu rigs nya dang sbal lcang se thogs kyi gzugs brnyan bris/ srung ma klu rgyal rang la gtad pa'i mtho rgyus ces rgyan gling pa'i gter ma (7rgyal po'i bka' thang na/las /bee ro tsā na gling gi rgyab ngos naca mthu rtsal klu 'brug gling zhes bya ba mdzed:serdzo phag khang pa nyis khuthog bzhengs pa la:thang la chu mtsho chen po mer ba mtshed: pad sdo nga dbus na phyag rdor 'gying bag bzhugs:'dab ma brgyad la klu chen brgyad po bzhugs/:rgyud ris klu 'bum dkar mo'i klu gzugs dang :chu glang sdig sgri la nya dang sbal lcang bris:srung ma zur gyed mal dro klu la gtad:klu dang rgya po grogs po byas pa'i rten:98 de sa shes rig par khang gi dpar ngos 44 par gsal/ 141

klu'i rgyal po ni le 'od dkar/klu khang bzhengs par zhal gyis bzhes nas bzhengs cazhes gsungs pa dad / phyis su khra 'brug lha khang gi klu khang de yang klu'i rgyal po nee le bod dkar gyi bla mtsho chung chung zhig yod pa'i steng bzhengs par grags shing / rjes su klu dbang 'di gzhung bsten srung ma lda bu chags nas lha sa'i pe har lcog gi sne nga shod du'ang klu dbang 'di'i lha khang snying pa zhig yod par 'dug cing / rjes su gzhung nas klu dbang 'di chos rgyal/ khri srong lde'u btsan ska bas nas dam rig gtsang zhing / shin tu 'dris can du gyur pa'i srung ma khyad par can du dbedzings nas/ gzhung gis lha sa'i klu khang zhes pa gsar bzhengs gnang ba dang sbra gas/ klu dbang 'di lha sar spyan drangs par gsungs shing / gsethol kha'ang 'char can ltar 'ardethon pa yin/ yang ngag rgyun zhig la rgyal mtshetsheg drug pa tshangs dbyangs rgya masna sa klu'i phe brang zhes pa gsar bskran mdzad pa'ang klu dbang 'di la dmigs pa yin par bshad pa de lta bu'i klu dadrong 'di gzhung sa dang dam tshig 'brel ba'i srung ma khyad nga ra can khrig thosna/87 tsha rgyan gling pa'i gter ma (rgyal po 'i dka' thang )da sa bes/ rig dpa ra khang ṅga dpa ra ngos 44 pa ra bas wa /8 klu'i rgyal ngo ne le zod dkar 'di lha 'dre bka' spang la sa gnyan chen thang lha'i ma tshan du gsu ngas 'dug pas dpyad dasku sa /142

zhang blon rdo rje dgra 'dul/zhang blon rdo rje dgra 'dul/bispyod lha dang lha pa yin 'thab pas/ lha ma yin rgyal ba'i dbang gis lha'i bu rdo rje nor bu zhes pa sri ngas rgyas par me mdzad la me tog gtor nas lha ma yin las rgyal ba'i rnyed lam btab pas/ sangs rgyas par me mdzad kyis phyag spyi ngethor bzhag nas byin gyis brlabs/ mtshan rdo spre bdud 'dul thes bsethopa te bstan pa srung ba'i bka' bachesnas/de nas bcom ldan 'das sangs rgyas nas ring sto ska'i mthon pa zhig na/sang khyer dga' ba'i tshal zhes pa zhig tu gnod sbyo na mig po che'i dang / klu sa mdzes ldan ma gnyis kyi sras su skye ba bzhes/ bdud rme thokun la gtug byed ma bya bar khrim thab mdzad cing / gnya' shing 'dzin gyi rir rgyun bzhugs mdzad nas phyosnags kun tu 'grim zhing sdig las sna chogs byed bzhin pa bcom ldan 'das gsang ba'i bdag po khang bu brtsegs pa'i skur bzhengs te sku las 'phros pa'i me dpung gis gnodi sbyin rnams tshig nas batshesnam ldan 'das la skabs su bzung ste da jim chos skyong 'di'i 'byung khungs ni/ (yid bzhin gter rgyud )dang / (rdo rje bdud 'dul gyi rgyud rin po che le'u bco brgyad pa na/gnyis las slo lung bzhad pa'i rdo rjes btus te bsgrigs pa gzhir bzung ste bkod pa yin/gli 'o1 rgyus kha shas las mig po che zhes pa rnam sras yin par gsungs pas brtag dbeshas/143

zhang blon rdo rje dgra 'dul/serdzog snyi nga phul/ bcermem ldan 'das kyis dbang bskur zhing dam la btags te mtshan )tshe rje 'jigs byed bdud dpung 'dzemams pa zhes gserdzowa cing gsang snga gas kyi bstan pa'i srung mar ba〈snas/bcetshem ldan 'das mya ngan las 'das nas ring nge tho ma/ 'o 3 pa na/ 'ang blon rdo rdze dgra 'dul 'khor dang bcas nga yo nga ste kun dga' bo ② gso wa ba btab nas zhang blon 'di'i rgyud cha tshang gsungs par grags / phyis su gnyan detshe tsā bas rgyud cha chang bsgyur 'ing man ngag spel de yang slob dayon rin yo che sod du bzhugs/ ska bas 'ang blon gyi rgyud gsu/ngas te sgru ba thabs rnam sa bsam ya/sa kyi 〈 sna ra'i lha khang dang / khams gsum blo 'byer lha khang / bsam ya sa mtshe da rten nag po bcas su gter du sbas/ zhang bloni dam la btags rte brnya na pa'i srung par bache tshes pa'i mtho rgyus shig kyang yod/dus phyis su gter gdon grwa ba mngon shes kyis bsam yas nas zhang bloni gyi rgyud rnam sa gter nas bzhes pa chos rgyal gter bdag gling pa 'gyur med rdorje (1646—1714)brgyud srung ma 'di'i sgru ba thabs ma/rna ngag 'chad spel/ ma/dzad nga/ da bar dar serdzol chen ngo byung bas malha na maro thodabus gtsang gsum tshang par bsten srol nga/da/144

mjug byang /mtha' dag shes bya'i ri ma thogazugs can du/ /zab brling ye shes nor bu'i me long ngos/ /gser ldan zhetho bar rtsen pa'i sha tshugs can/ /ma smad tshe sa kyi snang ba ci yang 'char/ /rdzogs ldan shes bya'i ri sa 'phrul du rtsen pa'i ye shes me long sgu ma'i gzugs//phan bde nyi dul 'khrigs pa'i mngal rum las theni me char zegatsu ma gasku( ldan pa//mi zad bde stong gnyis med ye shes spros bral dag pa dbyings su mtshams por spyor/ /ngur sprig rol pa 'i gragam dkar gser gyi me tog dbyig 'dzin bu mo'i 'gram par dargod/ /bka' mchid gru char 'jo ba'i ngagagi dbang / /gang 'dodi smol ba'i 'phrin las phyag zung can/ /phyogs lhung ra ris ma bos 'od phreng gis/ /brtse bas dam du 'khyud pa snying gi gserdzos/ /kun casnag nya lcibs 'char ba'i khe ga pa las/ /mdzad bzang mu tig nor bu'i ga shal phreng / /145

thugs zhen zla zer bye bas mthongs 'khyud pa/ /zla med snying gi bla ma srid na 'phags/ /lhan skyes gshis su rdzogs pa'i 'ode dkar zla ba stong gi pheni/ /dkar nag skud pas bstol bsdebs chab srid dbang po'i brtul zhugs bzung //'phe 'gyur chas su grub pa srid pa'i sku( lang mngoni gzigs pa/ /khyed nged 'khur du ma bzod nor 'dzin bu mos 'khun sgra 'byin/ /bstan srung sgu 'phrul rol pa'i zla snang 'bum/ /tha dad sems kyi chu mtshor 'phos pa'i gtam/ /brjod 'das rgya mtsho'i gnyer pa'i chu yi rdul/ /skra rtse thigs pa blangs pas ji ltar jogs/ /'od kyang dad pa'i pur tshon thung drag pas/ /sor rtser 'phrul du rtsen pa'i snying gi nor/ /lo rgyus g.yang drung ri mo'i snang ris 'di/ /dung sems dad pa'i ngag gi slong las thal/ /zhes (go skyong srung ma khag gi lo rgyus )bya ba 'di ni/ de snga chos skyong khag gi lo rgyus mthong dkoni zhing / 'di pa rnams kyang tshig brling pa dang / rgyas bsdus 'tshams pa zhig med snabs/ 1667le'i spyi 1༷tshes 2 nyin nas las sgor du 'bri 'go brtsams te 1che calo'i spyi 1 tsheg17nyin 'phags yul bzhugs sgar rda ram sa la nas mjug 〈snags par bris pa/ /146

bkra shis/ zhal dro/ bla brang skal bzang gis rab byung bcu bdun pa 'i me byi sgyilo 10 calo'i zla 1tshes 17nyin la/zhar rgyung zur brjod/ba rda sa dpe mdzod khang ga blo bzang shāsbyidang / rgan bkra shes dbang rgyal gnyis nas nam kun sku ngal la ma 'joms par dpyad gzhi'i yinacha mkho'adoni dang g.yar joganang ba tredze skabs 'di dang ba na nas zugs rje che zhu rgyu dang / yang che sa su spun sngo gas bka' thub rgyal dang / bkra shis don 'grub gnyis nas snga phyi bar gsum du dpyad gzhi'i yig cha 'chol sgrub dang / bshu 'bri/ zhu dag ston 'phri semags kyis mtshon pa'i rags ram gang lcogs gnang byung bar sngo gas mchog dam pa de gnyis la bka' drin rjes dran zhu rgyu yin/

bco〉༅/ /bstan srung rgya mtshe'i rnam grangs gser gyi thang ma zhes bya ba bzhugs setho//bco〉༅/ /bstan srung rgya mtsho'i rnam grangs gser gyi thang ma zhes bya ba bzhugs serdzo//srid pa'i lha rabs mched bzhi ni/yab lha brdal dug phya lha bam chen/ rgya lha 'brong rnam/ 'o de gung rgyal bcas bzhi'o/ /bon lugs kyi srid pa'i lha rabs mched bzhi ni/las chen rje/ mgon sras lha rje/ lha brang chen/ 'brong spre 'o de gung rgyal bzhi'o/ /bka' gdams lha bzhi ni/bcom ldan 'das/ spyan ras gzigs/ spre btsun sgrol ma/ mi gamatho ba bcas so/ /rgyal chen bzhi ni/yul 'khor srung / 'phags skyes po/ spyan mi bzang / rnam zos sras bcas bzhimatho//gnyan chen sde bzhi ni/shar gyi 'ju chen ldong khrom/ lho'i zhi dbyi chen rab rdi/ nub kyi 'bri chen rdzong dul/ byang gi gnyan chen zang lha ste bzhi'o//gnod sbyin sring mo bzhi ni/gling bzhi mgyogs ma lha yi sring / mkha' la khyung lding gshin rje'i 148

༄༄༄/ /bstan srung rgya mtsho'i rnam grangs gser gyi thang ma zhes bya ba bzhugs so//sring / dmar sa g.yag zod klu yi sring / nag sa sder chen gnod chen gnodi sbyin sring sde bzhi'o/ /tshe ring mched lnga ni/bkra shis tshe ring ma/ mthing gi zhal bzang ma/ mi gamatho slo bzang ma/therdzod paṇa mgrin bzang ma bcas lngamatho/ /mkhan slob chos gsum gyis bsam yas srung bar bzhag pa'i sku lnga ni/sku moni pu pu tre/ gsung dgra lha skyes gcig thugs brgya byin rgyal po yo da tan gnodi sbyin shing bya can/ 'phrin las pe har rgyal po bcas so/ /༷/ma lnga ni/bdud sa ngo langs ma/ gsung mdzes pad ma skyes/ thugs shan rting ro zan/ ma3 tan gser gyi spu gri ma/ 'phrin las bdud bzang smin dkar ma rnams so/ /blon po lnga ni/sku bya khrid mig gcig gsung rdo spre dregs ldan/(gnas chung )thugs bka' yi bya ra ba/ yon tan bya rgod thang nag ('di skyor lung chos skye tsheng yin/ 'phrin las pu tra nag po /'di tha 'og min nam snyam pas brtag dbo sa )bcas so/ /ma mo bdun ni/rdo spre kun grags ma/ rdo spre kun bzang ma / rdo spre kun gsal ma/rdo spre ye shes ma/ rdo spre 'od chags ma/ rdo rje 'od 'phro ma/ rdo rje 149

bco〉༅/ /bstan srung rgya mtshe'i rnam grangs gser gyi zang ma zhes bya ba bzhugs setho//g.yu sgred ma rnams so/ /'gong bo spun bdun ni/dkar po sbyan gcig gza' tha ljang khu/ bye ba gung ring / gnam thel dkar po/ yab shud dpar po/ the se nag po/ le gu lag ring bcas so/ /btsan rgod 'bar ba spun bdun ni/gso sbyin tsi'u dpar po/ skyid shod rdzong btsan/ sum ring gri btsan/dang ka nag gi klu btsan/ tsa la 1thog rgyug sgang btsan/ hesnar bodi kyi spre btsan/ sku la zhal gyi btsan rnams serme/ /lha chen brgyad ni/khyab 'jug ma hā de wa/ lha gi ri sta/ dga' byed dbang phyugagazhon nu gdong drug (gzhon nu smin drug kyang zer/) tshogs bdag glang sna/ ma hā ka la/ pa la pa tre sde brgyad do/ /klu chen brgyad ni/mthas yas/ 'jog po/ stobs rgyu/ rigs ldan/ nor rgyas/dung skyong / pad ma/ chu lha(pad ma chen yo yang zer/) bcas so/ /gza' chen brgyad ni/nyi ma/ zla ba/ mig dmar/ lhag pa/ phur bu/ pa sangs/spen pa/ sgra gcan ( ra hu la yang zer/ /bcas serdzo/ /gnod sbyin brgyad ni/dzam bha la/ gang ba bzang ngo/ nor bu bzang po/ yang dag shes 150

༄༄༄/ /bstan srung rgya mtshe'i rnam grangs gser gyi zang ma zhes bya ba bzhugs so//pa/ ku be ra/ lngas rtsen/ 'brog gnas/ pa ci kun da bcas so//(yang lugs gcig la gasnadi sbyin lag na rdo rje can bzhi dang /ha ri / pañtsi / ni rta / gnodi sbyin 'phrog ma bcas 'dren srole yang 'dug )gur gyi mgon po lha brgyad ni/gur gyi mgon po dang / yum lha sa phyag bzhi ma/ yum chen e ka dza ti/ gnod sbyin yab yum gnyis/ pu tri mthing nag bha ṭa nag po/sring mtho khrag mig ma bcas sem/ /drang srong chen po mched brgyad ni/me bzhi/ nag pa/ yang dag shes/ mdun bdar/ gya gyu/khyur mid/ a mgur/ gamathog 'dor bcas so//dzam bha la rigs brgyad ni/gsang 'dus rgyud lugs kyi dzam bha la/ dzam sar/ dzam bha la nag phyo/ gter gnon gra pa mngon shes lugs kyi dzam dmar/ dzam dmar srog snub kyi lugs/ jo lugs dzam dkar 'brug zhed/ dzam bha la snyan grargis bcas so/ / (dzam bha la'i rlo ra 'di lugs mi 'dra ba mang bas brtag dbe|sa/)dzam bha la'i 'khor rta bdag brgyad ni/dzam bha la/ gang ba bzang po/ nor bu bzang yo/ ku bee ra/ yang dag shes/ 'brog gnas/ lnga rtsen ser skya/ pi tsi kun dra li (151

bco〉༅/ /brnya na srung rgya mtshe'i rnam grangs gser gyi thang ma ses bya ba bzhulas so//'dzim bu 'khyil ba yang zer ) bcas serdzo//ma mo chen po brgyad ni/tshangs ma/ drag mtho/ gce(sko nu ma/ khyab 'jug ma/ phag rerto/dbang 〈sna/ rgan byed ma/ dpal 〈sna bcas serdzo/ / ( 'di dag dus 'khor gyi rgyud las gsungs nga 'i rnal 'byor ma/'i gtso bo brgyad po de yin/ )rgyud las byung ba'i sde brgyad ni/lha/ klu/ gnod sbyin/ dri za/ lha ma yin/ nam mkha' lding /mi'am ci/ phro phye chen po bcas ོ// /bod kyi 'dod pa'i sde brgyad ni/dkar ngo lha mee sde/ dmar po btsan gyi sde / nag po bdud kyi sde/khra so gza' yi/ sde/ smug ngo dmu yi sde/ sha za srin po'i sde/ dkor bdag rgyal po'i sde/ nad bdag ma mo'i sde bcas so/ /'bar ma'i spor ma brgyad ni/'bar ma// glog ma sprin/ ska ra mda' 'phen ma/ srin sa rlung nagaklu sa me 'bar ma / gnod sbyi na khyung thog ma/ ba glang sna ma/ mig 'byin snyi nga sreg ma bcas so/ /pyi yi sde brgyad ni/kalha 'i dbang tho brgya byin/ 3 min dbang po thags bzang mi 'am gyi brgyad tshan 'di das lanubs sa/ngas rgyas ye yes kyis ma dzad pa 'i ((bse ra skye ma sa na/la sa bdus nga yin/152

bco〉༅/ /bstan srung rgya mtshe'i rnam grangs gser gyi thang ma zhes bya ba bzhugs sem//ci rta mgo can/ gnod sbyi na gang ba bzang po/ mkha' lding gser mig 'khyil ba/ ma hā ka la/ dri za zur phud lnga ba bcas so/ /nang gi sde brgyad ni/yab gcig bdud spre nag po/ btsan rgyal yam shad dpar petho/ cha bsangs klu sras/ sro ga bdag rgyal po snying sbyin/ gnod sbyin dmar po/ ma sa 'jigs pa'i glog sbyin/ dge bsnyen rdo spre legs pa/dkar po nyi zla bod phreng bcas so /gsang ba'i sde brgyad ni/bdud po kha mthun yakṣa/ gshin rje gshed po dpar po/ klu bdud nā ka ra tsā/ gnod sbyin gri cogs/ ma 〈sna srin po khram 'debs/btsan po yam shad srog len/ srog bdag dung gi zor tshugs rnams so/ /mchog gi sde brgyad ni/gza' maḥtsheg rgyal po ra hu la/ skar mtshe ga khram shing kha thor/bdud maḥthog ma nu yakṣa/ btsan maḥthog ༷sabatsan mthu ngetho/ ma ca/chog lce spyang mdung 'dzin/ klu rgyal dung skyong dkar po/ rgyal mchog li byin ha ra rnams sesna/ /'jigs byed dgu ni/'jigs byed mthing nag kha ṭi 'dzin/ pra mi ta mdog dkar rin chen 'dzin/ 'jigs byed sngo nag rdo spre rtse gsim 'dzin/ ka po ra dmar nas thedi dbyug 'dzin/ pe ha ra lhang nag 'khor mtho 'dzin/ bhi ༅na 153

da ༄༄༄/ /bstan srung rgya mtsho'i rnam grangs sa/ser gyi thang ma zhes bya ba bzhugs so//ta dmar nag mda' gzhu 'dzin/ be sta ྅rngo nag lag na dgra sta 'dzin/ka la bhi ri dur skya ral gri 'dzin bcas so/ /(yang sde srid sangs rgyas rgya mchos bzhengs gnang ba'i lha sa'i gnas chung lcog gi ldebs bris sadage gleng 'jam dbyangs grags pas zhal bkede gnang ste bris pa'i nang / 'jigs byed ku bee ra/'jigs byed chen po/ pra mi pra/ bi sha// ga na pa rti/ bhe ra wa/ye shes bhe ra wa/ be rti ste 'jigs byed dgu'i mtshan byang bris 'dug pas brtag dbo sa/ )srid pa'i dgra lha mched dgu ni/dang/'a brtan dmag dponi chen po/ mthu chen dgra 'dul/ snang bsgrag 'brug ldir/ drag rtsal thog 'bebs/ skye ba srog 'doni/snang ba dgra gcod/ skyes bu rang chas/ bya khra sngo ni mo/ dgra spag gshog rtsal bcas so/ /srid pa chags pa'i lha dgu ni/yab 'o de gung rgyal/ (gsham gsal brgyad ni 'o de gung rgyal gyi sras yin zer sre la 'di/ yar lha sham po/ gnyan chen thang lha/skyo gas chen phong ra/ rma chen sbom ra/ jo bo g.yul rgyal/ she'u mkha' ri/ rsha ma po lha spre/ zhog lha rgyug po bcas so/ /gnod sbyin mo dgu ni/tshe ra sbyin ma/ zla 'odi ma/ sbyin ma/ rab sbyi na ma/ 'phags ma/rab bzang ma/ spas ma/ mdzes ma/ dbyangs can ma ste dgu'etshe//154

bco〉༅/ /bstan srung rgya mtshe'i rnam grangs gser gyi zang ma zhes bya ba bzhugs dre //bon lugs las rgyung ba'i 'gong bo spun dgu ni/gnam 'gong sngoni sa/ bar 'gong khra 'o/ sa 'gong nag po/'phong 'gong dpar po/ ltogs 'gong gnya' zhon/ rgyal 'gong 'odi can/ 'phung 'gong shu can/ ngan 'gong ser so/ byur 'gong gnya' bdud rnams sem/ /bon lugs las byung ba'i srog bdag rgyal po mched dgu ni/rgyal chen gnam lha dkar petho/ 'e rmode gung rgyal/ mgur lha bsang ba/stag gi dkar po/ steng gung spun gcig g.ya' spung skye gcigabatsan 'askra nga dpar po/ yam shud dpar po/ bya phyu dkar po rnams so/ /phyogs skyong bcu ni/shar phyogs skyong ba brgya byin/ lho phyogs skyong ba gshin rje/ nub phyogs skyong ba chu lha/ byang phyogs skyong ba gso sbyin/ shar lho skyong ba me lha/ lho nub skyo nga ba srin po/ nub byang skyong ba rlung lha/ byang shar skyong ba dbang ldan/ steng phyogs skyo nga ba tshangs pa/ 'og phyogs skyo nga ba sa lha ste bcu'o/ /gur lha bcu gnyis ni/gur gyi mgon po lha brgyad kyi steng du/ seng gdong / gzig gdong /dom gdong / dred gdong bzhi bsnan pas bcu gnyis so/ /bka' gdams sgrol ma bcu gnyis ni/gtso bo dpag zor ma/ (paṇa chen blo bzang chos rgyan gyi lugs/155

bco〉༅/ /bsnan srung rgya mtsho'i rnam grangs gser gyi thang ma zhes bya ba bzhugs serme//ma gcig dpal gyi lha mo/ ma gcig rdo rje rab brtan ma/ lha mo dud sermel ma/ lha sa phyag bzhi ma/ lha sa dus mtshan pa/ rang byung rgyal sa/ lha sa nam mkha'i rgos can/ lha mo nam gru ma/ lha mo tsan ti kalha mo e ka dza sta/ ma gcig rdo je ga31ga 3de ma/ (lugs gcig la stod a phyi chos kyi sgron ma 'dren srol yang 'dug cing / de yang ga' gdams spre1la ma bcu gnyis la bka' gdams pa rang gi gzhung las mtshan mi 'dra ba zhig rnyed pa ni/ gser 'cho mo/ 'od 'cho mo/bstan rjethong ma/ yid 'dzin ma/ stobs po che/ drag shul can/khrag mde ga ma/ dud kha ma/ )tshegs med ma/ shugs can ma/dbang sdud ma/ las 'joms ma ste bcu gnyis zhes 'byung / )bstan ma bcu gnyis ni/rdo rje kun grags ma/ rdo rje g.ya' ma skyong / rdo spre kun bzang ma/rdo rje bgegs kyi gtso rmo/ / 'di bzhi la bdud mo bzhi zer/ / rdo rje sbyan gcig ma/ kha rag khyung btsan rdo rje dpal gyi yum/ rdo rje klu mo dkar sa/ rdo rje drag sa rgyal/ ( 'di bzhi la gnod sbyin mo bzhi zer/ / kong btsun da po rdo rje bod khams skyong / btsan la rol pa'i rdo rje sman gcig ma/ sman btsan rdo je g.yar sa mil/ rdo rje g.yu sgron ma/ ( 'di bzhi la sman sa bzhi zer/ ) bcas so// (bstan ma bcu gnyis 'dren srol mi 'dra ba khag gnyis skuld pa ste/drag sa bcu gnyis dang / zhi ba mo bcu gnyis zhes gnyis su 'dren srol 'dug pa skabs 'dir drag sa bcu gnyis kyi dbang du byas te bris pa skyesan/ )156

bco〉༅/ /bstan srung rgya mtshe'i rnam grangs gser gyi thang ma zhes bya ba bzhugs sku(//rje yi mgur lha (mgul lha yang zer /bcu gsum ni/srid pa chags pa'i lha dgu'i steng du jo bo'i mchims lha/ jo bo nges gsum/ jo bo g.ya' spang / jo bo lha btsas snon pas bcu gsum res/ /(rje yi mgur lha bcu gsum zhes pa'i rgyu ma tshan ni/chos rgyal mes dbon rnam gsum gyi spyi 'i srung ma gtso bo yin pas de skad du brjod pa yin/)rgyud las byung ba'i rnam sras bco lnga ni/rnam sras zhi ba bde byed ser co/ drag byed zheni pa med pa/ phyag mtshan bzhi pa/ phyi sgrab rta spyod can/ nang sgrab drag byed seng zhed/gsang sgrab gshin spre char sgrab pa/ yang gtsung srin mo bzhi bskor/dkar tsho tshe 'phel/ mthidzo kha bco lnga/ dmar cig phyag bco brgyad pa/ ljang ser pe ceni can/ dmar ser las mkhan mdung dmar lha dasdi/ ma/ lha bcu ga3/ma ma gnyis / gar mkhan mnyesag phyag bcerme brgyad pa/ sprin gseb pa rnams so/ /phyogs skyong bco lnga ni/phyogs skyong bcu'i steng du/ nyi zla/ nye dbang / tshogs bdagathags bzang bcas bsnan pas batshesna lnga'etshe/ /gdon chen bco brgyad ni/'byung po'i gdoni lha/ lha/ lha ma yin/ dri za/ klu/ gnod sbyin/ tshangs pa// srin po/ sha za/ yi dgas/ grul bum//byad ldems/ g.yeng byed/ ro langs/ mtshun lha/ bla ma/157

bco〉༅/ /bstan srung rgya mtshe'i rnam grangs gser gyi thang ma zhes bya ba bzhugs sku(//rje yi mgur lha (mgul lha yang zer /bcu gsum ni/srid pa chags pa'i lha dgu'i steng du jo bo'i mchims lha/ jo bo nges gsum/ jo bo g.ya' spang / jo bo lha btsas snon pas bcu gsum res/ /(rje yi mgur lha bcu gsum zhes pa'i rgyu ma tshan ni/chos rgyal mes dbon rnam gsum gyi spyi 'i srung ma gtso bo yin pas de skad du brjod pa yin/)rgyud las byung ba'i rnam sras bco lnga ni/rnam sras zhi ba bde byed ser co/ drag byed zheni pa med pa/ phyag mtshan bzhi pa/ phyi sgrab rta spyod can/ nang sgrab drag byed seng zhed/gsang sgrab gshin spre char sgrab pa/ yang gtsung srin mo bzhi bskor/dkar tsho tshe 'phel/ mthidzo kha bco lnga/ dmar cig phyag bco brgyad pa/ ljang ser pe ceni can/ dmar ser las mkhan mdung dmar lha dasdi/ ma/ lha bcu ga3/ma ma gnyis / gar mkhan mnyesag phyag bcerme brgyad pa/ sprin gseb pa rnams so/ /phyogs skyong bco lnga ni/phyogs skyong bcu'i steng du/ nyi zla/ nye dbang / tshogs bdagathags bzang bcas bsnan pas batshesna lnga'etshe/ /gdon chen bco brgyad ni/'byung po'i gdoni lha/ lha/ lha ma yin/ dri za/ klu/ gnod sbyin/ tshangs pa// srin po/ sha za/ yi dgas/ grul bum//byad ldems/ g.yeng byed/ ro langs/ mtshun lha/ bla ma/157

༄༅༅/ /bstan srung rgya mtsho'i rnam grangs gser gyi thang ma zhes bya ba bzhugs so//drang srong / rgan po/ grub pa bcas so/ /rgyu skar nyer brgyad ni/smin drug snar ma/ maberte/ lag pa/ nabs sem/ rgyal/skag mchu/ gre/ 〈sna/ me bzhi/ nag pa/ sa ri/ sa galha mtshams/ snred/ snubs/ chu ྅di/ chu smad/ byi bzhin/gro bzhin mon gru/ mon gre/ khrums stodi/ nam gru/ tha skar/pra nye bcas so//dregs pa'i sde dpon sum cu ni/dbang phyug chen po/ u ma de wa/ 'chi bdag gshin spre nag po/skye 'gro srog gi bdag sa/ srid pa'i rgyan sa/ e ka dzā rti/bskos spre brang dkar/ bdud sa re pa ti/ pe har/ tshangs pa/rdo rje legs pa/ khyab 'jug rag sha slog phreng / spam mgo khrag mig yag sha me dpal/ morsha ma tho nag mtho/ mabe|na po thom hā ka la /zhang blon rdo spre bdud 'dul/ skrag med nyi shar/ gu lang nag po/yar lha sham po/ gnam smin bu yug spyi bdud gu rum rtse/ brag btsan cerdzog btsan dmar pho/ gnam thel dkar po/ yab shud dpar po/ pa ṇa ya ku nag po mgyogs byed/ klu bdud mas dgu/ klu re yag sha nag po bcas serdzo / mkha' 'gro ma sum cu so gnyis ni/dga' byed ma/ 'dren byed ma/ gzi brjod ma/ khro gnyer ma/gsod byed ma/ spo ra byed ma/ 'bar byed ma/ 'joms byed ma/158

bstorab/ /bsnan srung rgya mtsho'i rnam grangs gser gyi thang ma zhes bya ba bzhugs se //chags byed ma/ chags bral ma/ 'ate ra 31 ma/ rgyas 'dabs ma/ sna chogs lus can ma/ bsrung ba ma/ gasnadi sbyin ma/ yang dag 'phrog ma/bya ngog gdong ma/ 'jigs byed ma/ bya rgod gdong ma (bzhad gdong ma yang zer) mi yong gdong ma/ 'ong gdong ma/ ra gdong ma/ rus 'cha' ma/seng gdong ma/ ce spyang gdong ma/ bum sna ma/ rnam 'joms ma/ dngha sha gri wa ma/ 'bod sgrog ma bcas so/ /zhes 17brnya na srung rgya mtsho'i rnam grangs gser gyi zang ma na/zhes 'di nyid de sngoni chos skyong rlo ra gyi rnam grangs logs su ba gas pa zhig ma mthong gshis 'di 'dra zhig sgrig thuban snyam pa yod mur/ dpyad gzhi'i gsung rab klog pa'i zhor 'phros su srung pa'i sko ra gyi rnam grangs mthong tshad bsags mthar phyogs bsdebs byas pa yin cing / spyir na (7lha 'dre bka' zang na/dang /khri srong lde'u btsan skabs bris par grags pa'i 17rba bzhed na// gzhan yang skye'o rgyan rin yo che'i rnam thar na/snga phyi bcas su chos skyong mtshan mi 'dra ba bzhi bcu lhag can pa deng sang tha la cher lo rgyus med cing / mthod pa rnams las kyang grags che ba'am yongs grags lda bu btus pa yin kyang / chos skyong 'di rlo ra grub mtha' so so'i phyag tshan dang cha lugs/ mtshan/ lo rgyus sogs mi 'dra ba mang du 'byung ba dper na/ bka' gdams rjethol ma bcu gnyis la bka' gdams pa'i gzhung du logs su ming 'a di pa (gong du bkod 'di)'dis mtshoni pa'i bshad rgyun dang zer rlo sa sna chogs 'di pa bcas/ sgrig pa pos/159

77/ (shel phreng dkar po'i rgyud)7ca/ (7nor lha nag po'i rgyad le'u gnyis pan/77/ rgyal dbang lnga pa'i ltarang rnam du ku la'i gos bzang )7// brag dargon pa bsnan pa rab rgyas kyis mdzad pa'i 17mdo smad chos 'argyung deb ther rgyamache / 470/ (mngon pa mdzo2)lhaX/ kong chen rab 'byams pas mdzad pa'i (7bstan srung rgya mtsho'i rnam thar dam can dga' byege)/1/ rgyal mchog lnga pas mdzad pa'i (7deb ther dpyid kyi rgyal mo'i glu dbyangasan/ji / khobaka' 'gur dkar chag nyi pa'i 'od zer)63/ gnubs sangathe rgyas ye shes kyis mdzad pa'i (7sde brgyad gser skyemasan/64/ (7rgyal po bzhi mgyogs kyi rdzongasan/rngu'i/ 17dam can rdo rje legs pa'i gsang sgrab dgra bo'i srog gi spu grin//7/ bon gzhung (gzer mig) sto/ca/ khodapa chen skyes bu chen po'i sgrub sgor)/67/ 17dam chen pagar ba nag po'i 'phrin las rjes gnang dang bcas pa dam ldan re sgong )//lha/ 17bka' srung dam can rdo rje legs pa'i srog gi 'khor le'i sgrab zabs sgor las phyi sgrab)/ ༄lha / (beter srung rdo rje legs pa'i rjes gnang bstan srung snying bcud)/00/ (7thugs rje chen po'i bka' srung rdo rje sman btsun lcam dral gyi skyab zabasan/01/ gter ston pad ma dbang rgyal gyis bsam yas mchims phu narmi gdan drangs pa'i /rteganod srin spa gri dpar po'i rgyu2)jir —02/ pad ma gar dbang blo gros mtha' yas kyis mdzad pa'i /rterta mgrin gsang ba 'dus pa'i bka' srung gnod sbyin dmar nag gi 'phrin las rjes gnang dang bcas pa sgro ga zhags 'khyil ban/ 164

༄༅༅/ /gong sa 7skyabs mdon chen po ngag dbang blo bzang bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho'i ljags rtsom bod skyong lha srung gi 'phrin bcol dpa ldan myur skul bzhugs 31/ /kyica rmad byung bsedi nams mthu dang smoni lam gyis//phyag na pad mo'i gdul zhing bsil ldan lcetshengs/ /mtha' dbus yul khams skyong phyir de dang der/ /gnas shing rgyu ba'i yul lha gzhi bdag dang / /khyad par tshe ring mched lnga bstan pa'i tshogs/ /srid pa'i lha dgu spre yi mgur lha sermegs/ /bod skyong yul lha gnyan po mched 'khor rnams/ /gdung bas 'bod do 'dir byon mgron du bzhugs//rdzas sngags ting 'dzin rol ba las byung ba'i/ /dkar gsum mngar gsum phye par chang phud se gas//yid 'ong bza' bca'i bye brag du ma dang / /rin chen dar zab sku mchon spyan gzigs chogs//mi gtsang nyes kun sel ba'i bsang mchod dang / /snying nas mdza' zhing dbu 'phang mthor btegs te//gsol lo mchod do dam slong dgyes mdzod la/ /bag med le mdzes nongs pa ci mchis bshags/ /yang dag lta dang gzhan phan byang chub sems/ /165

thub pa'i bka' lung baspu ba med pa'i mthus/ /snying rje'i yul gyur nag phye gas sder gte gas kun//snang dang sdug pa'i blo snangan rab zhi nas/ /blang dor 'byed pa'i blo mig myur thob cing /dus kyi rgud pa'i mu na pa mthongs sangs te/ /ཿthos srid rang dbang gtsang pa'i snang ba'i dpal//'char bar nges serdzo dam ldan snying ma zhum/ / sngan tshe slob dgo mtsho skyes rdo spre dang / /rgyal bloni sems dpa' du mas bka' bache das shing //da lta rig 'dzin rnal 'byor bdag cag gis/ /gdung shugs drag pethos mtshetshed cing nyer bskul na//rang rang mthu stobs nus pa'i dpung bskyed de/ /rang yul gangs can zhing du bde skyed dpal/ /myur du bzhad pa'i rnam bzhi'i 'phrin las kun/ /ma cogs da lta nyid du sgrubs shig kye/ /ngas bod skyong lha srung 'phrin bskul de bris pa red/ de 'bri skabs nga rang yang ngu bzhin du bris pa yin/ bod lung pa'i gnas tshul de bsam blor 'khor/ slo ba dpon mtsho skyes rdo rjes bka' bsgo sa gnyer gtad yod pa'i bod kyi lha srung de rnams nga 3sna btsan byethol ba chags pa de bzhin/ bstan ma bcu gnyis kyis mtshon pa'i bod skyo nga lha srung kho rang tsho yang mgon med skyabs med skyo po zhig chags/ nga rang yang mi gcig lag gcig skyetho ngetho zhig chags/ nga la chos dang 'jig rten gyi yon tan ni gang yang mi 'dug skyo yo 'dra 'dra red de/166

nga la rgyal ba rin po che'i ming zhig yode pa'i cha nas 'od skyong srung ma de rnams la ngas sems gso dang rgyab skyor byas pa'i khul red/ sems skyo po'i gnas tshul red/ bod skyong lha srung tsho'i nang nas 'o de gung rgyal dang / rma chen 〈snam ra sermegs mang po zhig ni/ bodi kyi sa skyes the skyes lta bu yin stabs/nga tsho rigs gcig lta bu red/ gang ltar rkyen mang po zhig 'dzoms nas ngas 'phrin bskul de bris pa bzhin phan cogs kyang chen po byung / ((7chos skyo nga bsten phyogs skor gyi bka' slo ba phyogs bsdebs na/chos rig las khungs kyidapar pa'i 31ga therdzos 00 par gsal ba tshan bshus zhus pa yin/ )
